rows.name: The Creature of Chaos
rows.short_description: Frantic FPS game with very procedural levels
rows.description_html: Ever wanted visit one of Dracul's castles? Wondered how do they keep changing? Maybe experience non-euclidean horrors and confusion first hand? You're in luck! For the first time in history, we're opening Zlowrogowo Castle to the public! Fast Paced Fps Action Run and gun everything that moves. Take monsters from safe distance with your trusty revolver, go close and personal with double barrel shotgun or even use enemies against each other. Go explore off the main path and you may find artifacts that make you stronger, just be careful not to get lost... Both purely procedural and handmade locations The castle and it's surrounding grounds always change and most of areas you'll see only once. Few rooms resists chaos, but this doesn't mean they're safe... Variety of game modes Campaign mode - tackle main path that leads deeper into the castle and face fearsome guardians at the end of each zone. Arcade mode in which you will be given limited time to go as far - and score as much - as possible. Custom map mode - play around with map generator and create your own levels.

rows.name: Tales of Novariel
rows.short_description: Explore Novariel, a procedural generated land filled with various slimes. Fight your way through and gain rewards fitting your achievements. IMPORTANT: The game is currently playable but in a really basic state. It is currently not under active development anymore!
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT: The game is currently playable but in a really basic state. It is currently not under active development anymore! The land of Novariel is a vast and peaceful one. But one day slimes in different colors and clothing appeared and made the once peaceful world a dangerous one. Create your hero and fight against the slimes! Free the cities, help the lost citizens and explore a vast world ready for you. This game is a singleplayer RPG. It features a basic character creation, round based combat and an endless world. World generation The world is procedurally generated and offers currently the following tile-types with the mentioned content: City: Houses, Trees, Rocks, Ores and NPCs Forest: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies Plane: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies Mountain: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies River: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, River Lake: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, Lake Desert: Trees, Rocks, Ores, NPCs, Enemies, Lake Races Choose between the following races: Human: The basic race. Dwarf: Small but strong, always ready to fight. Elf: Fragile but agile. Never angry an elf with a bow. Giant: The biggest race in Novariel. Stupid but dangerous. Goblin: The rarest race. You want to challenge yourself? Play a Goblin. Nightelf: Elfs but with dark mode Classes Choose between the following classes: Warrior: You want a sword? Take it. Mage: -Weird magic noises- Thief: Why are my pockets always filled with gold?

rows.name: Aces Under the Moonlight™
rows.short_description: Action Sports is about to get a shot of pure fire. Run, jump, and Airdash your way to victory in this hand animated, high speed, punk-inspired ball game set against backgrounds of urban decay. Get ready for an absolutely electric experience.
rows.description_html: Aces Under the Moonlight is a lightning fast PvP game where you try to get the ball into the opponent's goal. Speed is the name of the game here: the more goals that are made, the faster the ball goes the more times you hit the ball, the faster the ball goes the more time the ball bounces of the stage, the faster the ball goes the higher the combo, the faster the ball goes Take control of characters inspired by underground punk, each with unique movesets and abilities. Play ball in 4 different modes including Crosscourt Brawl, a 1v1 mode where you forget the ball and just smack each other around. Hop into training mode to hone your skills or go to Crosscourt ball mode to remove the net and have full freedom in your movement. Master attacks, parries, and air-dash to dominate your enemy.

rows.name: PI.EXE
rows.short_description: Take the role of an antivirus software within the world of an operating system, eliminating malware spawns in a challenging, platforming quest!
rows.description_html: PI.EXE is a challenging action/platformer that takes place in the inside of an operative system's server! Slash through your enemies as your make your way through each sector of the server, in order to rid the whole system of the virus that has grasped it! A single means of offense: A sword that can slice through enemies, and take their data to power up again! You only have a single shot! A challenge, a touch, a termination: A single graze from your enemies will delete you and force you to start each sector over again! The main objective is not the end: Replayability, with either keyboard, or gamepads! Make the most of your time and ability by reaching each sector, and finishing the game in the shortest time possible! Or perhaps, with as many chained combo attacks as possible!

rows.name: Tray Racers!
rows.short_description: The world ended…But the fun didn’t! Race solo, or with your pals across the adorable post-apocalyptic world of Tray Racers! Grab a tray, surf the dunes, and get ready to SLIDE, DRIFT and TRICK your way to the finish line in this cute and colorful party racer, built for online multiplayer! YAHOOOOOO!
rows.description_html: ✨The world ended…But the fun didn’t!✨ From the creators of PHOGS!, Tray Racers! is a free-to-play racing game set in a vibrant post-apocalyptic world. Armed with nothing but your trusty tray, you play as a ragtag kid speedster - race solo or with up to 16 players through a wacky playground of randomly-generated sand dunes, cute critters, bouncy cactus forests and more! Surf the sizzling sands. Dazzle your pals with tray tricks. Hitch a ride on a giant worm. And outspeed your friends to become…the ultimate Tray Racer! For gamers of all ages! 💛 🌵 Hold onto your butts! It’s time to race… 🌵 Surf the dunes on your very own tray Race solo or in online multiplayer (with up to 16 players!!) Embrace your inner daredevil with *bonus speed* for near misses Goof off with silly emotes Pull off ✨cool ✨ tray tricks & combos Perfect for parties with pals 💛 🌵Discover a dazzling desert-world 🌵 When the world ended, the people of Tray Racers! found a better, more sustainable way to live. Together, and in better harmony with nature 🌱 Every race takes place on a unique, randomly-generated track - with weird and wonderful vistas, hazards, creatures, and surprises from a mix of bizarre & beautiful post-apocalyptic biomes. Featuring: Bouncy cactus forests Wacky wastelands Cute bugs & other critters Chaotic canyons Sustainable solarpunk settlements Herds of GIANT Camellos & More! 🎨 Race in style! Give your racer a makeover with…🎨 Sick Threads Gnarly Hairstyles Custom tray paint-jobs & More! 😊Get cute and cozy at the Camp 😊 Hang out with friends between races at the chilled-out Camp lobby Host a jam sesh with the Camp’s musical instruments Ponder your place in the universe under a starry night’s sky Pet *everything* with a dedicated ‘pet-the-thing’ button (There’s a friendly creature in the Camp called Scrump and we love him…) 🌱 Wholesome vibes 🌱 Made with 💛 by an indie team A positive take on the apocalypse that celebrates all things eco, kindness & community No way to hinder other players while racing (winning isn’t everything!) Characters that make you go awwwwwwww

rows.name: The Moonlight Circus
rows.short_description: In this first-person VR-Horror game, you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Solve puzzles and discover clues to unveil the tragic backstory and find your way out.
rows.description_html: In the Moonlight Circus , you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Who are you? What happened? And how do you get out of here? Take on the role of the protagonist and escape the Moonlight Circus. Unravel the mystery of the circus and its artists and get out alive. Features Explore three circus areas Movement through Arm Swinging Physics based gameplay Team The Crooked Creep Creators, a team of four students realized The Moonlight Circus with the help of one Sound student and two voice actors in three months as part of their studies at the h_da. Ben Wührer - Programmer, Game Designer, Sound Manager Lara Meyer - Vision Keeper, Character Artist, 2D/3D Artist Lea Wagner - Production Manager, 3D Artist, Animator Max Rupp - Tech / 3D Artist, Lighting Artist, Shading Artist Awesome Sound & Music from: Fabjén Rauch And the voices behind our characters: Andrew Latheron Will Edmisten The Moonlight Circus was made using Unity and FMOD. HTC Vive Users: If you use a vive you have to change the controller mappings, for example switch the menu button on both sides to left primary and right primary in the SteamVR settings. Example image is in the folder with the game files.

rows.name: Take the Throne
rows.short_description: Take the Throne is a massively multiplayer battle royale game with up to 25 players in a free-for-all bloody fight to be the last one alive.
rows.description_html: Join the Discord About the Game Take the Throne is a new Massive Multiplayer Online Battle Royale game with up to 25 players in a free-for-all bloody fight to be crowned and take the throne! Take the Throne is built on PvP encounters and is filled with comedic physics-based gameplay. FEATURES Official online battle royale servers with up to 25 players (regions in NA, EU) Create a private, locally hosted battle royale lobby in which friends can join via a code 7 Unique Classes, each with their own abilities 20+ Unique Maps Advanced fighting mechanics (3 different types of swings, as well as 2 class abilities for each class) Weapon hit force (the lower health you are, the further you get hit) Customize your character with 60+ skins (each with 4 different variations) and 100+ weapons (Some skins and weapons are only purchasable with crowns you get from winning the battle royale) Fully physics-based combat and incredibly funny ragdoll physics 25 PLAYER LOBBIES Take the Throne is a new Massive Multiplayer Online Battle Royale game with up to 25 players. Each round more players are eliminated until one player takes the throne! FUN FIGHTING MECHANICS Take the Throne combines ragdoll physics with advanced fighting mechanics and weapon hit force - where the lower health you are, the farther you get hit. SATISFYING PVP ENCOUNTERS Take the Throne is built on PvP encounters. Equip your weapon and have a choice at 3 different types of swings as well as unique class abilities! If you need to be on the defensive, use the block mechanic to avoid certain death! ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION Take the Throne has thousands of skin/weapon combinations! Advancing further in the rounds/winning will allow you to purchase more skins or weapons.

rows.name: Sex Search
rows.short_description: Plunge into the world of relaxation and light erotica! Mindfulness logic game with many modes.
rows.description_html: Are you tired of a hard day at work? Or, on the contrary, do you want to strain your brains and make a test for the brain? Then this game is especially for you! The essence of the game is simple - you have an exorcism in front of you and you need to find 10 hidden items of clothing. The interest of the game also adds a variety of different game modes! Among which: 1) Normal Mode - here you can spend small gaming sessions as relaxed as possible. Select the level you are interested in and find 10 hidden items of clothing there. Found? Get the hottest image in the gallery as a reward! 2) Random Mode - here you can spend a lot of time. The level will be randomly selected and all items of clothing will be scattered randomly across the field. After passing the level, you immediately move to another with the same rules. 3) Time Attack Mode - this mode is a challenge for your attentiveness! Here, in 60 seconds, you will need to look for 10 hidden items of clothing at a random level. For each item found, you will receive +2 seconds to the timer. When finding all the items on the level - you are moved to the next one, saving your time. How long can you last? Game Features: 3 unique game modes 5 varied and desolate levels Unique system for placing items on levels The game is completely free

rows.name: Elteria Hunter
rows.short_description: The world of Elteria is full of magic and monsters, And the Elteria Hunters are there to fight these monsters and protect the regions from evil. Level up your skill grind for equipment and become the strongest hunter!
rows.description_html: Elteria Hunter The world of Elteria is a world full of magic and monsters, and it's a dangerous world for an average human. That's why the humans created a guild full of hunters to take down these monsters and keep peace in the world. But humans are not alone in this world. There are gods and demons too. In every region there is an Elder monster who controls the region and protects it from danger. But something strange is coming and even the Elders are acting up more dangerous than normal. So are you the new hunter that can protect us for what’s coming next? The primary focus in-game is following the story towards the stronger monsters. And with this, you will be mainly focused on crafting and quest to fight monsters and epic bosses. There will be a lot of different mechanics in the game to make your party very strong and make your own play style. In the early stage, the game will not be too hard, and it makes it easy to get the hang of the game, but after the mid-story, the game will get more complex, and you will need to have good gear, or else you will die. Buying This, you will receive the base game right now, going into early access, so the game will only grow towards his full release. The base game includes right now (more coming with future updates :D Story Quest. Side Quest. Dungeons. Craft system. Merchant system. Guild System.

In every region there is an Elder monster who controls the region and protects it from danger. But something strange is coming and even the Elders are acting up more dangerous than normal. So are you the new hunter that can protect us for what’s coming next? The primary focus in-game is following the story towards the stronger monsters. And with this, you will be mainly focused on crafting and quest to fight monsters and epic bosses. There will be a lot of different mechanics in the game to make your party very strong and make your own play style. In the early stage, the game will not be too hard, and it makes it easy to get the hang of the game, but after the mid-story, the game will get more complex, and you will need to have good gear, or else you will die. Buying This, you will receive the base game right now, going into early access, so the game will only grow towards his full release. The base game includes right now (more coming with future updates :D Story Quest. Side Quest. Dungeons. Craft system. Merchant system. Guild System.

rows.name: Xpraize Beta for GameMaster
rows.short_description: An innovative game to play a tabletop role-playing game in VR ! Let’s experience another side of RPGs. There are Game Master version and VR version. In this Game Master version, let's make VR players enjoy the game! You can also record players’ adventures like a movie director with various cameras.
rows.description_html: Xpraize Beta, the first game developed by the indie game company RedefineArts Inc., is an innovative game that allows you to play a tabletop role-playing game in VR. The game is available in PC and VR versions, and in this PC versions, you are the Game Master. The Game Master will manage the game according to the prepared scenario. Switching stages, controlling NPC characters, and performing various event actions will be performed by the Game Master. Sometimes they become the player’s allies, and sometimes they control monsters to hunt the player down. Use the various camera control functions to record adventures to create your movie. Xpraize Beta includes an introductory fantasy scenario called “Dragon Descendants.” Up to 5 players can play online. All players except the game master will participate from VR. (If you only want to play as a player, you may not want to read the scenario for Game Master) We hope you will experience the fun of Xpraize through this scenario first. Scenario Book Overview Document Rulebook The additional scenario will be updated regularly after launch and available as DLC. The “Game Master” version is offered free of charge, so you can discuss it with your friends and decide who will be the Game Master before you play. Or you can go into the game as Game Master to recruit players to join you. Xpraize Beta

rows.name: SpectrumGames
rows.short_description: The good old Mafia in a virtual space, as close to the offline version. Become the Game Master, invite players and build the game atmosphere as in real life! Or find an open room to join as a player.
rows.description_html: SpectrumGames with Mafia Room is a platform for Mafia for 9 people, consisting of: three Citizens, a Special Officer, a Doctor, a Detective, three Mafia members. It is a team game (team of the peaceful city against the mafia team), which requires a leader from among the users. The goal of the mafia: to stay in equal numbers against the non-shooting peaceful roles. The goal of the peaceful city: to get the entire mafia out from behind the game table. How it happens: - The peaceful players analyze the players' statements during the day, the voting process, the results of the night's actions, and try to determine who plays for the mafia, and then take those players out from the game table. By voting, and by the city's firing roles, also by night actions. - Players playing for the Mafia try to take out as many peaceful players as possible by night actions and by voting. Sometimes set up their 'weakest link' in order to remove suspicion and gain a foothold at the game table. - By removing from the table a peaceful role that has the ability to take night actions, the Mafia gains a strategic advantage. - Players leaving the game table reveal their roles. - The game ends with a victory for the mafia when there are as many mafia players left at the table as there are peaceful players with a non-shooting role. Draw when the table remains 1 mafia and 1 firing peaceful role. In other cases - the victory of the peaceful city. - At the game table there is a set of ethical rules (no profanity, etc.) at the discretion of the host. What you can do in SpectrumGames: 1. Choose an avatar from ready-made avatars or generate an avatar from a photo and customize it. You can create any number of avatars, customize them and choose a new image for each game. 2. use emoji and gestures in addition to voice and text chat (we will increase the arsenal of emotions). 3. Interact with the environment. You can move some objects, move around the room (with the presenter's permission, of course). Possibilities for the Game Master: to upload his files (pdf, audio and 3D objects), create a closed or open room for the game with the subsequent invitation of players to it, moderate the game. Mafia is possibly the best team discussion game for boosting communication skills. It may be used for corporate team-building events and friendly parties. In our application, the Game Master can brand the space and build the game atmosphere like in real life!

rows.name: Vamps For The Memories
rows.short_description: Banter or die! Play two hunters who are racing to kill a vampire in a 90s JRPG style comedy. Solve puzzles, kill rats, and tolerate puns. It's like classic LucasArts made a Final Fantasy knock-off. The key to survival is exploring the world and finding things to talk about!
rows.description_html: An undead lord is terrorizing the countryside and every hunter in the realm is clamoring to be the first to stake'm! Play as two hunters who band together in their quest to defeat the new evil first! This is a cozy 90s JRPG style game where finding topics to banter about is a key to survival and trading stories of past battles gets you new and powerful skills. It's a lot of jokes, think a LucasArts Adventure teamed up with a Final Fantasy clone. Turn based combat, trading games, dungeon puzzles (e.g. box pushing) and lot of be people to talk to and banter topics to collect. There are options in the game to make combat easy and to give hints for the puzzles. You can turn them on and off anytime. This game was made in a few weeks for my DnD group and now it's out here for anyone who might enjoy it! Soundtrack: Resources: RPGMaker MZ Base Sprites and tiles from Additional sprites from @hazeldaydreamer (Check out ) Plugins from

rows.name: Siren's Call: Free Beta Edition
rows.short_description: This is an outdated, public beta for Siren's Call: Escape Velocity. Home is where your body is. And like any good tourist trap, Siren’s Call will do whatever it can to keep you there as long as possible. They will drag you down like crabs in a bucket. They will make this place home.
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: This is a free, public beta for Siren's Call: Escape Velocity. Be forewarned. Siren’s Call, Florida, 2011, 60 miles north of Cape Kennedy The final days of your adolescence are coming to a close… Having solved the strange and terrifying mysteries of this quiet beach town, you have finally found the time to relax with your friends. In the two weeks since your adventure ended, the six of you have mostly cherished your time together—your spirits wafting beautifully on the precipice of adulthood. Even so, all good things must end. With only one day left in Siren’s Call, all that’s remains is for you to pack your bags and say goodbye to them. Don’t leave without making sure they know how you really feel. Only then can you finally be satisfied with what’s to come. Judith , the exceptionally sweet (and extraordinarily intense) sovereign of Siren’s Call; Andi , the sovereign’s sassy twin sister whose strength and spunk speak volumes on their own; Ashton , a hero in training whose sizable fist is matched only by the size of his heart; Emil , the once timid boy turned man who will not stop until he reaches absolute perfection; and Violet , waiting patiently as always. There's a couple others too...I guess. 7+ hours of Visual Novel Gameplay with dire consequences for how you choose to spend this final day of yours. 55 journal entries and and 60 unlockable gallery images for those who want to explore everything this town has to offer. An original story centered on saying goodbye to friends rather than saying hello to strangers. A dynamic, evocative soundtrack made by The Pocket Protectors and LilyxJorge meant to perfectly capture the feel of central Florida music. A cast of lovely characters that only want what's best for you. Developer Note: This is the free beta version of Siren's Call: Escape Velocity, meaning that compared to the full release, there will be missing content and bugs that have been patched by the time the full release is out. While this version is (and will always be) free/up on Steam, it is a much more janky experience compared to the finish product. Regardless, it is still a great look into the past of this project that I hope you enjoy!

rows.name: Divine Combat
rows.short_description: Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. The fights are in top-down view on a grid, much like similar turn-based unit management games. There is no penalty for losing.
rows.description_html: Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. Each team is led by a 'Divine', or a being of immense power. Your goal is to win every battle and get the perfect team. In the main hub, walk around in 3rd person and talk to NPCs. You can also upgrade your units and purchase items from the shop in the hub level. In the combat zone, you will have a team of 6 characters and will fight an enemy team to the death in a top-down grid view. All units will automatically find the best path to a location, so you will not have to manually plan moving out each unit, they will do it automatically.

rows.name: Bionic Rebirth
rows.short_description: Classic arcade first person shooter, survive the depths of a overrun facility controlled by power AI. Can you escape?
rows.description_html: You are a man who was once known as 'August', now only an experiment in a science facility that converts humans into AI killing machines. You wake up in the perfect time, as a rogue AI has risen to power and taken over the facility. Fight your way through the floors and find a way to escape or even stop the AI... Explore the facility Gather upgrades Equip yourself with fate and a trusty gun Fight your way through the maze Defeat evil weaponized droids Drodge the deadliest lasers Do you have what it takes to shut down the facility and escape?

rows.name: Secrets of the Temple
rows.short_description: Secrets of the Temple is a single player puzzle platformer adventure game. Traverse the Pharaoh's labyrinthian temple and locate and collect the Eye of Ra before it's too late!
rows.description_html: You are a world-renowned treasure hunter seeking the ‘Eye of Ra’, a legendary diamond thought lost to the sands of time. The Eye is said to bring wealth and prosperity to any who possess it. Brave the Winding Tunnels of an Expansive Complex Navigate the shifting platforms, treacherous pitfalls, and fiendish traps left to guard the Eye in this ancient tomb. Solve Long-Forgotten Puzzles Pit your mind against the Pharaoh’s engineers and find ways of bypassing their locks and traps. Unearth Ancient Foes Fight for your life against the Pharaoh's undying chosen, sworn to guard the Eye long after the end of their natural lives.

rows.short_description: Welcome to Hohenheim: Skywards Fly high into the skyes and hope not to fall to the below as the Underbelly is ready to swollow you whole. A 3rd-person Plattformer with environmental puzzle and Randomly generated Maps.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Hohenheim: Skywards Fly high into the skyes and hope not to fall to the below as the Underbelly is ready to swollow you whole. A 3rd-person Plattformer with environmental puzzle and Randomly generated Maps. Jump, take leaps of faith and follow the light. Battle challening Bosses and enemies (at some point) and soar the sky.... if you fall you enter the 2. dungeon in the form of the Underbelly and have to find a way out of the maze(at some point) before you can try again to soar thru the sky again and reach the city of Hohenheim. This game is free and born out of passion so dont expect a perfectely polished game :) it is and will always be free and a sideproject of mine and any kind of monitization will not take place. I swear so on my mothers grave as soon as she has one.... Either way...we getting side tracked... Enjoy the game.

rows.name: Slider
rows.short_description: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.
rows.description_html: Slider is an award-winning puzzle adventure game where the world faces cataclysm , and you must use The Artifact to solve puzzles, rearrange maps, help reconnect humanity, and, most importantly... find your cat. Free to play! 10+ hours of content. Solve tricky puzzles with a variety of mechanics. Explore 9 unique regions, each with their own twists. Cats!!! Slide Tiles to Solve Puzzles Use The Artifact to slide pieces of the world to your advantage, unlocking treasures and completing each area's grid. Watch as your collection of objects expands as you solve increasingly complex puzzles. Explore 9 Unique Areas The world is full of mysteries, with each new area presenting a unique twist on the 8-puzzle. Discover rotating environments, tactical combat, 3D grids, time travel, and more! Help an Odd Cast of Characters After the world has been shattered, it's up to you to reconnect everyone. Help those in need piece their lives back together. Master Unique Mechanics Solve puzzles of increasing complexity as your toolbox grows and mechanics build upon each other. From anchors to minecarts to buoys to lights, take control of the world around you.

rows.name: The Doll Beneath
rows.short_description: Awakened from a deep slumber, six students find themselves trapped inside an abandoned research facility, otherwise known as the 'Losinglight'. Escape into a war torn city, and discover the truth behind an otherworldly being like no other.
rows.description_html: Awakened from a deep slumber, six students find themselves trapped inside an abandoned research facility, otherwise known as the 'Losinglight'. Delve deep into the trenches of the black eclipse, and search for a way out. Escape into a war torn city, and discover the truth behind an otherworldly being like no other. KEY FEATURES A thrilling 5 episode long storyline. - Spanning over the course of five different episodes, with four chapters each, experience a different story with each entry. (Not all episodes may be available at launch.) Unique characters, all with their own individual backstories. - Each and every character has their own story to tell. Learn about them, and unravel the reason why you were taken. Detective-like gameplay, with numerous different ways to uncover the story. - Collect evidence, and piece the story together yourself. There's a bigger picture at play here, can you uncover the truth? A 2D classic RPG Maker horror experience. - Taking elements from other RPG Maker games, The Doll Beneath will combine the use the puzzles, exploration, and isolation, to bring you a one of a kind, classic RPG Maker experience. Discover secrets - Alongside the main story, comes a whole slew of side activities to discover. They're not easy to find. Run, hide, RUN! - Be wary, you're not alone in here. Run, hide, and most importantly, RUN, to stay alive! As you explore the world of Kemden City, you will encounter many different obstacles, some not even human. Do your best, and stay alive. Uncover the truth behind it all, and search for a way out.

rows.short_description: Astral Slider is an immersive time-attack laser racer. Slide through a number of different astral cyberworlds and blast your way past obstacles to increase your speed and beat your top scores. Play flatscreen or in VR.
rows.description_html: Astral Slider is an immersive time-attack laser racer. Slide through a number of different astral cyberworlds and blast your way past obstacles to increase your speed and beat your top scores. Features Play flatscreen or in VR (note: currently Oculus only) 100% free. No microtransactions here. Fast-paced gameplay. Avoid the black blocks and shoot the red ones to gain speed. Improve your times to earn up to three stars for each level. An exciting soundtrack that will get your heart pumping.

rows.name: Harriet: From Slave To Hero
rows.short_description: Harriet: From Slave to Hero is based on the life of Harriet Tubman, an African-American slave who would become the most famous fighter for the freedom of American slaves, in the years before the American Civil War. It is a 2.5 D turn-based strategy game with puzzle and stealth components.
rows.description_html: Play as Harriet Tubman! , You will get to know the life of this incredible woman. From the years she was a slave to her famous rescue missions and her escape from slavery, you will travel throughout the most relevant moments of her life. You will progress through the highlights of her life, from escaping slavery to helping rescue other black slaves. Turn-based system where the player makes a move and enemies move after the player's turn ends Delve into 3 stages of his life and more than 25 different scenarios. Re-discover the life of Harriet Tubman through a board game experience. Stealth, action, and logic mechanics that will surprise you A beautiful soundtrack that accompanies each scenario

rows.description_html: Lights off is a short and experimental horror game. Play through a fear most of us have experienced as you turn off the lights alone at home.

rows.name: Catharsis
rows.short_description: Descend deep in the dungeons of Catharsis to reclaim what you've lost. Dive into this First Person Dungeon Crawler featuring a grim aesthetic with a heavy focus on character growth, exploration and customization!
rows.description_html: Catharsis is a character driven dungeon diver where the goal is to explore maze-like environments to collect treasure and return to town alive. Players have control over their character’s classes and gear, and must manage their inventory space as they explore the dungeons and face powerful monsters and ancient horrors. The player characters are a party of Lost Souls that need to venture deeper into the dungeon to defeat the Ancient Horror preventing their rebirth. Strengthen the souls and equipment of your characters and challenge the 3 increasingly grim dungeons against monsters with class archetypes, unique skills and dangers.

rows.name: The World is Binary: Why Love is the Answer
rows.short_description: The World is Binary, a 3D visual novel, takes you on a journey of good and evil, science and religion, and questions what is true or false. The experience explores the ideas of love and fear, and offers practical steps on how you can improve your life and change the world.
rows.description_html: The World is Binary, a 3D visual novel, takes you on a journey of good and evil, science and religion, and questions what is true or false. The experience explores the ideas of love and fear, and offers practical steps on how you can improve your life and change the world. Essentially a multimedia book, the experience lasts about 30 minutes and explores many serious and deep issues, such as the ideological differences between people of faith and the scientific community, the people's freedom and the government's order, and explores how the emotions of love and fear hold a deeper meaning in life. There are no choices or branching. It is, in essence, a book. However there are real time 3D graphics running in the background, and relaxing music to listen to as you read. The graphics are configurable for both high-end and low-end machines, and you can hide the text and just watch the experience as a looping benchmark. Press Alt + Enter for Full Screen mode. Press Space to Toggle Text. Press Escape to Access Options.

rows.name: Planet-A
rows.short_description: Planet A is a purposeful Metaverse. A geo-spatially correct Digital Twin that has been created created for gameplay and education, and getting to know places that may or may not-yet exist in the real world. This is just the beginning - start your journey.
rows.description_html: Welcome, to Planet A. Planet A is a ‘purposeful Metaverse’ which is focused on creating deeper knowledge, enjoyment and experience of the landmark real-world places Lendlease Podium is entrusted to create, and curate. Inside Planet A, anyone can virtually play, orientate and get-to-know quasi-physical places - and each other when multiplayer mode is initiated [coming mid-2022], before or after the real-world version has been constructed. Planet A is a mirror-world, a living city that reflects the realities and impacts of climate change that we face worldwide - most especially in our urban environments. Carbon Calculator data is your window into this. Inside this ‘Metaverse’, we educate through gamification day one, and will collaborate as the platform evolves, as players learn-about the most sustainable solutions to the greatest challenges humankind faces, today. We invite you to bring your energy, drive and the passion to embrace sustainability and make a difference. To begin, fly-into our first Planet A project: The Milano Innovation District (MIND) where you will meet your Planet A Chaperone. Formerly the site of the 2015 World Expo, your task is to play games that teach sustainability concepts such as waste management and IoT, battle the scoreboard and acquire all the skills and knowledge that are needed to plan and manifest a net-zero urban-regeneration project, like a ‘Lendlease Podium Pro’. And your rewards won’t just be virtual. Online Planet-A Scoreboard leaders will literally make their mark on MIND, being projected and celebrated in-and-on the real-world site. Plus….. from time to time, you never know what your game-points might be 'unlock' - in the real-world…. Join us on a journey into Planet A. Join our initiative to virtually + physically build a world that gives more than it takes. And - take your pick of experiencing in PC or in tethered VR.

rows.name: Chrysalis Inc.
rows.short_description: Slipping between the past and present, a child puzzles their way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear.
rows.description_html: Chrysalis Inc. is a 2D 3D Horror Adventure Puzzle Side Scroller. Explore the abandoned toy factory, solve intricate puzzles and unveil the deep dark truth behind it. Story: Waking up in an abandoned toy factory, You realize something is not right. The area is filled with weird machinery and strange imagery. Slipping between the past and present, you need to puzzle your way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear. As you delve into the depths of the factory, the layered truth will begin to unravel with each horrifying discovery. From the vicious robots left to rot, to the unexplainable residual power that grants time travel, not everything is what it seems. Maybe some truths are best left buried. Features & Mechanics: Dark, Depressing Irony: They say that the road to hell is paved with good intentions. One act of goodwill for one person could cause the suffering of many. One child’s glee at receiving the latest toy overshadows the tiny, grimy hands that constructed it. Explore a ruined factory: Traverse through the vast yet lifeless factory, where your only company will hunt you down. With each new location, the story behind the factory's construction and creations will be revealed in fragmented pieces. Unique Puzzles: Through innovative puzzles, you will be able to change the past to affect the present. Use this ability well to help you solve the mystery. This game is a student project developed over 9 months by 9 students in the Entertainment Arts and Engineering (EAE) Graduate Program at the University of Utah.

rows.name: Coral Cove
rows.short_description: Coral Cove is a relaxing match 3-like underwater game in which you try to build the largest reef without running out of corals to place.
rows.description_html: Azure waters, vibrant corals and busy flocks of fish are what used to await you a few meters under the water surface. But the damages of pollution have extinguished most of this. With only a few corals left, it is up to you to restore the once beautiful ecosystems in this relaxing match 3-like game. But beware of the dangers lingering underwater and your slowly depleting stock of corals. You start with nothing but a few tiles to build on and a small hand of coral cards to place. Three corals of the same level merge into a new coral of the next higher level. Through clever planning and strategic placement your corals will soon expand into a large, lively reef. Explore the seafloor to find new challenges, quests and special structures to help you with your run. Expand your reef to unlock different areas and advance to new places. But watch out for the dangers you and your coral reef will have to face. Short rounds, numerous hindrances to overcome and always new strategies to build and advance encourage replaying again and again. The expanses of Coral Cove await you!

rows.name: SOUL JANITOR
rows.short_description: In SOUL JANITOR you play as a worker contracted into a night time janitorial job, but when you arrive you find out that your cleaning up more than just toliets. Armed with only your spray bottle fight your way through the facilities in order to complete your contract and escape the facility!
rows.description_html: In SOUL JANITOR you play as a janitor who was contracted into cleaning out an old thought to be abandoned warehouse. You quickly find out that there is much more to this warehouse than a few dirty bathrooms. Armed with only your spray bottle, you must fight your way through the warehouse to complete your contract and unravel the mysteries of the facility along the way. Key Features: - Explore a detailed environment - Fight unique spirit enemies - Solve puzzles and find tapes to unravel the mystery

rows.name: Pickle Clicker
rows.short_description: Click pickle, get pickle, spend pickle, get more pickle, and most importantly... Protect pickle from sneaky Poglins!
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT NOTE: This game doesn't have any sort of ascension/rebirth at the moment and development for this game is unfortunately going to be on and off. Welcome to Pickle Clicker, an incremental game based on pickles. You just click the pickle and get a pickle out of thin air. Not only that, but with your pickles you have the ability to purchase and further enhance your pickle picking empire by buying auto pickles. But watch out! The more pickles you have, the more Poglins eager to come and steal your pickles, so defend and fight back with the purchasing of upgrade pickles.

rows.description_html: Battle other players in tanks inspired by iconic fighting vehicles including heavy tanks, half-tracks, and armored cars. Use special abilities like grenades and airstrikes to gain the upper hand and dominate your opponents. Personalize your tank! Flex your skills by unlocking camouflage patterns, and go to the Shop to customize your vehicle with unique stickers and decals. STUG is always evolving with rotating gamemodes, new maps, and new vehicles. Play now!

rows.name: Splinters of Regret
rows.short_description: Splinters of Regret is an atmospheric, action bullet hell where you fight your way through manifestations of your regrets.
rows.description_html: Splinters of Regret is a student-made action game with a focus on bullet hell elements and an atmospheric aesthetic. After committing multiple sins in life, you are forced to face them in death. A mountainous prison made of your own regrets seeks to make sure you never forget them. Make your way through the regretful hordes and hazardous terrain to find a form of peace at the top. Splintering With the power of Splintering, you have a second chance at 'life' after the regrets overwhelm you. However, you are defenseless and must survive the onslaught to regain your control. Vulnerability is what your regrets want. Items and Artifacts Encounter a variety of items and artifacts to help you on your journey. Items provide one-use destruction against the regretful hordes that plague you. Artifacts are lasting equipment that gives you a source of protection and aid. The Language of Na'en Listen to the original language of Na'en that the inhabitants speak from across the void in their own personal regret-filled prisons. You can find our language document at this link: .

rows.name: Alcohol Empire
rows.short_description: Alcohol Empire - unusual mixture of real-time strategy and card game. Use a variety of cards and a range of buildings you can buy or build to gain an advantage and defeat your opponents!
rows.description_html: Alcohol Empire - unusual mixture of real-time strategy and card game. Use a variety of cards and a range of buildings you can buy or build to gain an advantage and defeat your opponents! However, do not forget about time - the huge pace of the game will not allow you to think through your moves for a long time in advance, you will have to act quickly in order to keep up with your opponents. Game Features: Access to three characters with already prepared decks of cards. Let's skip the tedious part of deck building and jump right into the fight. We're here for fun! Buy buildings belonging to other players, steal cards from them, strengthen your buildings or weaken enemy ones - everyone can find a strategy for themselves. The high pace of the game will not let you get bored, and the victory will depend not only on the quality, but also on the speed of decision-making. The original visual and sound design gives the game a unique charm.

rows.name: Zombie Death Quota
rows.short_description: Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak. Grenade, shotgun, snipe and flame your way through the zombie horde and then evacuate in the helicopter.
rows.description_html: Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak and evacuate in the helicopter. Explore the island and find Bio-waste containers and neutralise enough Zombies to achieve the Zombie Death Quota. Scavenge for guns, ammo, grenades and health packs scattered around the island to help you in your mission. This first person shooter was first launched on the Xbox 360 Indie Games service in 2012, the XBLIG service was closed down in 2017. Play this part of gaming history which is preserved here today and support me by checking out my newest game Splodge Royale. Weapons Flamethrower: A Heavy Metal flamethrower. Shotgun: Never be without one in an apocalypse. Scoped Rifle: When you don’t want to move much. Pistol: Infinite ammo. Machine Gun: Short range, but very good when you are surrounded. Levels Play 13 increasingly difficult levels.

rows.name: Conflict 3048
rows.short_description: Real-time strategy and tactics on an alien world! Command super space soldiers against an array of alien hordes. Commander - we need you!
rows.description_html: Conflict 3048 is a real time tactical sci fi game written by Matt Lloyd in 2022. CAMPAIGN You play as a commander in the invading army on an alien world, documenting your trials and tribulations as you wage war against the alien hordes. Your tour of duty begins in a small listening post near the front lines and soon has you fighting battles against hundreds of aliens in do or die actions. ARMY FEATURES At your disposal are infantry with assault rifles, flame throwers, heavy combat shotguns;mechs with laser rifles and flame throwers, medics with the latest in battlefield healing technology and also air support and artillery. Throw into the mix armoured personnel carriers that can fly to anywhere on the battlefield and you've got yourself a force worthy of eliminating the alien enemies. GAME EDITOR and SCRIPTING If you tire of the main campaign you can edit the missions with the editor with the touch of a button, or craft your own new campaigns with full scripting support. The scripting, editing and customisation ability is all documented. In fact the game even ships with source code if you wish to make further changes to the game mechanics. Switching between editing mode and play mode is seamless.

rows.name: The Dream Team
rows.short_description: A fanmade game about Mr. Fruit and the Dream Team. A semi-linear turnbased RPG puzzle game where you play as Fruit, Rob, Blue, and Poppy to save reality from permanent sleep. Plenty of references, and a story deep enough to have things to spoil.
rows.description_html: The people of reality are falling into permanent slumber, never being able to wake up. With the help of the Dream Witch Poppy, Fruit, Rob, and Blue will enter the Dream Realm, a space where all dreams converge. There they will enter the dreams of their friends and try to wake them up from the inside. Join our heroes as they save many familiar faces within the Dream Realm. Return to reality to spend time with friends, record content, and gear up for your next adventure! The more people you save, the more you can weaken the gate at the end of the Dream Realm to get inside and strike down whoever or whatever is putting people into permanent sleep.
rows.about_html: The people of reality are falling into permanent slumber, never being able to wake up. With the help of the Dream Witch Poppy, Fruit, Rob, and Blue will enter the Dream Realm, a space where all dreams converge. There they will enter the dreams of their friends and try to wake them up from the inside. Join our heroes as they save many familiar faces within the Dream Realm. Return to reality to spend time with friends, record content, and gear up for your next adventure! The more people you save, the more you can weaken the gate at the end of the Dream Realm to get inside and strike down whoever or whatever is putting people into permanent sleep.

rows.name: Leviathan
rows.short_description: Play as 1 of 3 factions in the fight for control of Domusalus, but beware the Kaecillian menace who threaten both locals and warring factions. Deploy with your gear, search for upgraded loot, and escape in time to keep it for your next assault for planetary dominance.
rows.description_html: Leviathan is a multiplayer extraction shooter set in a sci-fi universe where humanity has been abducted by a gargantuan, interstellar beast and changed over the course of several millennia. The abducted were ultimately discarded onto foreign planets. To survive, they have been forced to evolved into three factions of biologically and ideologically distinct lifeforms. Recently, a second wave of abductions have occurred. Fate has brought them together to the surface of the bountiful world of Domusalus; where only ONE FACTION can establish dominance for their survival. Fight for control of Domusalus as one of these factions: • Terran – Strength is paramount. Given the chance to demonstrate their might to the weaker factions, they will surely establish dominance. Domusalus, being rich in natural resources their home planet is greatly lacking, shows itself as an opportunity to conquer. After previously living in such hostile environments, the Terran have no intentions of sharing this wealth – the other factions are merely an obstacle in their path to claim what is theirs. • Faunian – The Faunian believe in the preservation of natural life. If any being was to show disrespect to this order, that being is considered a pollutant that must be cleansed from the ecosystem. After seeing the other factions taking selfish advantage of the planet’s resources, the Faunian ready themselves to protect it, even if it means total extinction of the opposition, and the native Domi people. • Angel – With golden metallic bodies, the Angel have discarded their ties to humanity. In doing so, they have become virtually immortal and seek to 'upgrade' all other lifeforms in the same way. Believing that this is the only way for advancement, any who resist are marked at as primitive beings that require immediate extermination. Key Features • Three playable factions – each with a mysterious shared history! • Hundreds of items - weapons, ammo, armor, grenades, restoratives and more! • Explore the “Aurelian Wilds” - a HUGE map offering unique areas, enemies, loot and extractions! • High risk/High reward - fight against (and loot!) both AI and Player opponents! • Play solo or in teams of three – take the loot for yourself OR work together to enhance survivability! • Capture outposts – make your mark to boost your faction's domination over the planet!

rows.name: Psychosis
rows.short_description: Fight against demons and your own mind to save yourself from a never-ending hell in this retro-style survival-horror game about mystery, psychology, and the coldness of killing. Banish demons with deadly weapons and reassemble the mysterious pieces of a family gone missing in Psychosis.
rows.description_html: While investigating the home of a family gone missing, you find evidence of something unexplainable. But when you approach it, the world goes dark. You awaken drenched in blood and faced with the shattered skull of a gnarled unnatural creature. Darkness. You sprint through a forest beset by fog, sure only that you must run. Enter the world of Psychosis, a retro-style survival-horror game about psychology and the coldness of killing. SURVIVE AT ALL COSTS Wield deadly weapons to face the horrors of your own mind and save yourself from a never-ending hell. UNCOVER A MYSTERY Reassemble the disturbing shreds of evidence left behind by the missing family members and escape this dark world with your life. SUFFER THE SURREAL Trust nothing as your grasp on your own surroundings slips away in an ever-changing environment as you fight to maintain your own sanity. EXPERIENCE NOSTALGIA Transport yourself back to the 1990s Pacific Northwest with a hybrid-retro art style reminiscent of the era. The game is presented with low-res art, modern lighting, and crunchy audio.

rows.name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log4
rows.short_description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure
rows.description_html: 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log4' (Play time : 30 minutes) This is a continuation of 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log3'. Start with Log1. Development of Log4: 'Two mysteries that intersect' Clione, who lost sight of Coco, arrived at her own astonishing roots! and! A crazy old man who appears in a strange shape attacks them! History that becomes clear like angry waves! The story that continues from Log1 finally advances to the climax. How do you interpret the events that appear in front of you? A new development opens! Two silent wanderers 6 full chapters A game of exploration and adventure A lost child, drifting in an odd husk, lands at a mysterious structure. Clione, a manufactured doll you encounter. You are Clione. Your purpose? Protect this lost child. What awaits you at the top of the slowly sinking structure? What is a 'Sinking Structure'? What is the true identity of 'Clione'? Where did the 'Lost Child' come from? Major features You can play with the keyboard or controller. Actions include 'running', 'walking', 'jumping', 'climbing', etc., and you only have to press a button depending on the situation. When walking with the controller, tilt the stick a little. Operate some machine, investigate, and get information from the people you meet. Lost child are at risk during their actions. At this time, if you want to move the lost child, you can approach the lost child and 'hold hands', and you can move together. When a lost child comes into contact with water, a mysterious creature called ankh may appear and be attacked. Clione's weapon is Taser only. You will be able to fire after charging. Aim with the Shift key or the left trigger. Fire with the Space key or the A button. When locked on, the aim will turn red and the taser bullet will be able to track. rows.short_description: You’re a parkouring astronaut in a retro-neon dreamlike world hurling trough the vastness of space in order to get the last slice of pizza. Wallrun, jump, climb, use your grappling hook and portals to get the fastest time! For fans of Mirror's Edge, Beat Saber and CS:GO Surfing.
rows.description_html: Pizza Synthwave is a fast paced parkour game where you have to get to the pizza at the end of each level using your speed, quick reflexes and abilities. Wallrun, jump, climb, use your grappling hook and portals to get the fastest time! Set in a gorgeous neon world. For fans of Mirror's Edge, Beat Saber and CS:GO Surfing. You’re a parkouring astronaut in a retro-neon dreamlike world hurling trough the vastness of space in order to get the last slice of pizza. Perfect for speedruning fans and casual gamers too. Use environmental elements and tools to keep your momentum up and get to the pizza as fast as you can. Features Challenging Campaign with unique fast paced gameplay Use environmental elements like portals, walls, jump pads, speed pads and more Thirty fun levels that will test your abilities and reflexes Mesmerizing synthwave soundtrack Global leaderboard Official Soundtrack will be made available for download soon.

rows.name: Cards of the Dreaming Dragons
rows.short_description: How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family. Figure out what they are thinking and deceive them to win. Play with 3-8 players.
rows.description_html: How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family and tests your understanding of how they think. In this world of fantasy, you must figure out what dreams other people had and accumulate more points than any other in order to win. This is an amazing experience with friends, because you want to figure out what they are thinking, all while trying to win. It’s a game of trust, but also of deceit and with its fair share of challenges. How do you play Cards of the Dreaming Dragons? Each turn, a player is assigned the role of the 'dreaming dragon'. The dreaming dragon selects a single card from their hand. This becomes their 'dream'. They will provide a phrase which describes their dream. Then each other player selects a card from their hand which best matches the phrase given by the dreaming dragon. Once all players have selected a card, each player (except the 'dreaming dragon') will guess the 'dream' from all the cards. How do you win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons? If all players correctly guess the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points. If no player correctly guesses the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points. If at least 1 player, but not all players, correctly guess the dream, then the 'dreaming dragon' and any player which correctly guessed scores 3 points. If a player guesses a card that is not the 'dream', then the player who put down that card scores 1 point. Once all points are scored, this ends the turn and the next player takes the role of the 'dreaming dragon'. In order to win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons, you will need to reach the end of the game board first. Each point you receive will allow you to move upward on the game board. You are represented by a cute dragon on the board as you move through this fantasy world until the end, trying to win and surpass the enemies. Intense, exciting card game and board game experience Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is an exciting combination between a multiplayer board game, card game and fantasy tabletop. It’s also an immersive multiplayer game to play with the entire family or friends. It adds a lot of competition, fun, excitement and it also encourages you to strategize in order to win. Test out your skills, strategize and see if you have what it takes to defeat your friends and become the ultimate dragon!

rows.name: Battle of the Four Towers
rows.short_description: Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points, but if they defend they lose nothing.
rows.description_html: Four Towers have long been at war. For centuries the leaders of the towers were unable to conclude their petty fighting. No matter how often they were attacked, a strong defence always matched it. Until history erased it. Events were rewritten and scrapped from books as people turned their battle into a ‘sport’. The rich would gamble their money as the poor only hoped to win the grand prize. Teams would enter and leave as enemies. Alliances between Towers were formed, only for friendships to end. The power of money convinced anyone. Gameplay Battle of the Four Towers is an online 1v1v1v1 game best played with friends. Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points (LP), but if they defend they lose nothing. Each action takes 1 LP, so plan accordingly. Battle of the Four Towers is in early access. Over the next few months, this game will feature many updates to add to its few features. At the moment, this game has the bare minimum. It is best to play games with your friends, but there are plans to continue development to add more features and fix bugs.

rows.name: Word Crystal
rows.short_description: A daily word guessing game with four linked words of five letters apiece.
rows.description_html: GAMEPLAY : Word Crystal is a word guessing game. You get six tries to guess four five letter words that share the same first and last letters. The puzzle changes daily. The goal of Word Crystal is to improve upon the aesthetics and gameplay of other word guessing games. It is designed to be a relaxing, casual, yet complex puzzle. Give it a shot and see if you can make the crystal glow in as few guesses as possible! Currently, you can record your progress in the daily game for sharing as shown here: FEATURES 6 Letter Word Guessing Shining crystal that reflects your guess results Shareable video showing how quickly and easily you solved today's puzzle

rows.name: Desaturation Point
rows.short_description: A Strategic Squad-Based Horror Game in which players navigate across arctic labyrinths overrun by freakishly colorful monstrosities in this 'Lovecraft-on-LSD' experience.
rows.description_html: Desaturation Point is a student game developed by seniors from the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering Program. Join our Playtesting Discord and look out for Devlogs on our website for more information about development. ❄ ❄ ❄ It’s winter at Arctic Research Station Delta. The last planes have left for the season, stranding the station’s inhabitants alone in the dark polar months. At 0835 hours, three of the station’s researchers return from a routine surveying trip to find the base in ruins. Something terrible happened, and our three intrepid explorers are determined to find out what… Navigate the twisted halls of the once-bustling Station Delta for clues. Normal environments dissolve into the freakishly colorful as you delve deeper into the base for answers as to what happened. Avoid roaming psychedelic entities as you investigate the base. Will you freeze up in a tricky spot and hope the creature doesn't hear you, or run for your life? Make chilling decisions with your limited resources. Your party is limited, but your options may be less so when you've been cornered by a monster. You decide who will escape with their lives. ❄ ❄ ❄ Submit your arctic research! Join our Discord or check out our Community Forum to let us know your findings after playing Desaturation Point. Mission control appreciates your contributions!

rows.name: Where Are My Mittens
rows.short_description: A lost kitty. A dangerous environment. It's snowing. A cute indie platformer about a boy named Jason looking for a kitty named Mittens. Requires a standard qwerty keyboard and mouse. Compatible with MacOS and Windows.
rows.description_html: A lost kitty. A dangerous environment. It's snowing. Where Are My Mittens is a 2D pixelart platformer about trying to find Mittens, a kitty that has been separated from their owner. Play through 30 unseparated rooms of platforming and traversal using a unique dash ability constrained to dash crystals meticulously placed in rooms. Playtime: ~20 mins Desktop-Only , requires QWERTY keyboard and mouse .

rows.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby
rows.short_description: Experience Vampire: The Masquerade in a new way through this isometric cRPG. Change perspectives as you travel through the Heartless Club as a Human and a Vampire. Roll the dice, take your choices, and embrace the night in this narrative prologue.
rows.description_html: Step into the night as Zak Riley and Diane , mortal and Kindred, as their fates intertwine in an ominous plot involving a weakened Camarilla, the vampiric sect that wants to remain hidden, and a rising Sabbat, the fanatical group that sees humanity as cattle. Meet dozens of characters , venture deep into the shadows and see the world through the eyes of both mortal and vampire , as you explore the Heartless Club. Take your chances with the dice, face the consequences of your actions, and embrace the duality of Humanity and the Beast in this story rich cRPG set in the World of Darkness . Covering just the prologue of the story, with well over an hour and a half of gameplay and several different endings, Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby was created in less than a month in celebration of the Vampire: The Masquerade Jam . Features - Use your vampiric Disciplines (powers) to influence the world. Either by supernatural strength, sinister charm or sheer cunning, take your place in vampire society. - Semi-open locations with several ways to approach every situation. Leave no stone unturned. - A detective story embedded in a personal horror setting: heed the call of the Beast, or cling to your Humanity. - Experience the rule system of Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition like never before; a seamless transition between pen & paper and cRPG.

rows.name: CLOUDED VR
rows.short_description: Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday at the Cloud Hotel. This VR experience is a satirical commentary on our relationship with the virtual world through personal devices.
rows.description_html: Our personal devices are so embedded in our everyday lives that it has become an extension of the body. It is the entrance to a world of seemingly no limitations; always and everywhere connected to the cloud and therefore to each other. A blessing and a curse. The utopian online spaces once imagined were optimized into money machines reinforcing anything that gains attention, reflecting a reality of extremes. The virtual online space exploits our feelings through social media and advertising. This experience lightheartedly investigates how we should design future online spaces. In an attempt to escape reality, U, a user, wants to experience a relaxing stay at the virtual cloud hotel, a perfect stepping stone before one transcends to the Cloud, technological nirvana. Living in a digital world, U strives to satisfy their inner pressure to perform and reach the status they think they deserve. Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday in the Cloud Hotel. In this abstract narrative experience, it is up to you to figure out the rules of the world while your attention is diverted. CLOUDED VR was created as an interactive offbeat VR snack of about 15min. by Uni_verse studio in collaboration with Antfood for RGBXYZ digital art gallery. Original idea by Vincent Boon & Enzo Soubra.

rows.name: Tuwas vs MUDA
rows.short_description: Real-time economic simulator of an up-and-coming company. Earn profits by distributing the orders to the machines as efficiently as possible. Expand the machine park to be able to accept more and more complex orders.
rows.description_html: In this business simulation, you take over the management of a small business and try to increase productivity by avoiding MUDA. Muda (無駄) is the Japanese word for meaningless activity. It is defined as '...any human activity that consumes resources but produces no value.' - Wallace J. Hopp In this game, MUDA is represented by the little colorful monsters that sit in the factory and do unproductive nonsense. Productivity is represented by clever squirrels 'Tuwas' (German for 'DoSomething'). They are always productive and always work hard. The more efficiently the operation is managed, the more Tuwas work in the hall. With bad management, MUDAs are everywhere and waste valuable working time. Other companies send you inquiries for which you calculate offers with a suitable price. Always remember to stay profitable. Some of the inquiries are initially not lucrative and would be a financial loss for you. So go to your office to negotiate directly with the customer and secure a profit for yourself. If the companies accept your offers, the planning of the production begins. Strategically distribute the orders to your machines. With clever planning, you can process many orders at the same time and still on schedule. If your financial resources allow, you can rent more machines, which will make it easier for you to distribute the work in the short term. However, more machines cost more money and require more employees, which leads to higher expenses. If, on the other hand, you plan cleverly, a few machines are sufficient to meet the delivery dates. If you do not meet a delivery date, the customer is not willing to pay the full price, which has a negative effect on your sales and thus also on your profit. All machines must be serviced regularly, which inevitably causes downtime. If the maintenance of a machine is not carried out regularly, this can lead to defects. Repairing a defect always takes longer than maintenance. It is therefore worth scheduling maintenance. All of these factors above must be carefully considered when planning business operations so that your company does not go bankrupt. Can you still remain profitable despite the many orders and the higher turnover? Unlock the infoBoard planning board, which can help you with planning through automation. This gives you a constant overview of your machines, employees and orders. Backward scheduling means that you always meet your delivery dates and get the agreed price. infoBoard planning board helps you to reduce the costs of your company and thereby increase profits.

rows.name: OUTLANDER
rows.short_description: Outlander is a blocky platformer game that is fun for all ages.
rows.description_html: Outlander is a blocky platformer game that is fun for all ages. You start on a dark planet without any tools or items. As you explore you gather materials and other objects and you build new or better things in the workshop. You can build a simple house with lights. Even electric lights that you connect via wires to a battery. Lights are very important in Outlander because the dark planet has lifeforms that can kill you instantly on contact! You only have one life, but don't worry, the Save button is only a click away. Remember to use it often. If you get killed it loads the last saved state. Once you completely explore the world it gives you the ability to move to another world. And then to another and another! Each world has something unique and interesting so you'll never get bored. And if you unlock all worlds we'll give you a Creative mode to unleash your creativity. It is still in experimental stage but it already is serious fun :) Outlander is a very new project and will get better with FREQUENT UPDATES. We are determined to make it one of the best games. Have fun!

rows.name: FUCK PUTIN
rows.short_description: In February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine. This event shocked the whole world. Unjustified aggression must be condemned, and the president of Russia, Vladimir Putin - punished.
rows.description_html: In FUCK PUTIN your task is to torture Vladimir Putin and get as many points as possible using a wide variety of blocks and weapons. GAMEPLAY In the game you can build your own torture constructions, create an infinite number of Putins and inflict suffering on him with firearms and white weapons, for which you receive points. LEADERBOARD All the points earned in the game are added up and then recorded in the global leaderboard. Perhaps it is YOU who will find yourself at the top of it! PHOTO MODE You can stop the game at any time using the advanced photo mode to take the perfect shot and share it with the community. STEAM WORKSHOP The game has support for Steam Workshop. Download maps created by the community or add your own creations.

rows.name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log5
rows.short_description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure
rows.description_html: 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log5' (Play time : 30 minutes) This is a continuation of 'The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child -Log4'. Start with Log1. Deployment of Log5: 'Proof of Sad Truth' Clionidae and Coco escaped from the captivity of a crazy old man. Coco that came from the sea. The secret of that surprise! The outer shell of something I was riding when Coco was washed ashore. The mystery can be solved?! 'Clione' whose taser was crushed by an old man. And now, Ankh attacks 'Clione'!！ What is the truth that can be glimpsed from the series of actions of the old man? !! And Clione sings... Sadly... Why...?! Two silent wanderers 6 full chapters A game of exploration and adventure A lost child, drifting in an odd husk, lands at a mysterious structure. Clione, a manufactured doll you encounter. You are Clione. Your purpose? Protect this lost child. What awaits you at the top of the slowly sinking structure? What is a 'Sinking Structure'? What is the true identity of 'Clione'? Where did the 'Lost Child' come from? Major features You can play with the keyboard or controller. Actions include 'running', 'walking', 'jumping', 'climbing', etc., and you only have to press a button depending on the situation. When walking with the controller, tilt the stick a little. Operate some machine, investigate, and get information from the people you meet. Lost child are at risk during their actions. At this time, if you want to move the lost child, you can approach the lost child and 'hold hands', and you can move together. When a lost child comes into contact with water, a mysterious creature called ankh may appear and be attacked. Clione's weapon is Taser only. You will be able to fire after charging. Aim with the Shift key or the left trigger. Fire with the Space key or the A button. When locked on, the aim will turn red and the taser bullet will be able to track. It continues from Log1 to Log6. ------------------------------- Recall Coco's mother's apron. Is this also a clue? Current time? Let's go back in time. Why do you sing? Who wore this shirt? Who and who are in the picture?

rows.short_description: It will test your nerves and take you to the extremes offroad dirt bike racing capabilities
rows.description_html: Dirt Bike Mini Racer – Fun and Exciting Racing for Everyone Get ready for an  action-packed racing adventure  that’s fun for players of all ages!  Dirt Bike Mini Racer  combines vibrant visuals, simple controls, and thrilling gameplay to deliver an engaging and accessible racing experience. Whether you're pulling off stunts, unlocking cool vehicles, or using dynamic special powers, this game guarantees hours of fast-paced fun in a colorful and lively world. Why You’ll Love Dirt Bike Mini Racer Easy-to-Learn Controls : Simple three-button gameplay (Jump, Brake, Drop Powers) makes it easy for anyone to pick up and play. Bright and Playful Graphics : Vibrant 3D visuals and fun themes create an enjoyable and immersive environment. Quick Download : Small game size ensures fast installation, perfect for devices with limited storage. Smooth Gameplay : Lag-free performance keeps the racing action uninterrupted and exciting. Daily Rewards : Earn bonuses for logging in daily, keeping the excitement alive every time you play. Power Upgrades : Non-intrusive monetization through coins enhances your experience without frustration. Exciting Special Powers Unleash a variety of  fun and dynamic powers  to dominate the race: Nitro Boost : Speed up and leave opponents behind. Rocket Launch : Attack the nearest racer with a homing rocket. Bullet Fire : Slow down opponents with rapid projectiles. Fly for 5 Seconds : Soar above obstacles and avoid collisions. Shield : Protect yourself from attacks with a temporary barrier. Touch to Kill Armor : Eliminate opponents on contact. Magnet Collect : Attract nearby collectibles for extra rewards. Invisibility Cloak : Become invisible and immune to attacks. Freeze Ray : Temporarily freeze opponents in their tracks. Time Warp : Slow down everyone else while you race ahead. Unlock Cool Vehicles Race with a variety of  fun and unique vehicles , including: Dirt Bikes Scooters F1 Cars Tanks Semi Trucks Each vehicle offers a unique racing experience, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. What Makes Dirt Bike Mini Racer Unique? Accessible for All Ages : Simple controls and vibrant visuals make it enjoyable for everyone. Realistic but Fun Physics : Easy-to-master controls paired with exciting stunts and tricks. Engaging Features : Daily rewards, power-ups, and vehicle customization keep you coming back for more. Download Dirt Bike Mini Racer Today! Whether you're a casual gamer or a racing enthusiast,  Dirt Bike Mini Racer  offers a perfect blend of simplicity, excitement, and creativity. With its  vibrant visuals ,  dynamic powers , and  variety of vehicles , this game guarantees hours of fun for players of all ages. Start your engines and join the race today! 🏁

rows.name: VR TRIBES
rows.short_description: Step into the fast-paced world of VR Tribes as a swift non-VR player, teaming up with others to face off against the powerful VR player, the mighty 'Meteor.' Use your unique abilities and strategic moves to keep the VR player on their toes. Can you and your friends bring down the Meteor?
rows.description_html: This is the 'pc-only' edition! You need one player in VR to play the game! To get full access to the game and play as VR you need the DLC: VR TRIBES - THE VR EDITION! Challenge VR players in this epic VR vs non-VR multiplayer showdown! Step into the fast-paced world of VR Tribes as a swift non-VR player, teaming up with others to face off against the powerful VR player, the mighty 'Meteor.' Use your unique abilities and strategic moves to keep the VR player on their toes. Can you and your friends bring down the Meteor? Features 4 immersive maps for a varied and exciting battle experience Dynamic multiplayer modes: 3 vs 1 | 2 vs 1 | 1 vs 1 Cross-platform action: Compete against VR players on Steam or Meta Quest (coming soon), and join friends from your PC, tablet, or phone - ideal for couch parties or connecting worldwide! As a non-VR player Outsmart the VR player with special abilities like cloning, hiding and shielding Fly around using a jetpack for swift and evasive maneuvers Launch powerful cannon attacks to knock the VR player off their position The VR Player Will face you from their 360° mode in stunning miniature worlds Can grab, punch and throw you as non-VR players, adding a unique VR twist to the battle Is able to unlock a powerful arsenal of tools, including guns and laser eyes Important Notes VR Tribes requires an internet connection and at least one other player For the best experience on tablets or phones, we recommend using an additional gamepad This is the 'pc-only' edition! You’ll need at least one player in VR to play the game! To get full access to the game and play as the VR player, you’ll need VR TRIBES and the DLC: VR TRIBES - THE VR EDITION (available on Steam) or VR TRIBES on the Meta Quest Store (coming soon) We are still in Early Access! The full release is planned for early 2025. If you have any questions, suggestions, bug reports, or feedback - or just want to hang out with other players - join our Discord community!
