rows.name: Animals Collision
rows.short_description: Animals Collision is a party game. Play as humanoid animal and fight for your victory: solo or online up to 4 players. There is no space for other animals on the arena!
rows.description_html: Special Offer About the Game Animals Collision is a party game for up to 4 human (online) or computer-controlled players. The game features several different levels in which the goal is to defeat opponents. The last player standing wins the round and the first player to win a set number of rounds wins the game. The main mode of play is Free for All, but online is possible in 2v2 teams. FEATURES Different levels with different crazy things happening. Sheep with rockets, turtles with chainsaws, flying penguins... Falling boxes from the sky with a reward or not, everything can change very quickly in your favor or harm. Apart from that, you have to show your fighting skills on the arena against different opponents. Humanoid animal characters with unique look, attacks and skills. Choose between: Cat, Lizard, Bear, Rabbit, Ram, Wolf, Panda, Raccoon, Capybara, Tiger. AI Bots as bonus in addition. Initially, the game was planned to be played online only, but bots were added. They are not very smart, but it's better than nothing. This will allow you to play offline (Single player mode) and no need to connect in online game rooms. You can choose versus how many bots to play: 1, 2 or 3. Also keep in mind that they will all attack only you (yes, they are friends) - this can be a challenge that will be definitely a lot of fun. Game Modes: Single player, Lan or Online up to 4 players. Also available game types are: Free for All or 2v2 teams (online). This is 'Free To Play' game. If you are worried that there will be no one to play with... you can invite your friends and play with them. It's better than AI bots in Single player mode (and probably more fun). It's not 'Pay To Win' game. Only additional content as DLC (Maps, Characters, Skins). Even if you don't have a DLC content for this game, you can play online on DLC maps, if the host player has them and chooses them. Partial Controller Support: Xbox 360, Xbox One (native support) or PS3, PS4 (with SCPDS3, DS4Windows, XOutput, x360ce). Integration of some Steam features such as: Achievements, Leaderboards, Cloud. Supported languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified). NOTE: This 'Free To Play' version of the game contains the following game content - Maps: Forest 1, Forest 2, Forest 3, Forest 4, Forest 5, Forest 6, Tournament 1 and Tournament 4 - Characters: Cat, Cat 2, Lizard, Lizard 2 and Panda. Additional game content can be found as paid DLC.

rows.name: Galaxy Life
rows.short_description: The universe is full of Starlings, tiny orange aliens that want to take over the galaxy. Create your own space colony, fight epic battles and discover new planets. Train your soldiers, develop your technology and create unimaginable gadgets. Enjoy this huge social game with friends!
rows.description_html: Impressive planets, strange creatures, and dangers can be found in Galaxy Life! In this online game you steer your colony to victory! Your little friends may be cute and sweet, but space is full of all sorts of threats. Explore the world of Galaxy Life, build a space colony, attack enemies, grab items and rule the universe. Galaxy Life is full of interesting planets and characters. You'd be surprised how big Galaxy Life is! In this free to play MMO strategy game that mixes traditional easy-to-play casual gameplay mechanics with touches of more traditional genres and features like tower defense, RTS, or several competitive PvP features in a persistent on-line Galaxy. You play together with others or your friends and take on evil, so gather your friends to fight evil in this Galaxy Life social game! Features: + Persistent Galaxy on war with players from all over the world! + Challenge friends or foes in battles for loot and control over the Galaxy! + Strategically Secure your colonies from the attacks of rivals and even friends with your defense towers, mines, bunkers full of units, walls, energy shields, traps and more! + Conquer intriguing and wonderfully weird new worlds to expand your empire! + Form a galactic Alliance with other players and wage epic Alliance Wars together against the other ones! + Bet against other people by fighting them in Rival Battles! + Climb the weekly, monthly or all time player leader boards to show your friends and the entire world what your Starlings are made of! + Seasonal events like the Halloween or Doomsday! + Periodical game updates with new features, content and fixes! + Train and upgrade new troops or resource buildings! + Craft powerful Special Attacks or units with unique collectables! + Multiple ways to cooperate with friends helping them! + Save your Starlings from the grip of the evil Firebit!

rows.name: Harmony Overture
rows.short_description: When the world has gone silent, music finds a way. But when there is harmony there is discord. Interact, Fight, Dash, and Dodge your way through the dungeons filled with discourse and calamity to bring harmony back to your utopia.
rows.description_html: In Harmony Overture, there was once a world that was split into two half's, the top half known as Caesura and the bottom half known as Legato. Caesura has banned all music while Legato stayed alive by thriving on music. However the people of Caesura didn't enjoy that fact and are trying their very best to stop Legato from spreading their music. Play as Melody, the leader of a band known as Forte, fight back against monster, bandits, and the troops of Caesura and rise to the top and bring back music and harmony to the entire world! Features DELVE THROUGH THE DUNGEONS OF THE UTOPIC UNDERGROUND • Explore a bullet hell game of different harmonies and chords where music is your weapon and soul. • Interact, Fight, Dash, and Dodge your enemies attacks in this top-down 2D dungeon environments • Use a variety of different instrumental weapons that can be found by interacting with the environment!. • Experience unique story and dialogue with surreal voice Make your voice and music be heard in Harmony Overture

rows.name: Darold The Doomer: Psychedelic Lucid Dreams
rows.short_description: The weird and somewhat unsettling trip of a doomer
rows.description_html: In Darold The Doomer: Psychedelic Lucid Dreams, you play as Darold Wichstock, a man who tries to cheer himself up by taking psychedelics and ends up ultimately failing by crashing his car and falling into a coma. However, with the psychedelics still active in his body, Darold finds himself in some sort of psychedelic dream world with bizarre entities. FEATURES: -Unique character interactions -Bizarre character designs -Composite video output filter -Unique battle songs tied to characters -Things that don't make sense

rows.name: Farlight 84
rows.short_description: Hey Lightcatchers! Are you ready for massive 60-player shootouts? Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in Farlight 84!
rows.description_html: Hey Lightcatchers! Are you ready for massive 60-player shootouts? Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in Farlight 84! Team up with two squadmates and parkour your way through towering cityscapes as you hunt down your enemies. Play as uniquely skilled heroes, tame your Buddy pets, and unlock hundreds of tactical combos to outsmart your opponents. With unlimited respawns, you're free to charge into the fray, break armor, and go all-out without fear! If you've got the guts, you've got the power to forge your own path to victory! Farlight 84 Season 1 begins October 16! With new maps, new heroes, new Buddies and new weapons... it's a whole new battlefield. Lightcatchers, get ready for battle! [Fast-Paced Action in an Urban Jungle] Prepare to drop into a 60-player battlefield that pushes every limit! From open fields to vertical cities, team up and let the bullets fly! Run, climb, and fight your way to victory! Loot gear in tight alleyways, wall-run and slide between rooftops, zipline across bridges to reach the high ground, or launch across the map in a giant Rat Cannon. With layered, dynamic map design, every battle delivers endless exciting moments. [Get Straight Into the Action With One-Tap Looting] Don't struggle with cumbersome controls. Become a master looter in an instant! When the battlefield turns hot, reaction speed is crucial. Enemy got the drop on you while you were trying to tweak your loadout? Not in Farlight 84! With the touch of a button, you can equip the best weapons and mods for an instant upgrade! Whether it's shotgun chokes or long-distance sniper scopes, everything gets equipped automatically, so you can focus on what counts—take aim, fire, and win! [No Penalty for Newbies—Respawn and Hit Back Harder] Knocked out? Nope, you're just getting started! It's not just about pulling the trigger—you'll need to think on your feet and adapt on the fly. But if you make a mistake, your squad's got your six. Even if you go down, you'll be back in action in seconds and ready to strike back! No need to sit on the sidelines or shrink away from the fight—Even new players can become relentless battle machines! [Countless Combinations of Hero and Pet Skills] Each hero brings something different. So get ready to upgrade and expand your tactical playbook! Choose your moment, unleash your skills, and nail that kill! And don't forget your Buddies—these tactical pets show up randomly, and they're game-changers! They can summon storms, shift zones, disguise the terrain, steal items while invisible... They're unpredictable, powerful, and always bring surprises to the fight! Try combining your weapons, heroes, and Buddies in different ways, and you'll discover dozens of new ways to win! There's no one way to win. Every shot opens up new possibilities! Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in Farlight 84! New season starts December 25!

rows.name: Check it Out!
rows.short_description: Ever dreamt of working a cash register with no pay or real-life customer interaction? Look no further! This simulation game brings a fresh-take to the notoriously dull tasks of customer service, introducing you to a cast of wacky characters and the baggage they carry.
rows.description_html: Welcome to your first day on the job! You’re a cashier trying to run the register, prevent robberies, and maintain good relations with your customers. Avoid selling damaged or expired items to shoppers as you deal with the drama of their personal lives, all while dodging the looming threat of getting fired. This check all your boxes? Download Check it Out! now, a 2.5D simulation game from USC’s Open Alpha.

rows.name: Corleone Online
rows.short_description: Corleone Online is a MMORPG 2D game full of guns!
rows.description_html: Corleone Online is a cross platform MMORPG set in an open modern day organized crime world. » WRITE YOUR STORY « Are you ready to explore the world and embark on a risky journey in conquering the gang filled streets of Corleone as your own! Or seeking notoriety and fame in a more competitive environment? Whether you’re keen on controlling the streets as your own or basking in the spotlight of infamy, the world is yours to conquer and you have a story to write! » CROSS-PLATFORM « Corleone Online is a fully cross-platform MMORPG experience. Whether you prefer PC or Mobile, one account is shared across all. » FULL PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION « • Featuring the ability to upload and use your own personal created graphics in-game • Head , Hat and Body Uploads: Following our character templates, you are able to create and fully customize your own player as you wish and have the option to upload the finished masterpiece to the server to use and show off! » GUNS … GUNS and EVEN MORE GUNS « Dozens of different weapons at your disposal to chose from, you’ll need a few to protect yourself and your turf. » COMMUNITY RAN ECONOMY « • From basic currency to actual weapons and item’s. Nearly every item in-game is obtainable from other online players. • Buy, Sell and Trade and the click of a button! and be sure not to miss out on Staff hosted Auctions! You ALWAYS will want to be there. » INTENSE COMBAT « • Test yourself against other players in various, rewarding solo to small or large scale PVP battles! • Unique tactics and strategies will be needed to ultimately put your skills to the test, will you be dominant in your efforts? This game requires an internet connection.

rows.name: Rat Royal
rows.short_description: Rat Royal is an exhilarating, asymmetrical multiplayer game! Embark on thrilling adventures as cunning rats, tasked with unleashing chaos, or take on the role of an exterminator on a mission to eradicate them. With unique mechanics and fast-paced gameplay, every game is full of strategy and tension.
rows.description_html: Rat Royal – The Ultimate Asymmetrical Battle for Survival! Prepare for chaos in Rat Royal , an intense asymmetrical multiplayer game (2-8 players) where sneaky rodents go head-to-head against relentless exterminators. Whether you're outsmarting your enemies as a crafty rat or hunting down pests as a ruthless exterminator, every match is a thrilling fight for survival! 🐭 Play as the Rats – Small, Fast, and Clever! As a rat, your mission is to steal valuable objects, sabotage key locations , and avoid being caught at all costs. Use speed and agility to navigate the environment and complete your objectives before time runs out! 🔹 Key Abilities: Attack : Fight back against exterminators if you’re cornered! Eat Cheese : Randomly spawned cheese can restore your health. Carry Stolen Items : Pick up and transport objects to complete missions. Use Mouse Holes : Quickly escape by squeezing through mouse holes to access hidden paths. But beware—one wrong move, and you might find yourself trapped, poisoned, or gassed! ☠️ Play as the Exterminators – Hunt Down the Rats! As an exterminator, your job is to eliminate the rats and prevent them from causing destruction . With an arsenal of deadly tools, you must track them down, outthink them, and wipe them out before they complete their objectives. 🔹 Key Abilities: Attack : Strike down rats before they escape. Set Traps : Place mouse traps in key locations to catch unsuspecting rodents. Poison Cheese : Lure rats in with baited food that will drain their health. Gas Mouse Holes : If a rat hides in a mouse hole, flush it out—or kill it instantly! Carry & Throw Objects : Use the environment to your advantage by throwing objects at rats. Victory belongs to those who can outsmart and outmaneuver their opponents. Will you let the rats slip through your fingers, or will you reign as the ultimate exterminator? 🏚️ Explore Dynamic Maps with Unique Strategies! Each match takes place in a highly interactive environment, requiring players to think fast and adapt. Warehouse 🏭 – A massive industrial storage facility full of obstacles, hiding spots, and sneaky shortcuts. House 🏠 – A cozy home turned battleground, where every room presents new dangers and opportunities. ⚔️ Fast-Paced Action with Strategic Depth! Asymmetrical Multiplayer : Two completely different playstyles create unpredictable matches. High Replayability : Every round is different thanks to dynamic gameplay and player choices. Interactive Objects : Pick up, throw, and use objects to gain the upper hand. Teamwork & Strategy : Communication and coordination are key to victory! Will you outwit the exterminators and complete your mission as a cunning rat, or will you crush the infestation and claim victory as a relentless hunter? The battle for survival begins now! 🔥🐭🔨

rows.name: Lost Lives
rows.short_description: Lost Lives is a multiplayer 2D shooter with RPG elements, in which you will find yourself in the conditions of post-Soviet devastation. As you play, you will have to fight other players and local factions, as well as find and sell loot. Choose your equipment wisely and defeat your enemies!
rows.description_html: Events take place in the 2000s. After the collapse of the USSR, all structures ceased to function, and people were unable to unite into smaller states and got stuck in banditry and looting. Those who still managed to survive organized small armed groups and established their own orders, norms and morals. In addition, another misfortune came to the world - a shortage of various resources around the world, because of which the territory of the former union, rich in all kinds of benefits, began to attract people from all over the world. Arm yourself to your taste – Choose from a variety of weapons from both NATO and Warsaw Pact arsenals. Equip body armor, helmets, and backpacks to customize your loadout. Dynamic PvE and PvP action – Play against other players in PvP or challenge yourself in PvE encounters. AI opponents and bosses – Encounter AI-controlled enemies, including occasional bosses, providing tactical challenges and variety. Varied matches – Each game session can feature randomized elements, including loot, AI behavior, and environmental conditions, ensuring every run feels fresh and challenging. Find and trade loot – Explore locations to gather items, earn in-game currency, and purchase gear from the store. Character customization – Unlock and equip clothing and cosmetic options as you progress. Balanced gameplay, no aggressive monetization – Every player has a fair chance; no pay-to-win gear or battle passes. Day/night cycle and weather – Dynamic conditions influence gameplay, requiring tactical adaptation. Voice chat – Communicate with nearby players, allies, or enemies for coordination or deception.

rows.name: Oh Sheep!: Baaaa
rows.short_description: Embark on the fantastic world of Oh Sheep!, a slapstick cartoon-style action game where you'll encounter crazy enemies. Sheep will be your salvation.
rows.description_html: THIS IS A DEMO STORY Placidie, a young woman in her twenties, is living in a small settlement where its inhabitants harvest and breed the local fauna. But a purple sheep will have changed Placidie's life forever. Transported to a place with more than exotic life, returning to her family will be her sole purpose. With the help of a mysterious shepherd's staff's abilities, she will obtain the support of sheep who will be her comrades, but above all, her weapons to navigate and face the dangers of this insane world. GAME Fight through a crazy, colorful universe, accentuated by comics visuals effects and delirious animals. Use your herd of sheep to fight enemies by either throwing them or make them charge. Don't forget that you can use them to improve your movements. Experience a story rich in action and visuals, mixing humor and intrigue. STUDIO COATS We're French students at ETPA Rennes who made this game as a study project for our Bachelor. We're releasing this DEMO as there are several reasons for this : This would be our first game published on Steam. It's a good way to show our skills. Getting feedback and knowing if the game brings interest will mean of lot for us!

Getting feedback and knowing if the game brings interest will mean of lot for us!

rows.name: Eragon's Tale
rows.short_description: Brave through the darkness in his dreams. Or die trying.
rows.description_html: Eragon's Tale is a horror adventure game that follows the story of Eragon, a young lad of a noble family. During the party celebrating the passing of the family elder, an artifact of great value is stolen. Soon after, Eragon starts seeing nightmares, and somehow these two events are intertwined... During the game, you will travel through the dreamland, and meanwhile, in the real world, foul deeds are afoot. Find clues and important items to get through the puzzles the dreams will present to you. There are dark creatures roaming in the dreamland, so you will have to take care not to get caught by them! Features Story-driven horror adventure Point & Click interactions Retro pixel art graphics Puzzles to complete

Use your wand to cast spells to plant, water, and harvest flowers and plants in your garden during the day. rows.name: Pirate Souls
rows.short_description: A 2D Online RPG where you can become the most wanted pirate, the strongest bounty hunter or even the highest-ranking Marine! Customize your character to be uniquely yours, level up and find treasures. Start your adventure in the world of Pirate Souls now!
rows.description_html: Retro-style Pirate MMORPG with large focus on community and PvP Free-to-play forever! Become a Sailor in a harsh sea of thieves and heroes! Start off as a sailor and choose to join the Navy or become a Pirate! Become scum of the sea, or become a hero in the eyes of the law. Things aren't black and white in the world of Pirate Souls. Open World PvP & Hardcore Game Design This may be a turn off for some, but Pirate Souls is a very hardcore game. So take this as a word of warning... Absolute freedom when it comes to PvP also means a bad time for some with a low tolerance for being killed for no reason. But for others, it's just another reason to get stronger! Deep Character Customization in the right places Choose your faction, join a crew and obtain a soul fruit power. Combined with thousands of equip-able items, no two seafarers will ever look or be the same. Pirate Souls is a game where you are encouraged to express yourself. Looking good doesn't cost you to lose fights.

rows.name: Rage Night
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic journey, conquer levels for prizes, recruit unique fighters, wield new weapons, and engage in online multiplayer. Customize your fighters and bet in esports arenas for added excitement and rewards!
rows.description_html: ENTER THE WORLD OF RAGE NIGHT! Step into the realm of RAGE NIGHT, where a captivating cosmic Fight Promoter has gathered an extraordinary ensemble of brawlers, warriors, and misfits hailing from distant corners of the galaxy. Brace yourself for an unparalleled extravaganza of Real Action Galactic Entertainment as they engage in the sector's most-watched martial arts tournament. In this electrifying showdown, combatants must sharpen their skills, unearthing the enigmatic secrets that unlock their untapped potential. Witness the emergence of new mystical abilities and witness their mastery over the deadliest weapons known to any world. Get ready to place your wagers and immerse yourself in the heart-pounding live and online spectacle as these intergalactic champions collide in the latest chapter of RAGE NIGHT! ■ Esports Wagering: Introducing Esports Wagering, an innovative platform that enables players to bet their coins against one another. This competitive betting system empowers players to double their coins upon victory, claiming the entire pot. ■ Leader Boards and Rewards Rage Night has introduced leaderboards for both Multiplayer Arena Mode and a separate leaderboard dedicated to Esport Wagering. The top 5 performers in each category stand to earn substantial rewards. With the leaderboard resetting weekly, every participant has a chance to compete and seize the rewards. ■ Engage in an exciting single-player campaign with a map-based progression system: Embark on an epic adventure with our brand new single-player campaign, where completing levels on the map unlocks exciting prizes. Immerse yourself in a captivating battles and conquer challenging quests to claim amazing rewards. ■ Discover an expanded arsenal of weapons, including cutting-edge gear and Express yourself with a wide range of new emotes: we've also introduced a wide array of new weapons and emotes in this version. Arm yourself with cutting-edge gear, from powerful swords to futuristic Weapons, and customize your gameplay like never before. Express yourself with an extensive selection of emotes, allowing you to communicate and celebrate your victories in style. ■ Competitive Online Multiplayer: RAGE NIGHT features a robust online multiplayer system, allowing players to compete against each other in real-time matches. Climb the ranks and become a top player on the global leaderboard. With matchmaking and dedicated servers, you'll always be able to find a fair and competitive match. ■ Customize, Train, Invite and Fight! RAGE NIGHT allows players to customize their fighters with unique weapons, flags, entrances, victory selections, and skins that can only be earned and not bought. Additionally, this game provides the opportunity for players to invite their friends for private real-time matches, as well as live in-game global leaderboard ranking stats. To ensure a fair match, the game allows both players to start from left to right in their own screens. ■ Easy for First-timers: Everyone is a Champion! Beginner-friendly intuitive controls allow players of all skill levels to compete. With a Single-Player Mode and one-button Special Moves, you control the fight. ■ Customizes your Fighters: Customize your fighters , Weapons, Grand Entrances and Celebrations, over-the-top Taunts and shameless Victory celebrations. You run the show! ■ Fully-featured Multiplayer online modes: Supported with a robust netcode which offers a stable and smooth online and Real-Time Multiplayer experience. Players can aim to top the Global leaderboards in ranked matches, or invite friends for casual games. ■ Multi-Platform Cross-Play: Play your way on your Android devices or on other available platforms. Invite a friend or challenge another player across devices to battle it out in real-time PVP ranked matches to become RAGE NIGHT Champion. ■ Exciting Updates every season: Monthly Updates keep the fight going strong! More Fighters. More Content. More Fun!

rows.name: Who Is The Red Queen?
rows.short_description: Alice, Alice, the Red Queen is missing. The queen has been dismembered and Alice must find all her pieces. A horror-fantasy yuri visual novel filled with death, love, and forgotten memories.

Or, more specifically, to find the pieces of the dismembered queen whose body has been strewn across the land. ~35k words 3 major endings and plenty of dead ends 8 CGs with simple animations Accessibility options A CG gallery, a music room, and an achieved endings screen

rows.short_description: Bleeding Abyss is a chaotic, fast paced, overwhelming bullet hell game. Plan and manage your survival by investing your hard earned rewards into resources and unravel the secrets that lie in the underground. Do you have what it takes to escape?
rows.description_html: Your goal. Run and survive the onslaught of the Ayaards. Use your rewards to grow stronger, buy food and equipment. Travel from statue to statue and try to escape. What to expect. Chaotic exhilarating fast-paced combat. With a hint of careful planning. Multiple different enemies with unique movesets to conquer. Plentifull of bosses to catch you off guard. Level up, buy food, equipment and tools in order to conquer more ground. Find out the mysteries of the underground and help everyone escape. Easy to pick up. Hard to master. Provides a good challenge.

rows.short_description: Be ready to join epic multiplayer battles PVP or PVE. Create your team of heroes and improve them to annihilate your enemies and win battles. Discover also a unique and exciting progression system. Join the arena now!
rows.description_html: About This Game Be ready to join epic multiplayer battles PVP or PVE. Create your team of heroes and improve them to annihilate your enemies and win battles. Discover also a unique and exciting progression system. Join the arena now! PREPARING FOR BATTLE Before starting the fight, you must select 3 characters who will fight for you, they differ by their spells, their cards and their attack range. These differences allow you to create many associations between the characters and define your gameplay. THE BATTLE The goal is to eliminate all the enemy characters and the boss. When all the enemy characters are dead, the boss appears, your goal is to deal him the most damage to kill him. THE ITEMS The items allow you to increase the power of your characters, you get them after the battles or against gold from the store. Gold is obtained after the battles as a reward. You are limited to 6 items per character. You can increase many characteristics and create your gameplay. You can also improve items to make them even more powerful.

rows.name: BAWs Pharmacy
rows.short_description: BAW’s Pharmacy is a mobile time management and strategy game. Players manage a medical warehouse and sell products to hospitals and clinics. Customers will approach the sales counter and request a specific item for purchase.
rows.description_html: BAW’s Pharmacy is a mobile time management and strategy game. Players manage a medical warehouse and sell products to hospitals and clinics. Customers will approach the sales counter and request a specific item for purchase. With the increase in need due to COVID-19, players must move quick to select the right product! Correct choices result in currency allowing players to purchase additional stock and upgrades. Upgrades can help to keep customers happy and make your store more efficient! At the end of each workday, players review their data to determine which supplies are best to invest in using box and whisker plots. Choose carefully to ensure your store has what it needs to succeed! Directions for BaW’s Pharmacy Welcome to BaW’s Pharmacy, this document will give you a general guide on how to play the game. In this game you run a pharmacy that provides products from face masks to pain pills. Main Menu When you load up the game there will be a main menu where you will have to write your name or username and sign in. Once you write your username, press the Sign In button and then the Play button will become available. There will also be many other different buttons. Firstly, the Play button will take you into the main game and allow you to run the store and do your post daily box and whisker graphs. The How to Play button will take you to a screen that will explain how different aspects of the game work. The Options button will take you to a screen that allows you to change sounds and other options within the game. The Trivia button will put you through different box and whisker graph scenarios and allow you to practice there on them.   Main Game - Running the Store In the main game you will control the person behind the counter. As customers come into your store and approach the counter, they will have an image and a timer above their heads. The image depicts what item the customer is requesting. The orange image behind the image of the item will slowly disappear as a customer waits in line and for their item, this represents a customer’s patience. Patience will be important because if a customer’s patience runs out, they will get upset and leave the store, causing you to lose your sale. When a customer approaches and you want to make a sale to them, you need to tap on the icon above their head. When you tap on the icon the store inventory will open and you must then tap on the correct item and then confirm so that your pharmacist can go to the back of the store and grab the item. The pharmacist will return and give the item to the customer making a sale. You can use upgrades within the store too. There are several upgrades you can acquire and next to each upgrade there is a description telling you what it does. Then you can continue working until the end of the day is reached.   Main Game - End of Day Graph At the end of each day you will be taken to a screen that will show a box and whisker graph that is generated by your sales throughout the day. The data values that should appear on the bottom of the graph are scrambled on the right side of the screen and you will need to drag and drop them into the correct place to continue onto the next day. If you need a detailed walkthrough on box and whisker graphs it is recommended visiting the how to play or the tutorial. That is about it on the instructions for BaW’s Pharmacy! While in the game if more help is needed just visit the how to play, the trivia or the tutorial in game and these will explain again how to play BaW’s Pharmacy successfully.

rows.name: You Deserve a Seat at the Table
rows.short_description: You Deserve a Seat at the Table provides players with the right tools to excel in corporate environments. This 2D Puzzle game offers an exciting alternative to common dull approaches. Ordinary business concepts such as Critical Thinking and Problem Solving are taught through interactive mini-games.
rows.description_html: You Deserve a Seat at the Table provides players with the right tools to excel in corporate environments. This 2D Puzzle game offers an exciting alternative to common dull approaches. Ordinary business concepts such as Critical Thinking and Problem Solving are taught through interactive mini-games. Working your way up the corporate ladder can be tough, but it doesn’t have to be! With You Deserve A Seat, players can simulate a learning experience built to help them succeed. After arriving to their first day of work, players are led to the Board roam to learn tricks of the trade. They are given the option to select a Board Member and complete the corresponding puzzle. Each Board Member represents a concept and offers insight into becoming successful. Mini-games like dice stacking teaches players how to find creative solutions when unusual difficulties occur. Tips will trigger at the start of all mini-games and can applied to real world situations. From preparing for a first interview to building a solid rapport with your boss. These will be sure to come in handy across all office settings. How to Play There are three professional concepts to explore that teach valuable skills and values. Each concept serves as a level and has its own mini game for an interactive experience. At your discretion, levels can be selected and played in any order. All will include tips and a tutorial narrated by the 'Working Joe' character. Player Identification After the game has loaded, you are given the opportunity to enter your name before playing. There is no requirement on the length of name provided nor are nicknames prohibited. Level Selection Once you have finalized your preferred name on the previous screen. You will be introduced to the board room with its accompanying members. To select your desired level, hover over the mini game name attributed to the specified member. Before each mini game, there will be a randomly selected tip displayed on the game screen. Each tip will relate to the selected concept and provide more insight into professionalism. As one tip cannot encompass all experiences in the corporate world, there will be an assortment with every level selection. Mini Game Levels Creativity (Dice Stacking) Creativity in the workplace allows for collaboration and fresh new ideas that could be beneficial to the company. If you are faced with a problem that you are unable to solve, being creative can help you to be more flexible in your approach. You can examine all sides of the issue to gain inspiration and be innovative in your solution. This mini game helps to promote creativity by presenting you with a unique problem requiring experimentation. In learning to stack the dice, you are building up your creative skill through thinking outside of the box. 1. Click and drag to rotate the screen. 2. Use the scroll to zoom in and out. 3. Right click and hold to drag the dice. 4. Drag the dice onto another 5. Win this game by completing and building a full stack of dice Critical Thinking (Chess) Being able to think critically in the workplace shows that you are a valuable asset to the team and a potential leader. This skill helps you to focus more on details and take logical steps to diagnose problems. In fact, this could lead to finding errors and irregularities in your work resulting in a higher quality. Chess has proven to be beneficial in increasing intelligence, memory, and perspective. Regularly engaging in a game is not only useful in those areas but also in furthering your Critical Thinking. 1. Players tap on the chess pieces then tap on the desired square. 2. Each chess piece (both player and opponent) has health points. 3. Win this game by eliminating your opponent’s chess pieces. Problem Solving (Trivia) Another indicator of potential leadership is effectively solving complex problems within the workplace. This shows you are proactive in your approach and determined to get things done. In the long run, this could help to save time and money by making it easier for others to understand certain things. Trivia is an excellent way to exercise your problem-solving skills. This mini game is all about outsmarting your opponent through careful answer selection. You will navigate through an office building using your knowledge of office etiquette until you reach the top floor. 1. Use your phone to swipe in the direction that you’d like to move. 2. You can only move one tile at a time until chosen again. 3. When you land on an Enemy tile, a trivia question will appear on your screen 4. Tap the appropriate responses on the Trivia Screen to continue 5. When the correct response is chosen, you are able to continue moving through the level. 6. Win the game by making it to the 10th floor, representing a promotion.

Each concept serves as a level and has its own mini game for an interactive experience. At your discretion, levels can be selected and played in any order. All will include tips and a tutorial narrated by the 'Working Joe' character. Player Identification After the game has loaded, you are given the opportunity to enter your name before playing. There is no requirement on the length of name provided nor are nicknames prohibited. Level Selection Once you have finalized your preferred name on the previous screen. You will be introduced to the board room with its accompanying members. To select your desired level, hover over the mini game name attributed to the specified member. Before each mini game, there will be a randomly selected tip displayed on the game screen. Each tip will relate to the selected concept and provide more insight into professionalism. As one tip cannot encompass all experiences in the corporate world, there will be an assortment with every level selection. Mini Game Levels Creativity (Dice Stacking) Creativity in the workplace allows for collaboration and fresh new ideas that could be beneficial to the company. If you are faced with a problem that you are unable to solve, being creative can help you to be more flexible in your approach. You can examine all sides of the issue to gain inspiration and be innovative in your solution. This mini game helps to promote creativity by presenting you with a unique problem requiring experimentation. In learning to stack the dice, you are building up your creative skill through thinking outside of the box. 1. Click and drag to rotate the screen. 2. Use the scroll to zoom in and out. 3. Right click and hold to drag the dice. 4. Drag the dice onto another 5. Win this game by completing and building a full stack of dice Critical Thinking (Chess) Being able to think critically in the workplace shows that you are a valuable asset to the team and a potential leader. This skill helps you to focus more on details and take logical steps to diagnose problems. In fact, this could lead to finding errors and irregularities in your work resulting in a higher quality. Chess has proven to be beneficial in increasing intelligence, memory, and perspective. Regularly engaging in a game is not only useful in those areas but also in furthering your Critical Thinking. 1. Players tap on the chess pieces then tap on the desired square. 2. Each chess piece (both player and opponent) has health points. 3. Win this game by eliminating your opponent’s chess pieces. Problem Solving (Trivia) Another indicator of potential leadership is effectively solving complex problems within the workplace. This shows you are proactive in your approach and determined to get things done. In the long run, this could help to save time and money by making it easier for others to understand certain things. Trivia is an excellent way to exercise your problem-solving skills. This mini game is all about outsmarting your opponent through careful answer selection. You will navigate through an office building using your knowledge of office etiquette until you reach the top floor. 1. Use your phone to swipe in the direction that you’d like to move. 2. You can only move one tile at a time until chosen again. 3. When you land on an Enemy tile, a trivia question will appear on your screen 4. Tap the appropriate responses on the Trivia Screen to continue 5. When the correct response is chosen, you are able to continue moving through the level. 6. Win the game by making it to the 10th floor, representing a promotion.

rows.name: Local Paper Small Town
rows.short_description: Local Paper Small Town is a 2-player co-op puzzle game about spreading happiness around a quirky papercraft town. Team up with a friend, using a physical newspaper and VR, to discover Smalltown and its charming cast of characters by communicating and relating between both formats.
rows.description_html: Local Paper Small Town is a 2-player co-op puzzle game about spreading happiness around a quirky papercraft town. Team up with a friend, using a physical newspaper and VR, to discover Smalltown and its charming cast of characters by communicating and relating between both formats. One player explores the town in VR, solving puzzles by moving cardboard cutout characters around, entering codes, and working with the second player to fill in their newspaper crossword puzzle and deducing each character's story and place in the game world. The second player, equipped with the PDF of the Smalltown newspaper, reads and scans pages for clues that may help both players advance the game state by solving puzzles in VR thanks to their shared understanding of the characters, similar to a collaborative escape room, but with more narrative flavouring. * * * How to play: In this two-player experience, one player is equipped with a newspaper from a fictional Canadian town, and the other player explores a papercraft version of this town in virtual reality. Please find the newspaper PDF in the game folder. This game is for two players: one with the newspaper, one playing VR. The game lasts about one hour , and is best played in local co-op with a speaker for both players to hear the audio. Be sure to communicate well with your partner to solve puzzles, discover character stories, and complete the game. VR player: In addition to teleporting, you can grab characters and move them around to solve puzzles. Newspaper player: The game was designed to be played with the newspaper player not seeing the game screen. However, if you prefer to have an easier time, you could check what the other player is seeing in VR. Have fun in Smalltown! * * * Created as a mixed media semester project at the Cologne Game Lab. Nominated for the Ubisoft Newcomer Award at the German Developer Awards 2020.

rows.name: Love and Guillotines
rows.short_description: A visual novel video game which allows you to woo the most powerful figures of the French Revolution. Be careful to stay on everyone's good side, or you might just lose your head.
rows.description_html: Love and Guillotines is a visual novel dating sim which allows the player to romance prominent figures of the French Revolution. Experience your first day at 'Vive La University' as you navigate the ins-and-outs of the schools prominent 'Political Society Club'. Will the president of the club, Max, catch your eye? Or maybe the young playwright, Oly? The choice is yours in this work of historical fiction and romance. During the beginning of the pandemic I was reading a book titled 'Twelve Who Ruled' by RR Palmer. The book is about the Committee of Public Safety and it's members during the period known as the 'Year of Terror' in France. It's a great book, very informative. I highly recommend it if you're into that period of history. But there was something I just couldn't shake... These men were all so interesting with such strong personalities and crazy drama, so why... Had no one put them in a visual novel dating sim yet? This is how Love and Guillotines was born. A visual novel video game which allows you to woo the most powerful figures of the French Revolution. Be careful to stay on everyone's good side, or you might just lose your head. Script: Ellen Noel Programming: Chilliac Character Art: Emily Horn Additional Resources: Florassence CreaPracticus Patat0Master

rows.name: Death Duel VR
rows.short_description: Experience True HEMA Combat in VR. Step beyond button mashing. Death Duel VR uses physics-based leverage to let you authentically execute historical European martial arts techniques against live opponents. Master real guards, leverage, and tactics in heart-pounding PvP duels to the death.
rows.description_html: Just Updated Death Duel VR: Full Release Unleashed – The Ultimate PvP Arena Awaits! Warriors! The arena calls louder than ever. Death Duel VR emerges from Early Access, transformed and ready for its Full Release! We've honed the blade, deepened the saga, and forged the definitive PvP combat experience you helped create. Prepare for battle with major upgrades: ⚔️ Masterful Combat Physics: Feel every clash like never before. Revamped physics deliver unparalleled realism in strikes, parries, and movement – where true skill and precision reign supreme. 🎉 New Ways to Conquer: Gather your allies! Challenge rivals in the brand-new Party Room , featuring intense custom duels and unique trial modes for epic showdowns. 📖 Deeper Legends Unfold: Immerse yourself further. Fresh lore and expanded narratives enrich your warrior's path, adding weight to every victory. To our incredible community: Your relentless feedback, fierce battles, and unwavering support shaped this journey. This victory is yours as much as ours. Thank you for forging Death Duel VR into the ultimate PvP proving ground. This is more than an update – it's the pinnacle of VR combat. Step into the perfected arena. Claim your glory. Carve your name into legend with Death Duel VR: Full Release! See you on the battlefield, Champions! 💀 Try the Free To Play! Experience core PvP combat against full-version warriors. Unlock the complete experience with the Elite Package . About the Game Free DEMO: Taste Core PvP!  Experience core PvP combat in the Free To Play version (DEMO).  Fight full-version players in limited combat. Unlock ALL weapons, armours, modes & progression with the Elite Package (FULL GAME) . Hello Duelist’s, This is Community Manager Tyrus Rechs. It has come to my attention that not alot of people know about our discord server. We primarily engage with the community over discord.gg as it's easier to manage discussions over there. You may also find people to fight with in the Looking-for-game chat by @ the role that notify people to you willingness to fight. What is Death Duel VR Experience Historically Accurate VR Duels, Powered by Physics. Death Duel VR is a competitive online melee combat simulator. Master authentic HEMA techniques – real guards, strikes, and grappling – against live opponents in physics-driven PvP . Wield swords, shields, polearms, flails, and more with realistic collision and leverage. Engage in intense foot combat or test your skill in mounted jousting. Step into the medieval tournament arena, recreated for VR controllers. Duel with history, duel with skill. Key features: Fencing with sword, shield, flail, polearm and etc. Jousting Is there Singleplayer Content? Absolutely! Experience the 'Way of the Duelist' roguelike campaign. Hone your techniques solo, collect XP and credits through challenging runs, and unlock legendary weapons to wield in PvP. To report bugs please post them on Discord where I answer questions most of time.

rows.name: 推推炸(PushPushBoom)
rows.short_description: Alice, the protagonist of the game, enters a different world by mistake and finds that all the delicious food she likes has become a monster that can eat people. Alice wants to avoid the monster's pursuit while she wants to defeat the monster through her own wisdom and return to her own world.
rows.description_html: How to move Use the WSAD keyboard to move up, down, left and right. After clicking, the character will move accordingly. When it moves a space, it will stop. If you still click the move key in the corresponding direction, the character will continue to move without stopping. How to defeat monsters Pushing the square stones and fruits in the map is the main attack method. You can also use diaper bombs to kill monsters when you become a baby. Some pitaya fruits in the map also have the effect of bombs, which can also kill monsters. Note that some special monsters cannot be killed by pushing stones and fruits, but diaper bombs are effective. When a player is touched by a monster, the player fails. A level can be revived once through the vitality potion. How to pass Each level has specific requirements. The requirements are displayed in the upper left corner. It is required to display the number of monsters destroyed and the number of fruits destroyed. The current completed number will also be displayed. The shorter the time it takes to complete the task, the higher the clearance evaluation will be. Game fruit props, etc In order for players to pass the level more easily, there are fruit props that can be used in the game. The props are used to slow down monsters, dizziness monsters, or even kill monsters directly. The most important thing is that you will die when being approached by monsters in the game, but you can use resurrection (you need to use 5 points of vitality potion) How to get prop fruit Most of the fruit props are purchased from stores, but when you complete some achievements, you can get rewards from the achievement system, as well as a small amount of fruit props. It also includes vitality potion. How to get gold coins You can get gold coins by killing all kinds of food monsters in the level. Note that the higher the level score, the more gold coins you will get. When a stone crushes more monsters, the points will double. Game content obtained in this version This version can obtain 50 levels of game content. Players can obtain gold coins and buy game props through the game.

rows.name: ​Triple Fantasy
rows.short_description: Win the battle through various card combinations! Tactical Card Battle RPG!
rows.description_html: ■ Three Cards, Triple Fun - Unique tactical TCG, CCG among card games! - If you like RPG games, you will definitely love Triple Fantasy! Triple Fantasy is a cute pixel design, but it's a card battle game with a deep strategy. The player plays with a total of 27 cards. The goal is to strategically combine 3 cards to defeat the enemy. You receive 6 cards at the start and attack with 3 cards at each turn. In other words, the combination of the 3 cards should be used strategically. Sometimes you need to throw away cards to win the battle. Cards come in a total of 4 classes. There are 'Steel' class that deals damage, 'Faith' class that heals and manages crowd control skills, 'Magic' class that deals Area of Effect skills, and the special 'Wild' class that can be used in any situation. There are also various 'Jobs' such as Warrior, Monk, Sorcerer, etc. There are also Water, Earth, and Fire elements. The game is similar to the basic rules of poker such as Double, Flush, and Straight. Tremendous damage can be given or the HP can be healed by multiplying the damage through combining each Class, Job, and Element. There are more than 300 cards, and you can make your own deck through the obtained resources. Now enjoy the game with your own cards and your own strategy. ■ Free welcome-gifts for new users are awaiting! - We are giving everyone 500 free summons! - Complete the mission and earn the Mythic Cards! ■ A card collecting game with unique dot characters - Sun Wukong, Thor, Odin, and characters from 'Romance of the three kingdoms?!' Meet familiar legends in the adventure! - Collect over 300 pixel art heroes! One of the best card collecting RPG games! - From normal heroes to legends! Collect cards in various tiers and become stronger! ■ Various contents that will never go boring - The basis of strategy games! Expand the world with your one and only deck! [Outpost] - Attack monsters with different elements! Rewards depending on the strategy! [Goblin Mine] - A true strategy card game enjoyed by random cards! Thrilling turn-based PVP! [Arena] - Collect unique dot heroes hidden somewhere in the map! [Monster Dungeon] - Defeat various monsters with powerful card combinations! The real tactical RPG game! [Lab] - Use tactics in the PVP as well! Fun triples in Card battle games when enjoyed together! [Devil's Ruins] - NO Grinding! The real-time battle only with card strategy skills! [Unknown Portal] Enjoy strategy games with cute dot heroes! One of the best card battle RPG games! Download now!

rows.name: Ardor
rows.short_description: A hex-grid puzzle-tactics card game. Outwit and outlive your enemies, while upgrading your deck. A lightweight game of bite-sized encounters.
rows.description_html: Slice and dodge your way through a hex grid in this puzzle tactics card game. Avoid danger while dealing damage with the cards on hand, while powering up your deck. Turn Based Combat: Consider enemy attack patterns and decide how to navigate them while lashing out along the way. Upgrade any number on any card: Augment your deck's potential, while leaning into your own playstyle. Combine any card with any other card: Trim and craft your deck. Circumvent limitations of cards by creating your own synergies. Handmade Levels: A roguelike mode of varied scenarios that pose specific strategic questions, but also... Endless Levels: An Endless Mode of randomly generated arenas that scale in difficulty to keep up with your deck. Join us over on the Discord Server or r/ArdorTactics to discuss suggestions and share feedback!

rows.name: TILE PERFECT

rows.description_html: Tile Perfect: Pixel Perfection in Every Slide! Unleash your puzzle mastery with Tile Perfect, the mesmerizing sliding puzzle game that bursts with vibrant, pixelated charm! Dazzling pixel art: Each puzzle board is a vibrant tapestry of meticulously crafted pixelated wonders. From whimsical landscapes to retro arcade throwbacks, every tile is a tiny masterpiece waiting to be placed with precision. Arrange vibrant squares and discover a meditative calm within the pixelated puzzle. So, are you ready to embark on a pixel perfect adventure? Download Tile Perfect today and let the puzzling begin!

rows.name: Overstrike Arena
rows.short_description: Welcome in the overstrike arena, a fast-paced competitive 2 versus 2 simulation where your only goal is to take control of the Overdrive and bring into your opponent's goal. Punch your adversaries, wall-ride, destroy and hack the various evolving arenas to get the advantage.
rows.description_html: Overstike Arena is a fast-paced FPS competitive multiplayer game in 2 versus 2. Your goal is to get the Overdrive at the center of the arena and bring to the opponent's goal. Cooperate with yout teammate, score 3 points before your adversary and victory is yours. Move swiftly through the arena with various capacities like wall-riding or the punch-rush. The arenas in which you play change regularly over time or at your will! Modify the environnement at your advantage and adapt to get the upper hand. The close combat is at the heart of the experience and the best user of the punch will easily send his foes out of the map.

rows.name: Fanite
rows.short_description: A remake of Magicite, same gameplay loop just a tad bit harder, with new stuff added, but without multiplayer.
rows.description_html: Survive in this remade game with new stuff! Featuring many of the same elements as magicite, Fanite randomly generates each biome for you to delve into. Collect resources, and hunt beasts in order to help you survive the difficult and challenging environment. With a lot of character traits, hats, companions, players will have a fun and rewarding experience each play through! Be prepared to die a few times. Fanite's main influence was Magicite. Features: Randomly Generated Biomes - Experience a new biome each time you play. A couple trees to chop, ores to mine, plants to harvest, and bugs to catch! Permanent Death - When you die you stay dead. Crafting System - Combine any two items(That can be crafted) to create a new one! For example nothing + something = nothing. Combat System - If you plan on just running in and swinging your fists, you're gonna get wrecked if you dont ware armor. Take time to craft useful items and learn enemy move sets before attacking. Unlockable Races, Hats, & Companions - The more you play, the more you will unlock new stuff.

rows.name: Gabriel's Auditory Playground
rows.short_description: Gabriel's Auditory Playground has no graphics, no visuals, no way to experience the gameplay with your eyes. In Gabriel's Auditory Playground, your eyes have no use. Put your ears to the test and play through mini-games designed without sight in mind!
rows.description_html: This game is an experiment and no longer in development! Gabriel's Auditory Playground has no graphics, no visuals, no way to experience the gameplay with your eyes. In Gabriel's Auditory Playground, your eyes have no use. Put your ears to the test and play through a variety of mini-games designed without sight in mind such as: Zombie Survival - Survive an increasing amount of the living dead as you fend them off with nothing but your ears and a big, stinkin' gun. They're closing in from every direction, how many will you take down with you? Ninja Knockout - Ninjas to the left of you, more ninjas to the right, here you are, stuck in the middle with... two fists. In this mini-game inspired by 'One Finger Death Punch', get ready for a brutal beat-down and knockout limitless ninjas coming from either side! Not Enough Cooks - Put on your apron as a criminally underpaid fast food worker that's on their last warning. Get three orders wrong and you'll be back in the unemployment line! Can you survive your shift? In this mini-game inspired by 'Overcooked', build burgers to order in a very busy restaurant! Gabriel's Auditory Playground is an experimental game to raise awareness for visual impairment. Trailer by Josh Curry-Glasper

rows.name: Royal Duality
rows.short_description: Royal Duality is an immersive dark fantasy visual novel with 15 endings, various side stories and hidden Easter Eggs all set in an engaging lore-rich world
rows.description_html: Let the story begin... Explore the world of Royal Duality with a mysterious and cryptic narrator. Make choices that will change the lives of the characters of the tale, and the world they live in. Discover hidden side stories, unlock all the endings and complete the compendium to reveal the truth behind this captivating plot and unlock the true motives of the mysterious 'Guardian of Stories' Multiple character POVS 15 endings 12 bonus scenes Partially Voice Acted Over 30 CGs 74k words 15 hours completion time This game contains dark themes. There is a full content warning available before the game begins. “I haven’t seen a human for quite some time. Welcome, I am the guardian of stories. You came here to experience ‘Royal Duality’...one of the most important tales in my world. A small group from the Final Fae Kingdom are on a quest to find the powerful wizard, Oliver Lunastella, who has gone missing in the realm of the evil vampire Count Helmrick, who lives in the now desolate Evergreen Castle that once belonged to the Fae...or at least, that’s the story it told, the last time I read it…The narrative can be changed you see...by you.'

rows.name: Whispers of the village
rows.short_description: You arrive in a small village as a fortune-teller who reads the future in tea leaves. But an apocalyptic vision leads you to question its tranquillity. What if you had a part to play in this? Ready your cups and tea leaves, as the future of this village will be shaped by four unusual visitors.
rows.description_html: Whispers of the Village is an investigation game where you play as a fortune teller. As you enter a small village, you are overwhelmed by a terrible vision of the village ravaged by flames. Thanks to your divination skills, which tells you the future through tea leaves, you'll find clues in empty cups that will help you understand how the disaster will happen. Atypical and captivating characters:  Meet four villagers who come to your caravan every day to talk and drink tea. The four days leading to the disaster will lead you to grow closer to them, and discover more of their stories, personalities and secrets... Play as a tasseomancer :  You will have to find clues in the villagers' tea leaves through a series of shape matches. Each shape has its own meaning, and each combination and positioning of shapes must be interpreted to understand what is happening and will happen in the village. Take notes:  In your trusty notebook, you can record information obtained from your discussions with your visitors. This could be about their work, their relationships, or the predictions you've made for them. And solve the investigation:  Use stamps depicting the four villagers, as well as actions and objects. Place these stamps on drawings representing the different places in your vision to create sentences explaining the events to come. Once you've matched the right stamps with the right drawings, and put the drawings back into chronological order, the mystery surrounding the disaster will be solved. This Game include:  4 characters who will open up to you as you progress. A captivating story that will take you deeper into the hearts of your visitors. A calm and cosy atmosphere in your caravan, despite the looming disaster. 24 puzzles to help you solve and understand the mystery. 2 hours of immersive play and reading.

rows.name: Alone in the Dark Prologue
rows.short_description: This stand-alone prologue puts you in the tiny shoes of Grace Saunders – an 11-year-old girl delivering a letter, when things go horribly wrong… Experience the unique 1920s horror atmosphere of Alone in the Dark and prepare for the terror that awaits in Derceto Manor
rows.description_html: Alone in the Dark Prologue is an atmospheric Playable Teaser for the upcoming re-imagination of Alone in the Dark – the game which gave birth to the survival horror genre. One of Derceto’s residents, Jeremy Hartwood, has been acting strange lately. He asks Grace to do one simple thing – help him deliver a letter to his niece, Emily Hartwood. She seems to be the only one capable of understanding the otherworldly horrors plaguing Jeremy’s mind. Experience the haunting atmosphere of Derceto Manor, where psychological horror meets Southern Gothic, from the seemingly innocent perspective of Grace Saunders. Dive into the eldritch nightmare of Alone in the Dark in this exclusive first taste of Alone in the Dark’s full experience. If you make it to the end, be ready for a very special surprise… Grace agrees and embarks on a short yet memorable trip through a wing of Derceto Manor, invaded by a presence which appears to have emerged from the dark depths of the Bayou…

rows.name: DogeFight
rows.short_description: DogeFight is an EPIC Third-Person Multiplayer Fighting game👍 Play with your favorite memes and be the last survivor by defeating your opponents with special abilites and weapons! But be careful not to be SUS 🗿
rows.description_html: DogeFight is an EPIC Third-Person Multiplayer Fighting game 👍 Play with the most incredible meme characters of all times like Stonks or Doge in a fun/competitive pvp game. More precisely, this game consists in surviving in a map with 10 other players, with a total of 3 lives. You have to be the last player alive by looting weapons and fighting your opponents until everybody lost their live's, and cannot respawn anymore. By winning a game, you will collect a huge amount of 'Social Credit', which allows you to be ranked in the online DogeFight leaderboard, with a specific rank according to your level. You can also gain social credit by collecting amogos coins in different maps, which you are able to keep if you survive at the end. This game is designed to play with friends in the same lobby, but it's also possible to play with randoms thanks to the server list. Be the best DogeFight player by mastering characters spells and climbing the ranks! Features Lobby system Up to 10 players in a game A wide variety of loot and weapons 9 Different characters with different attacks 6 unic maps based on memes Public Server List Ranking system with in-game leaderboard and ranks

rows.name: Past Synergy
rows.short_description: Past Synergy is a 2 player co-op game that tests you and your friend's synergy. Divide the ability and roles between you and your friend to overcome the obstacles in a cave.
rows.description_html: Past Synergy is a 2 player co-op game that tests you and your friend's synergy. Divide up the roles between you and your friends to overcome the obstacles in a cave. Avoid the dangerous traps and destroy fragile walls to open path to the next level. Bigger issue, however, may be your friend. If you step on your friend from above or shoot the fireball at your friend, you may need to restart the level. There are three abilities as of now. Shield: It makes the player immune to attacks Fireball: It can destroy fragile walls. Double jump: Helps your friend jump twice Each level features a unique challenge that will test you and your friend's current synergy. Besides the co-op mode, this game also features a pvp mode. Show your friend your true skill! Will your current synergy be stronger than the past synergy or will it be weaker?

rows.short_description: An ancient custom is invoked, and five kingdoms send their young heirs to play a legendary game. Build relationships, form alliances, and win the crown in this high-stakes game of woodland politics and social maneuvering.
rows.description_html: Hare Apparent is a dialogue-based roleplaying game in a high-stakes social elimination scenario. As one of five pretenders competing to rule the disparate kingdoms of Under-Sky, you’ll need all your social chops and strategic skills to be the last candidate standing and win the crown. During the day, talk with your fellow pretenders: build rapport, discuss issues, hatch plans and make false promises. Every night, votes are cast—and a pretender is eliminated. Last one standing wins the Ironwood Crown. Will it be you? • Randomized dialogue and relationships—no two playthroughs are the same. • 5 colorful and clever contenders to bond with or betray. • 6+ endings based on your cunning and conduct in the crucible of the Conclave. • Multiple difficulties to find that perfect balance between strategy and story.

rows.name: Paige Turner
rows.short_description: In this adventure, you'll travel through a magical library and platform your way through a library lost to time in order to reconnect a father and daughter after tragedy tore them apart. Utilize unique abilities to overcome the library's troublesome obstacles and unlock the pieces of the story!
rows.description_html: Complete the story and reconnect a father and daughter! This is a game created by students at the University of Central Florida in the GaIM program. In this adventure, you'll travel through a magical library and enter storybooks in order to reconnect a father and daughter after tragedy tore them apart. Players take on the role of Auri, the healer of giants, an origami creature of unknown origin. Players will be able to transform into different forms in order to run and jump their way to the end of this story. This roughly 40-minute-long adventure lets you jump and glide your way over various puzzles over 5 different and varied levels. Players can expect to run up against some interesting platforming puzzles and narrative interludes. An environment with a story! Explore a library lost to time at the hands of grief and help heal the troubled keeper of the library, Turner, from the grief that ails him. The library holds the key to the source of Turner's anguish. Player's will be guided throughout the library by magic candles that have been imbued by some form of protective magic, leading you to the next piece of the story. Key Features Platforming and puzzling through 5 distinct and varied levels! A touching story about reconnection. Full controller support. 4 unique abilities to assist traversal! Fully voice-acted!

rows.name: Ellisar
rows.short_description: Dive into this magical underwater adventure. Explore a corrupted environment moving with your two transformations to help fix the disaster that almost ended life around your world. Ellisar is a third person contemplative exploration and adventure game.
rows.description_html: Ellisar is an underwater adventure in a corrupted world. Your character will be able to explore the ocean using two kinds of bodies: a humanoid one and stingray-like one. With the help of your small but magic Mooty friends you will be able to soar through the devastated areas your species used to inhabit. Unique movement Your character can change its form to be able to move like a stingray. Using the magical power of the Mooties around you, you can flap your fins to impulse yourself forward. You can do this as many times as you have Mooties, but they have to rest, so you will need to transform back whenever their power has worn off. Contemplative exploration The world around you is both magical and devastated. While looking for the solution to the corruption, you will encounter many things that will shed a light to the history of your ancestors. A living environment Life finds a way. Even if everything around you seems hopeless, there's always life that can give you the push you need to continue. Our world is filled with small animals and algae that reminds the player of how necessary it is to continue this venture and prevent the disaster from spreading. Accessibility Features In CoGames we believe in the importance of accessibility, so we have certain features to make sure the game is playable by as many people as we can: Localization in many languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Danish, Basque and Catalan. And we might include more!! Control settings for one hand only Full control remapping HUD color customization

rows.name: Lonely Knight
rows.short_description: Lonely Knight is a story that immerses you in an epic adventure in the medieval era. Avenge your wife as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast-paced combat, castle sieges, and more.
rows.description_html: Lonely Knight is an action-adventure game set in medieval and ancient times. You are playing as a hero whose name is Tristan. Tristan's former friend Garreth, seized his wife so he could return to the army. After capturing Nyneve, Tristan felt betrayed and decided to go on an unexpected journey through dangerous lands. World of betrayal Experience the action in a whole new light with Tristan's combat skills, and punish those who betrayed you. Be prepared to face deadly mythical monsters while avoiding perilous traps. Enter the chaos of war as a bold Knight and Interact with many unique and imaginative creatures and enemies. Forged in the flames of battles Battle across the dangerous lands against dragons, Skeletons, Demons, Ghosts, and a corrupted army in your quest for vengeance. Vanquish your foes using the game’s deep and intuitive combat system that is easy to learn. Fantastic graphics bring this mythical world to life. The defeat was merely delayed Arm yourself with brutal melee weapons, and jump into the Medieval world. Explore the world and defeat all of those who stand in your way. With the help of the God Zeus, show no mercy. Take to the field of battle and experience the brutality of medieval combat in a third-person perspective with hundreds of on-screen units, each with their own detailed AI. Key Features: Experience a lawless land Live an epic adventure through stunning landscapes. Dispense your own justice With a sword on your back, become a ruthless Knight. Epic Universe Unlike anything the player has seen before, take a look at a unique style. Freedom Explore the vast world and face various challenges – go solo and complete quests. Fantasy Explore lands inspired by medieval time including frosted mountaintops, deep forests, swamps, ruins, and caves, evacuated cities, deserts, and many more. Discover ancient secrets, seek forgotten treasures, and face mythical creatures inspired by medieval tales! Be part of an exciting story

rows.name: Tilebreaker
rows.short_description: Destroy blocks through 20 levels and 5 unique bosses with different mechanics. Do it in the best possible time!
rows.description_html: Destroy the blocks you achieve a 80% score while avoiding enemies and their attacks. Improve your time and unlock additional levels!. 20 unique levels and 5 bosses with different techniques to challenge you! Hi, I'm Nicolas Rizzi, just a guy who loves making games. 'TileBreaker' was my first creation; it's a bit rough around the edges, but filled with passion and fun gameplay. I poured a lot of love into it, learning and growing along the way. I truly hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. If you do, feel free to check out my other works. Here's to more gaming adventures together!

rows.name: The Nameless Braves: Heaven (Episode 1)
rows.short_description: The Nameless Braves is a kinetic-style Visual Novel. Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as 'The Dark Age', one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero.
rows.description_html: Game Overview 'The Gods had but one question for mankind: what is the meaning of life?' The Nameless Braves is a kinetic-style Visual Novel. Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as 'The Dark Age', one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero. You will follow the story of Elijah, a rookie member of a mercenary organization known as 'The Braves'. The lands of Ankh-Seah are wrought with dangers both human and inhuman. Elijah and his allies will be pit against the various threats that creep in the shadows of Ankh-Seah, uncovering secrets while being forced to confront harsh truths about their world and even themselves. Format The Nameless Braves is planned, at current, to be a trilogy of sorts. The first book is The Nameless Braves: Heaven. It is planned to have four episodes, and this first one is free!

rows.name: Zumbi Blocks 2 Open Alpha
rows.short_description: Loot. Kill. Survive. Can you escape ? (probably not) Zumbi Blocks 2 is the official sequel to the 2013 free browser zombie game. Stuck on an island, cut off from the rest of humanity, you wake up. The secret to breaking free from this place lies asleep, underground. From the soil, zumbies emerge.
rows.description_html: Zumbi Blocks 2 Zumbi Blocks 2 is a zombie survival game. It's going to be available for free while it's in early development. Much will change in terms of gameplay, as it will move towards a base building / wave survival type of game. Kill: fight zombies with melee and ranged weapons, both in first person or third person mode. Loot: explore the procedurally generated city , to find resources. Overcome: defeat bosses that live in interest points along the island. Upgrade: unlock loadout tiers, that you can bring to the match with you.

rows.name: The Anointed: David Saves Keilah
rows.short_description: Anointed: DSK is a single player, 3rd person action/adventure game. As David, the player can run, climb, scale walls, swing from ropes and ride a horse on the journey through ancient Judah - using Stealth, Combat and Strategy to fulfill God's plan and save the people of Keilah from the Philistines.
rows.description_html: Controller Support The Anointed supports most XBox controllers and is compatible with SteamDeck. About the Game You are David, a young shepherd boy that quickly realizes he has a greater purpose than just taking care of sheep. With wisdom, skill and bravery, you will progress through many events and locations from the biblical stories of young David. The Anointed: David Saves Keilah is a single-player, action-adventure game with platforming elements experienced in 3rd-person perspective. This is a demo of the larger game, The Anointed: Heart of David - due to be released in late 2026. In DSK, David traverses many locations; moving through the wilderness of Ziph, the Forest of Hereth, and the threshing floors and stronghold of Ancient Keilah, all in this single episode (1 Sam 23). As David, the player has the physical ability to walk, crawl, crouch, sprint, jump, vault over objects, climb on buildings, scale up walls, swing from ropes, and there is even a horse for those long runs through the wilderness. Although the story is linear, there are plenty of things to discover and many paths to take to fulfill each part of David's mission to save Keilah. There is a vast open-world feel with no time limits between objectives. There are loud thunderstorms and bright sunny skies, and David has a torch to light his way inside dark rooms/areas. Dialogues and Scrolls of information (Scripture) help guide David on the right path, while providing invaluable lessons. And, there are videos (Prayer Tips) that help the player navigate the challenges ahead. David's sling, staff, sword and spear are very useful weapons against the Philistines, the wild animals, and all the enemies of David - but Stealth and patience can be the most rewarding strategy. The Vitality, Righteousness, and Empowerment meters reflect the state of David during gameplay. All of these elements and features come together in an exciting version of the biblical narrative of David, God's Anointed.

rows.name: Blackout!!
rows.short_description: Blackout!! is a Tower Defence Action-RPG where you must defend the land of Suwemba from the evil Olrinds! Select one of two heroes to fight back wave after wave of enemies by summoning defences while participating in the action-packed combat!
rows.description_html: Blackout!! is a Tower Defence Action-RPG where you must defend the land of Suwemba from the evil Olrinds! Select one of two heroes to fight back wave after wave of enemies by summoning defences while participating in the action-packed combat! Test your creativeness while using crystals to build up your line of defence during the defence phase and test your skills using mana to cast spells while fighting alongside your defences during the attack phase. Play singleplayer or play co-op splitscreen to coordinate your strategies with a friend.
