rows.name: PogoStickMiooooooon
rows.short_description: An action game where you bounce up and up and up and up, just trying to get to higher. This game is hololive unofficial fangame featuring Ookami Mio.
rows.description_html: What is 'PogoStickMiooooooon' 'PogoStickMiooooooon' is a hololive fangame featuring Ookami Mio, member of Hololive Gamers. The game is a platform action with you control Ookami Mio who jump automatically on a pogo stick. Jumping to the platforms, and just keep going up, don't fall. How To Play Left Mouse Button: Decide A Key/Left Arrow Key: Move Left D Key/Right Arrow Key: Move Right Left Thumbstick/D-Pad: Move Left-Right Jumping to the platforms, and keep going up higher and higher. When it lands on the platform, it automatically jumps, don't panic. NON STOP HOLOLIVE! There is no goal. It is a score attack to see how high you can go up. Streaming Notice This game is available for streaming. And we'd be very grateful if you could help us with the following! Include 'PogoStickMiooooooon' in the stream title. Include a link to this page in the stream description. This game is a fiction featuring talents from Hololive Production. This is not an official game of Cover Corporation and Hololive Production. Please stream the game while being respectful of the characters. If your stream or video is leads to grieving to the talent, I may reach out and request for the video to be removed. Excuse Please try to understand the circumstances. Assumed play time is 5~10 minutes small volume. The resolution is fixed at 450x800. Please make sure that the height is within the display. Sound volume cannot be set in the game. High scores cannot be save. There is no function to post scores to social networking sites. The UI cannot be controlled with the gamepad. Credits Game Design/Art/Engineering/Title Logo/Publishing, almost all of them: Blasthal Sound: A lots of free sounds Synopsis 'The entrance to the fortune-telling house is blocked!' Ookami Mio has been locked out of the fortune-telling house she went to so much trouble to build. The staff-only entrance was also blocked. The remaining entrance is on the roof. A white fox girl gave her pogo stick, a familiar platform floating in the air, and I decided to do it. But was the fortune-telling house so tall ...? This game is not endorsed by or directly affiliated with Cover Corporation or Hololive Production. The game is produced according to Cover Corporation's Derivative Work License Agreement. rows.description_html: A story Of Heroes In the Far Future. The Laurasia Empire, located in the western part of the Eurasian continent, was being invaded by the Jungals, a powerful nomadic equestrian race that appeared in the east. Overrun by the overwhelming military might of the light cavalry, the people of the empire are terrified and frightened of the carnage that awaits them. McMurdo, a holy knight who lives in an orphanage in Lipetsk, a provincial city of the empire, stands up against the invaders together with his sister Lismy. Key Points Of the Film ■possession System The main character and his male companions have the 'possession' ability and can fight by possessing the bodies of girls. More than sixty of my friends! Combine the power of your spirit with the power of your body to defeat powerful enemies. Three Soldiers System This work is a tactical simulation RPG. In particular, the roles of infantry, cavalry, and artillery on the battlefield are clearly defined, and these are effectively utilized to advance the game. Gamepad play recommended

rows.name: Sketch
rows.short_description: Enter the Land of Cere as a mysterious being, Am. Traverse through the mind of Taylor, an artist whose passion for art is dimming. Am wields a pencil, which can draw shapes to progress through levels and erase enemies to clear Taylor's mind and ultimately restore Taylor's passion.
rows.description_html: What to look forward to: It's completely free (no microtransactions either)! Innovative Draw/Erase mechanic Fantastic soundtrack, with 25 gorgeous songs 12 Exhilarating and strategic boss fights 36 Platformer levels, each revealing parts of the rich story 4 In-game achievements per level Non-linear Gameplay: Explore the 12 regions in your own order Sketch is a game in which you control Am, a being composed of artistic passion, to internally help Taylor deal with the struggles of pursuing an art career. Sketch takes place in the Land of Cere, which is Taylor's mind. The Land of Cere is plagued with many negative thoughts and memories, taking the forms of monsters. These monsters are dimming Taylor's passion to pursue art, so it is Am's duty to erase them and clear Taylor's mind. Am wields a pencil, which can draw shapes to progress through levels and erase enemies to clear Taylor's mind. Journey through the Land of Cere's 12 regions, each resembling a part of the human mind. Each region introduces more of Taylor's story through 3 platformer levels and 1 boss level. Best of all, you can travel across these regions in any order that you like.

rows.name: Asmodeus's Hell: Devil in the Sunshine State
rows.short_description: A young boy finds himself tied into something sinister while pursuing the girl of his dreams. Total of 10 different endings!
rows.description_html: Kowechobe is a Florida town infamous for occult activity and supernatural occurrences. Khyle Romano has spent his entire life avoiding this part of his hometown, but slowly finds himself tied into something sinister while trying to pursue the girl of his dreams. Choose-your-own-story mystery visual novel with  horror elements. There are a total of 10 endings and multiple routes and unlockable scenarios! This game contains graphic and disturbing content and is not for anyone under the age of 17

rows.name: The Horror Story: Rebirth
rows.short_description: Welcome to The Horror Story: Rebirth, a remake version from the original Horror Story powered by Unreal Engine 5. Like all horror games, it contains jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises.
rows.description_html: NEW LINEAR DLC EXPANSION INCLUDED! Get The Horror Story: Rebirth and get the KaleidoMode Expansion DLC for free! The KaleidoMode is a free DLC that unlocks once you completed the base game by getting the true ending. Your mission: Unknown! About the Game The Horror Story: Rebirth is a remake version from the original Horror Story powered by Unreal Engine 5. Collect an item to unlock the next level, and to proceed with the game, but be careful though. Someone may be lurking around in these levels. There are 3 levels you need to beat in order to unlock the 'secret bonus level'. You will start off in the Basement. Look around to see if you can find an item you need to proceed. Then there's the Bush Maze. It's small, so you should be able to find the item pretty quickly. The last level is the Maze. You must find your way around the maze in order to find the item you need to proceed. The 'Secret Bonus Level' is a secret, so complete all 3 levels to unlock it. Like all horror games, it contains jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises. Features: Unlockable levels Collectable items Flashlight Scary elements 3 levels 1 bonus level

rows.name: Aero Tales Online: The World - Anime MMORPG
rows.short_description: Aero Tales Online is a free Cross-Platform Anime MMORPG with PvP, PvE, Fortress War, Faction War, Guild War, and life-sim features like Cooking, Farming, Fishing, Housing, Marriage, and even flying freely across the world. Uncover the mystery of the Key of Skylight and begin your adventure!
rows.description_html: Ultimate Combat Mechanic: You can play in either action combat or target combat modes. Showcase your difference with numerous combo combinations and play styles. Whether you prefer PvP or PvE, the choice is yours! Daily Events: Every day, many events await you. From sudden battles and ranked arena fights to raids and much more! New Social Life: Socializing in the world of Aero is effortless. Gather with players to clear dungeons, go fishing, head to the mines, decorate your home, play music, or even get married. The possibilities in this world are limitless! Battles: Each class has its own unique combat style and item types. Choose your side, customize your character, and make your way to become a legend. Castle sieges, clan wars, faction battles, daily arenas, a power-balanced matchmaking system, and much more await you in this world.

rows.name: Until the Night
rows.short_description: Economic strategy about building a toy factory for Santa Claus. Until the Night is a small economic strategy game that was inspired by Anno and Tropico game series.
rows.description_html: Until the Night is a small economic strategy game that was inspired by Anno and Tropico game series. The main goal is to build a Santa Claus toy factory and produce toys and coal. To do so Player will need to complete several tasks by gathering resources and building different factories that produce these goods. After completing each task, Player will be reworded with new buildings. The game will takes two to four hours to complete. Features: • Construction and production, which changes as you progress through the game; • Events that can both give resources or take something; • Resources and carts - if it take too much time, you can speed up the game; • Dynamic snow; • Event-based upgrades of buildings and the main building appearance; • Time limited main missions where player should produce toys.

rows.name: Meth Master
rows.short_description: Are you ready to build your own drug empire?
rows.description_html: Are you ready to build your own drug empire? Start your journey with growing ruderalis, upgrade production to get new recipes, the better the product, the more it costs. Buy different types of dealers to sell your product faster. Do not forget that you need production and workers in order to produce it. If you have already mastered the production of grass, it’s time to move on to serious matters, for example meta, you can improve each of your products to the 2nd, and later the 3rd level, as an example, there are grasses of such types: ruderalis, sativa, indica, hybrid . Having developed a new recipe, the price of the goods will certainly increase, but be careful, the more your empire the more likely unpleasant things can happen to you, the police will try to raid your production or dealers as soon as you lose vigilance but for the safety of your production and dealers there are various corrupt police and lawyers who will compete for your property and dealers, if you have already made enough money you can use the services of a banker to increase your capital and reduce costs for dealers, productions and chemists and bribe a politician to reduce the chance of an outside attack on you. Production: Buy various plants for growing, cocking meth and making coca. Hire employees to your production to increase the quantity of goods produced. Control the amount of goods produced with the help of sliders, you decide how many chemists will work. For each type of product, 2 types of production and one type of growers or chemists are available. Management: Manage dealers so as not to sell all the goods or in which case all your dealers will stop working and you will need to send them to the streets again. Track and manage the economy of your empire with the management tools and statistics provided to you. Dealers: Buy a variety of dealers from common street dealers to professional smugglers to sell your goods faster. In total, 4 types of dealers are available for each type of product, each of them costs differently and requires an additional payment for each one. Product: Keep track of the filling of your warehouses, the extraction and sale of your goods, as well as the current prices of products. Do not forget to buy new warehouses in a timely manner so that the warehouse is not full and does not sell out completely. Improvements: Improve your products from ruderalis to hibrid, create various recipes for meth and coca, improve your production and buy new chemists and growers to achieve success in this matter and create your own empire. Assistants: Buy various helpers to strengthen the empire. Each of the assistants does his job, the boss increases the limit of dealers, and the policeman insures your dealers from prison, a lawyer will help if your production are under arrest, and the politician will reduce the pressure of the authorities on you. Support and plans: Contact our community forums for support or help, we will be happy to help you and listen to your wishes to make the game even better. We will be happy to try and develop the game with you. New languages ​​will be added at the request of the community in the forums, each new language requires time and financial investment, as well as font support for new characters of foreign languages.

rows.name: Indecent Details - Find the Difference
rows.short_description: Indecent Details is a barebones free adult “find the differences” game.
rows.description_html: Indecent Details is a barebones free adult “find the differences” game. This zero-budget title has dozens of images to distract you with, if you are bored enough to give it a spin. Indecent Details includes a mix of art styles featuring new and old art from LarsMidnatt, which isn’t saying much. But if you have made it this far, some of it might have caught your eye. Enjoy! ADVISORY Differences may be subtle and difficult to spot depending on a variety of factors. Monitor calibration, screen size, viewing angle and color blindness may make finding differences harder for some compared to others. Bring your own music there is no in-game music. All characters are 18 years or older.

rows.name: Danger Ducklings
rows.short_description: Join 2 cute but not-so-bright ducklings on their quest through over 100 fun and challenging puzzles! Conquer new modes, collect costumes, and explore different worlds on their journey to reunite with their Mother!
rows.description_html: Danger Ducklings is a cute puzzle game that puts players in control of 2 adorable little ducklings through 3 vibrant worlds! Each uniquely designed puzzle offers players the chance to unlock more levels, collect costumes, and showcase their mastery by achieving Diamond rank (Done by completing the puzzle in the fewest amount of moves possible!) Features Help 2 dim Ducklings complete over 100 puzzles! Never-before-seen content, with new levels, costumes, and modes! Master Puzzles to collect Stars and Bread. Use Bread to Customize the Ducklings! Race the clock to Beat your high scores in Time Trial Mode! Reunite the Ducklings with their Mother!

rows.name: FITRIZ
rows.short_description: Food puzzle game. Complete lines of food blocks and collect 175+ food items in 30 levels with the help of a raccoon.
rows.description_html: Beautiful berries, lovely legumes, and wonderful vegetables! And some pizza plus ice cream afterwards. Collect more than 175 delicious plant-based food items (with real nutritional values) and learn more about vitamins and minerals while having fun with this food-puzzle game. With the help of cutlery and your raccoon friend you will dig through mountains of food in 30 yummy levels. Choose between three degrees of difficulty that will challenge beginners and puzzle-veterans alike. You will have to handle serving after serving of delicious food, while trying to get those important micronutrients in. Features: (Play & learn) Play: -Complete line after line of delicious foods -Complete and devour up to 5 lines at a time for maximum score -Use cutlery, the raccoon or a bomb to push down blocks or get rid of them -Dig through 3 difficulties and 30 levels of yummy food And Learn: -Collect 177 food items and discover what nutrients they contain -Collect 38 sport activities -Learn about the function and importance of vitamins and minerals -Learn about the function and importance of macronutrients -Learn about daily recommendations of nutrients -Get tips for a healthy diet with linked scientific information

rows.name: Operation Pill
rows.short_description: Operation Pill is the story of a small and brave pill that gets into your body and saves it from pathogenic bacteria. Arm yourself with an electrostatic shield and a germicidal cannon and save your body!
rows.description_html: Operation Pill is a story about a small and bold pill that enters your body and saves it from disease-causing bacteria. Control the flight of a capsule inside a blood vessel and destroy pathogenic bacteria. You have a germicidal gun to attack and an electrostatic shield to defend. Of course, we have red barrels that destroy everything in their path. Warning: An inaccurate shot can kill a neutral cell and weaken the organism. Collect weapons, additional shields and lives. Go ahead and save it!

rows.name: Goblin Gladiators
rows.short_description: Live fast, die ridiculously! The big brawl has begun, and you are invited to unleash chaos in the most thrilling battle arena ever seen through the eyes of goblins. Will your pack of cunning goblin fighters rise to the top and claim victory in this heart-pounding spectacle?
rows.description_html: Live fast, die ridiculously! The big brawl has begun, and you are invited to unleash chaos in the most thrilling battle arena ever seen through the eyes of goblins. Welcome to Goblin Gladiators, where danger lurks in every corner, fearsome foes await, and a deadly fog draws near. Will your pack of cunning goblin fighters rise to the top and claim victory in this heart-pounding spectacle? It's time to find out! Choose from three distinct character types - Sagittarius the archer, Secutor the warrior, and Dimachaerus the assassin. Each goblin possesses their own set of unique skills and abilities to match your play style. Level up and customize your warriors to dominate the arena! Every swing of your blade or crackle of arcane power can change the tide of battle - it's all up to you, you cunning Goblin! The battle arena is fraught with peril as you face off against other teams of goblin gladiators and the intervention of hordes of nibblers and mythical opponents that can throw off your winning streak at any moment. Join forces with friends and challenge rival gobbo gladiators in exhilarating multiplayer battles. Only the smartest and most agile goblins will emerge victorious. In Goblin Gladiators, death is just the beginning of the fun. You can equip devestating death effects that give you immediate revenge on your enemies. Even when your goblins fall, you still get to make a real impact on the gameplay. Choose to aid or sabotage other players, or return as a charging nibbler boomer, seeking revenge on your adversaries. The choices are limitless!

rows.name: Déjà-vu
rows.short_description: Déjà-vu is an online diffusion platform of immersive and virtual sound works offering the possibility to live or relive an experience originally conceived for the sound window, an outdoor linear device of 16 speakers integrated into Sporobole’s building facade.
rows.description_html: Experience immersive and virtual sound works as you move around freely, listening from a selection of more than fifteen pieces from different sound artists. Déjà-vu is an online diffusion platform of immersive and virtual sound works. Created from the 3D digitization of Sporobole’s outdoor space, it recalls the familiar structure of the center. The platform offers the public the possibility to live or relive an experience originally conceived for the sound window, an outdoor linear device of 16 speakers integrated into Sporobole’s building facade. It also showcases works produced especially for this environment, which becomes, here, a creation support in itself. By placing freedom of movement at the heart of the passerby’s experience, Déjà-vu aims at widening the notions of space of creation and diffusion while highlighting the sound works created at Sporobole and making them accessible from anywhere.

rows.short_description: Voxel-like medieval escort game.
rows.description_html: TVG - Journey is a voxel like, medieval escort wagon game. It is a prequel to the upcoming medieval aRPG game. The aim of the game is to escort wagon to all the villages protecting it from all the enemies encountered on the way. On the way you will encounter numerous different enemies and obstacles. You will be able to collect different types of clothings and upgrade your equipment. The game is short, and it should be treatened as an introduction to the vox games I am an will be developing.

rows.name: Easter Eggstravaganza
rows.short_description: Developed by Lumpy Pudding Productions, EASTER EGGSTRAVAGANZA is a 3D Platformer that puts you in the shoes of the Easter Bunny himself. Help the Easter Bunny collect eggs, explore levels, and make his way to the end as quickly as possible.
rows.description_html: Easter Eggstravaganza is a 3D platformer with the Easter Bunny as the hero. The object of the game is to collect as many eggs as possible, destroy enemies, and finish each level with a fast time. Points will be awarded based on how well you perform at these 3 objectives. Try to get as high of a score as possible! There are 4 levels to choose from and you may complete them in any order. Explore areas like the snow-capped mountains, a green forest, a meadow teeming with life, or even the ludicrous Lava Land.

The object of the game is to collect as many eggs as possible, destroy enemies, and finish each level with a fast time. Points will be awarded based on how well you perform at these 3 objectives. Try to get as high of a score as possible! There are 4 levels to choose from and you may complete them in any order. Explore areas like the snow-capped mountains, a green forest, a meadow teeming with life, or even the ludicrous Lava Land.

rows.name: Run N' Gun
rows.short_description: Skate and shoot your way through waves of enemies increasing your firepower along the way to become the champion. Run N' Gun is a First-person arcade shooter with a focus on movement. Become the Protagonist Bot and use your skills to survive waves of Antagonist Bots to win it all.
rows.description_html: Skate and shoot your way through waves of enemies increasing your firepower along the way to become the champion. Run N' Gun is a First-person arcade shooter with a focus on movement. Become the Protagonist Bot and use your skills to survive waves of Antagonist Bots to win it all. Stadiums Gain speed, explore, gear up and shoot through waves of Antagenst Bots. Choose one of two locations to become the champion and prove to them all, that there is only one Protagonist. The Arena is set in the dead of night on top of a building in the Bot's new capital city. Design for movement this stadium sets the new standard for speed and versatility. The Facility is set in a part of this world long forgotten. With tight corners and roofs, one's ability to aim will be their best friend. Guns & Augments Pick up the tools for the job and enhance your ability by using five different unique weapons and six augments. Use the Assault Rifle, Shotgun, Sniper, Pistol, or Greatsword to slay the Antagonist Bots where they stand. Become More powerful to defeat your foes using Augments. enhancing the Protagonist's physical prowess and weapon behavior. Antagonist Bots Run from and defeat four top-of-the-line Antaginest Bots why they seek the Protagonists Bot out and end his career to become the champion. Drones, why weak will try to swarm you and overpower you with numbers and air power. Walkers, the calvary of the Antaginest Bots seek you out and will outmaneuver you when they fire their deadly weapons. Trappers, avoiding the Protagonists while still being a menace.

rows.name: Oceans
rows.short_description: Adapt your Species to survive and thrive in the Oceans depths in this turn-based strategy game based on the hit board game Oceans.
rows.description_html: Enter a vast, underwater cosmos: a mysterious interconnected world of tentacles, sharp teeth, and black ink, where your survival depends on your ability to adapt in a continually changing environment. But this is just on the surface… Lurking below the surface lie mysteries so bizarre they hardly seem natural. The Deep is a deck of mysterious traits you’ll discover over the course of many games. These over-powered traits represent the unknown: the undiscovered wonders of the deep ocean. Buy once, play on any platform! Based on the hit board game, Oceans offers a beautifully crafted strategy game experience. The reef and 20 deep cards are completely free to play (and ad-free!), and you may also join one multiplayer game per day free. A one-time upgrade to the Complete Game features 87 Deep Cards, 21 Scenarios, and multiple hard AI personalities for endless replay fun. You can also play unlimited online games against others on any platform, in real time or asynchronously, create your own multiplayer games, and even create your own decks for use in singleplayer and multiplayer. You are also able to login with your account on mobile platforms and unlock your purchased functionality there. Venture into the deep at your own risk!

rows.name: World of Mines Creator's Edition
rows.short_description: Classic Minesweeper meets pixel art creativity! Craft unique pixel puzzles, transform them into challenging minesweeper levels, and explore endless community creations.
rows.description_html: Dive into World of Mines Creator’s Edition — where classic Minesweeper meets limitless pixel-art creativity. Build your own pixel artworks with an intuitive in-game editor, then instantly transform them into playable, hand-crafted Minesweeper puzzles. Play over 600 community-created levels, discover new pixel challenges every week, and share your creations through Steam Workshop. Whether you love logic puzzles, pixel art, or the nostalgia of Minesweeper, World of Mines turns creativity into gameplay. Create Design pixel art from scratch using a simple grid editor. Every pixel becomes a tile — place, paint, and sculpt your image into a custom puzzle. Play Test your creations or explore a growing library of player-made levels, from meme art and retro icons to detailed illustrations and themed puzzle packs. Share Publish your artwork in the Steam Workshop with one click. Browse, rate, and save designs from players around the world. Features • Pixel art editor → instantly converts art into Minesweeper puzzles • 600+ community puzzle levels and growing daily • Unique challenge themes: retro, memes, art, logic, abstract • Endless creativity through Steam Workshop • Relaxing design, challenging gameplay • Beginner-friendly creation tools • Classic Minesweeper rules reimagined with art • Support for 27+ languages How to Play Each pixel may hide a mine. Numbers show how many mines surround a tile. Mark suspected mines with a flag, reveal safe tiles, and uncover the full artwork without detonating a bomb. Unleash your creativity, test your logic, and join a community reshaping Minesweeper one pixel at a time.

rows.name: Cyphers Game
rows.short_description: It is the end of 1920. The Polish-Bolshevik war has been going on for almost two years. The battle for Korosteń – a key railway junction and technical supply base – is underway. Break Bolshevik cyphers, ensure radio communication, and neutralise the fearsome armoured trains.
rows.description_html: DISCOVER THE DEEPEST MYSTERIES OF ESPIONAGE AND FEEL THE RUSH OF VICTORY Take the role of soldiers, cryptologists, and communication experts during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920! Operate historical communication devices, decode enemy ciphers, and gain access to secret information that shaped the outcome of the war. Discover the inner workings of Bolshevik armored trains and participate in crucial missions that led to Poland’s victory. Every aspect of the game has been meticulously crafted with the help of source materials or accurately replicated from historical exhibits. Players engage in documented historical events, with each character assigned a unique, vital role in determining the battle’s outcome. Key Features: A captivating story inspired by real events and featuring authentic Polish cryptographers and soldiers from the Polish-Bolshevik War Elements of stealth, cryptographic puzzles, and interaction with historical communication devices Attention to historical detail, with all devices and elements in the game carefully recreated from source materials and historical artifacts Gameplay that blends action, puzzle-solving, and exploration, offering a unique combination of education and entertainment in a three-dimensional space

rows.name: Masks Of Deception
rows.short_description: Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... otherwise the demon will slay you first.
rows.description_html: Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... or the demon will slay you first. You’ve been sent to disrupt and purge a demon before it claims three lives and fulfills its ritual. Purgers (innocents) must be cautious in performing their task as the demon isn’t the only one looking to slay them. Others silently patrol searching for victims outside ultraviolet protection, and some will attack only if you prompt them to. As a Purger you’ll be traveling around the entire area looking for paranormal zones to investigate, making progress towards uncovering the Demon’s type. These zones appear and disappear in different locations as time goes on. While searching it can be easy to lose sight of teammates, offering the Demon an opportunity to perform a suspicious action. Trust must be earned and even then isn’t a guarantee. Keep everyone at an arm's reach until you can confirm they are who they claim to be. For every three demon books the Demon collects and deposits on a summoning circle they’ll be able to kill one Purger. As your party dwindles the Demon’s identity will likely be exposed if you haven’t learned who it was already. Time is of the essence to figure out the Demon’s type, with both uncovered you can vote and cast the incantation to exorcize the Demon. Performed correctly the Demon will be purged from this world and the Purgers will win. However if the vote is cast incorrectly the Purgers will lose and the Demon will be freed. One chance is all you get, make it count. Falling victim to one of the threats or the Demon isn’t the end. After death you respawn as a Ghost with separate tasks of destroying Demon Books and collecting Sacred Pages scattered around the area. If you manage to collect all 10 Sacred Pages and turn them in you and the Purgers will exorcize the Demon.

rows.short_description: Follow the very unique premise of an indie horror game about a demo-.... ok maybe not so unique, but we have a dog so there's that.
rows.description_html: FIDO is a short, top down horror game about a dogsitter's job gone wrong. Walk around three different stages, complete dogsitter tasks, and avoid Fido. To win, you must translate demon runes to fend off Fido while collecting the items needed to exorcise the dog! Just a quick little indie game made for class :) Features (Potential Spoilers): - Three different stages of the game - Different goals and mechanics for each stage - Fetch Quests and 'stealth' section - Exploration and discovery - Unique 'Translation' mechanic (translate runes flying at you to keyboard letters, and press them all in time to keep Fido at bay) - Roughly 15-30min playtime - A main menu

rows.name: Five Stages of Pink
rows.short_description: Horror mystery about a boy who desperately wants a Normal life in the most abnormal city in the world. Help Timor understand his cruel life in this supernatural city while trying to survive one more day. In a universe where Sleep is an illness. This is a visual novel with point and click features.
rows.description_html: Follow the overwhelming life of Timor who desperately tries to find some Normalcy in a very supernatural city where the color pink is forbidden because of its dark history. Timor is a teenager and teenagers suffer from high curiosity. You will help him elucidate Septeek city's many hidden mysteries and dark past while trying to not get kidnapped (and killed?) a third time because of reasons he doesn't even know (yet). In a universe where Sleep is an illness and Timor has to deal with it. This game has : - A 'Complete your Journal' task that encourages the player to investigate everything about the characters and the mysteries around them. - A very large cast of +20 main characters with rich stories. - Deep family dramas and friendship struggles. - But also lots of wholesome family and friendship love. - Freedom time in the day where the player can move around in the vast choices of settings and choose with who or what to interact with. - Meaning : multiple side story tangents but following one big main plot. This is an episodic visual novel with point and click features. The gameplay is there to accompany the story and not the other way around. Chapter 0 is Free !

rows.name: Moonstuck
rows.short_description: Relaxing rage game in a cutesy wholesome Moonstuck land. Delicate jump-balancing rage platformer where your job is to escape, while staying relaxed.
rows.description_html: You’re far from home and you’re all alone, but there’s some soothing music keeping you going and your mood is pretty high. You just have to get off this rock. You are Moonstuck. An intriguing hybrid of ‘rage game’ and chill, wholesome experience, Moonstuck will push you to your limits of endurance, but keep your mind centered and relaxed the entire time. Navigate a huge winding labyrinth of traps and hazards in the safety of your little ship by delicately bouncing your boosts and directions until you’re free. Your boosters won't last forever, so you'll need to carefully and consistently shift a little bit here and there to make your way through. You can do it though, it's fine. With checkpoints, a calm atmosphere and a pastel colour palette, Moonstuck is designed for you to succeed, if only you have the patience. The entire game is available for free, so the only thing you need to spend is your time. Try it out, and see how this strange experiment into the chill, relaxing rage game subgenre plays out for you. See if you can get home. See if you can escape from being Moonstuck . - One-button platform gameplay that is easy to pick up yet hard to master - A soothing chill lo-fi soundtrack that'll keep your mood stabilised as you try and get 'unstuck' - Carefully placed checkpoints so that nothing ever gets too much for you - A rocky terrain in a far off land for you to float, jet and fly through - Hazards and landmarks that will challenge your ability to keep flying - A unique hybrid 2D platforming arcade style between rage game and chill-'em-up - An immediate restart so you won't get too angry - Kinda like the rage games you've played before ( Getting Over It, Jump King ) but way more relaxing - Tough but addictive gameplay - Entirely free!

The entire game is available for free, so the only thing you need to spend is your time. Try it out, and see how this strange experiment into the chill, relaxing rage game subgenre plays out for you. See if you can get home. See if you can escape from being Moonstuck . - One-button platform gameplay that is easy to pick up yet hard to master - A soothing chill lo-fi soundtrack that'll keep your mood stabilised as you try and get 'unstuck' - Carefully placed checkpoints so that nothing ever gets too much for you - A rocky terrain in a far off land for you to float, jet and fly through - Hazards and landmarks that will challenge your ability to keep flying - A unique hybrid 2D platforming arcade style between rage game and chill-'em-up - An immediate restart so you won't get too angry - Kinda like the rage games you've played before ( Getting Over It, Jump King ) but way more relaxing - Tough but addictive gameplay - Entirely free!

rows.name: Planet S
rows.short_description: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction.
rows.description_html: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction. The world consists of up to 24 procedurally generated planets which you can colonize. A planets type affects things like the appearance, the farm productivity and the kind of resources you can find on it. You start the game with a spaceship and enough materials to colonize your first planet. Uncolonized planets can be claimed by building a spaceport on it. Once you claimed a planet, you can integrate it into your economy! To advance your faction and unlock new buildings you need to attract residents and provide them the goods they require. By gaining more and more residents, you will unlock new production chains which will increase in complexity. At some point, your first planet won't be able to supply you with the resources you need, so you need to expand to other planets. While you start your population with workers, you need to make a decision when you advance to the second tier. You can upgrade your residents to the science or military civilization type. You can adjust the direction in an adjacent city center. Your decision will determine your path for the game and set a focus on either a more peacefully or a violent way of playing and winning the game. It may be rational to carefully consider your decision and adapt to the situation you are in. Residents of a civilization type generate either science or military research points, which you can invest into research. The two research trees unlock bonuses and unique buildings for the corresponding civilization type. Through that, the game experience will rely heavily on the path you select. You can play alone or with up to seven friends. You can either practice diplomacy and negotiate agreements, or act militarily against each other. Coupled with the fact that each player can build his civilization differently, every game remains exciting.

rows.name: Frostbitten
rows.short_description: Frostbitten takes you into the depths of a national park's snow-ridden forest; a place notorious for consuming those who enter. Through the eyes of a park ranger in this survival horror experience, discover the dark secrets that lie beyond the clearing…
rows.description_html: You're ending the day at your assigned post when you receive a call from the chief ranger. A colleague, and friend, who is stationed in a nearby sector has failed to report back for a day or so... You are requested to investigate his whereabouts only to find his ranger station in disarray, with no one left in sight. You then venture into the snow-ridden forest, dread setting in, as you realize something is amiss... Be the Ranger Make your way through the forest as Thomas, a park ranger for White Valley National Park, as a strange presence lurks among the trees. Survive the night equipped only with a flashlight, shovel, and lighter. Immerse Yourself Experience the isolation, paranoia, and mysterious air of a dark, winter forest alive with the sounds of night. Strategize Your Escape Use your shovel to create barriers between you and your impending death, but whatever you do, don't stare at it for too long. Explore the Park With a flashlight as your guiding light, discover the clues that will bring you closer to the truth. NOTE: This game is in its open Beta phase and is the product of a student development team . We are very appreciative of everyone who takes the time to play our game and welcome the feedback!

rows.name: Albert Innovation
rows.short_description: Albert Innovation is an immersive, narrative, atmospheric semi-horror game, where you will attempt to unravel the mysteries of what was once the most brilliant technological innovation company of the olden days. Manipulate machines, run away, and put an end to this nightmare.
rows.description_html: Albert Innovation, a company known for its extraordinary technological innovations, offers you a job. But when you arrive, no one is there to greet you... you realize you are on your own to find the mysterious boss Albert Thompson. Through the deserted premises, interact with special devices developed by former engineers to explore the premises and try to uncover the company's disturbing past. But beware, because you are not alone in this place... Hand-drawn monochrome 3D graphics creating a dark and unique. An immersive audio universe composed by Virgil Marrel Astonishing devices to hold in your hand to progress There is a threat to you and to these places... This is the Albert Innovation demo, then once the game is released in its entirety, it will be paid for. -Delirium Den

rows.name: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game
rows.short_description: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game is an online DBG which contains a PVE mode called Uncharted Realms and a PVP mode. Every game is a deck building from scratch. Players can have stronger decks by changing cards, and then build more powerful routines to defeat all opponents to win.
rows.description_html: Cards Building You will draw a lot of cards on the path of cultivation. You need to choose the appropriate cards from them and build your deck. Exert biggest power of your cards by combining and collocating them. Sub-Profession In each game, you can choose a Sub-Profession. Each Sub-Profession has a set of exclusive cards. The same character can build different deck by matching different Sub-Profession, and obtain different game experiences. The mechanism of Character plus Sub-Profession can greatly increases the playability. Immortal Fates Immortal Fate is the gift of fate that the character receives on the path of cultivation. Every time you break through, multiple Immortal Fates will appear randomly according to the sect and character you choose. You need to choose your Immortal Fate. The effects of Immortal Fates are various, including card drawing, attribute increasing, and various passive effects, etc. Some Destines even require you to build a deck according to their effects. Fortunes On the path to cultivation, fortunes are also a part of strength. After each battle, there is a very small chance to encounter an fortune card. Through fortune cards, you can get Spiritual Pet cards, Talisman cards and Guild Secret Spell cards. These cards are very rare, and their strength may be similar to the regular cards of the same rank, but they often bring you new building ideas and help you create unique and rare decks. Battle with Other Players Each of your opponents are other players online, and everyone builds a deck from scratch. Every battle with your opponent will test your deck’s strength, and you will be eliminated if you lose multiple battles. Devise strategies, climb to the top of cultivation, and wait for you to battle!

rows.name: Nocturama
rows.short_description: Nocturama Bononia is a container of interactive comics, of an urban fantasy genre, set in a nocturnal Bologna. Different stories and characters but with a single common denominator: living the most important night of one's existence.
rows.description_html: Nocturama Bononia [/] is a container of interactive comics of the urban fantasy genre, set in a nocturnal Bologna. The stories are linked to places, monuments and city objects, located on a map of Bologna, and tell of different characters but with a single common denominator: living the most important night of one's existence [/]. Liber Paradisus[/] [/h2] 'This is the memorial of the male and female servants who were freed by the Municipality of Bologna ...' [/] Red has been in Italy for some time and is a rider. He is very tired from the continuous work. Called back by the company several times, he is forced to suffer and move forward, for himself and his family. There is someone who is waiting for him for the umpteenth delivery, a man who recites the memorial known as the Book of Paradise. And he seems really looking forward to meeting his rider. Ars Memoriae [/] [/] What are you willing to risk for a great story? [/] A narrator has lost all inspiration and wanders through the streets of Bologna under the moonlight. Entering the historic University Library, he finds a hooded figure who promises to help him if he will play a strange game, with a worn-out tarot deck. Gargoyle [/] [/] Son of Good. O Son of Evil. Without knowing where one or the other is. [/] A man wanders aimlessly after drinking all night, gripped by pain. When he finds a street corner where Good and Evil coexist, he will have to accept this paradox. And confront his demons. A seamstress' night[/] [/] One obsession: that your art is never forgotten. [/] After winning the most important tailoring award, Roberta was torn apart by critics. Obsessed with her work, she cut off every other relationship. The only leisure she allows herself is to spend a few minutes in the cloister of the Church of Santo Stefano, at the end of her working day. Here, one night, she finds a woman who proposes a pact to make her art immortal. The Wanderer[/] [/] The ultimate recipe for the control of souls, an inheritance at hand. And only a guy who can stop you. [/] Dasein is the last descendant of an ancient Academia, formed by the nobles who studied at the University of Bologna in the Archiginnasio. Here they accumulated the many ingredients needed to prepare Theriaca, an elixir to control human souls. And Dasein has only one obstacle to overcome to reach his inheritance: a boy. The Wanderer. Emma [/] [/] Emma is thirteen years old and has gotten lost in the large park of Villa Angeletti. As she searches her way home, she finds the macabre remains of previous visitors to the park, until she gets close to the banks of the Navile Canal. Here she discovers where those remains came from, and what lies hidden in the waters of the Canal. Requiescat [/] [/] Even if you are infallible, there are always those who will prove the opposite to you. Whether it is corporeal or not. [/] Dalia has been hunting ectoplasms for more than twenty years, and no ghost has ever deceived her. You receive a letter, a request for help from the ancient Villa Clara, just outside the city. The Slayer is suspicious, no one sends such letters anymore. And once she reaches the Villa she discovers that her suspicions are well founded. Perhaps she, for the first time, she was really deceived. Two soloists A promising pianist, a ruthless killer. Two soloists. Carlo, an acclaimed pianist, is about to debut at the Teatro Comunale. When he starts to play, each of his chords corresponds to a crime in the alleys of Bologna, carried out by a heinous murderer. Neither Carlo nor the murderer are able to stop: both are desperately seeking the applause of their audiences. Kairos What if Bologna is one of the Pillars of Time? Proarke and Sige are the two Guardians of Kairos, the temporal dimension, and have been resting for centuries, petrified in the form of Eagles set in the facade of Palazzo d'Accursio. But as the sundials and clocks of Bologna begin to melt, they awaken to try to understand who is endangering time. They discover that the cause has to do with their past, and with ancient, unsolved jealousies.

rows.name: Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea
rows.short_description: It is a free-to-play shooting game.You may choose 6 types of warships used in the WWII to play PvP and PvE naval battle. Start the voyage with your warships and fight for the honor of your fleet!
rows.description_html: “Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea” is a free-to-play, MMO shooting game. As a navy commander, you may choose 6 types of warships used in the World War II to fight the 16vs16 battles. Start the voyage with your warships and fight for the honor of your fleet! game Features: Essence of team play: Tactics first 6 warship types and over 100 famous warships with distinctive features. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea presents the 6 most representative warships of the modern and contemporary naval system, namely, destroyer, light cruiser, heavy cruiser, battleship, carrier, and particularly the “deep sea killer” – submarine, appearing for the first time. Deep Sea Assassin - D-Class Submarine Attacks. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea presents the nightmare of Atlantic ships for all captains, the famous deep-sea assassin - D-series submarine! German submarines with enhanced underwater speed, underwater endurance and torpedo loading capabilities have better lighting efficiency and a safer output environment. At this point, the complete lineup of wolves that the German Navy is proud of has officially debuted, and the fiery scene of wolves fighting will be particularly spectacular. The following is an introduction to the basic information of D-series submarines. Captains who like to play submarines can do their homework in advance： U-IIA (D series 2-class submarine): On the day when the Anglo-German naval agreement was passed, the new German submarine U-1 was officially launched. The new submarine is called Type 2A (Tpye IIA), which is mainly used for submarine crews. train and test. Due to their small tonnage, these submarines seldom conduct far-sea operations. U-VIIA (Class 3 submarine of D series): Type 7A is the basic prototype of Type 7 submarine. It is a new generation of medium-sized attack submarines built by the German Navy after World War I. This type of submarine was designed in 1933 and its main technology is based on World War I. The Type 3 submarine was improved. The performance of the Type 7 submarine is very good, and the diving speed is very good. U-VIIC (D series 4-class submarine): The 7C type is the most productive type of the 7-type submarine, and it is also one of the main submarines of the German submarine force during World War II. This type of boat is slightly longer than the 7B type, but does not improve the performance of the main engine, so the speed is reduced. U-VIIF (D class 5 submarine): As the threat of Allied aircraft to the submarine force was increasing, Germany thought of strengthening the submarine's air defense to counter the threat of air strikes. Some Type 7C submarines were converted into dedicated anti-aircraft submarines (U-Flak). These conversions added two to three quadruple 20mm anti-aircraft machine guns to the submarine, and experimentally added 37mm anti-aircraft guns. Anti-aircraft artillery, torpedo reserves were reduced. U-IXA (D series 6-level submarine): The 9A submarine was designed as the basic type of the 9-type submarine in 1935. It refers to the Type 1 submarine developed after the First World War. Its combat goal is to focus on ocean-going operations. The fuel tank and the torpedo attack capability were strengthened. U-IXC (D-Series 7th-class submarine): The 9C type adds an additional 43 tons of fuel tanks on the basis of its basic model, which further expands the sailing range. This series also removes the second periscope in the control room. In order to perform mine-laying tasks, the Type 9C also has additional mine chambers. U-IXD-2 (Class 8 submarine of the D series): Type 9D is the largest model among Type 9 submarines. The entire Type 9D is divided into 3 types due to different power systems. Type 9D2 is mainly based on Type 9D1. Its unreliable powertrain has been corrected. U-XXI (D series 9-class submarine): Type 21 is one of the new high-speed submarines developed by the German Navy during World War II. The boat was designed to increase the underwater speed as the main goal. Therefore, the shape and structure of the boat The design is very simple and streamlined, removing the useless deck guns, while increasing the battery capacity and improving the power system, giving it a strong underwater combat capability, the Type 21 has also become the prototype of modern submarines. Incorporating hundreds of classic tactics, and supporting the original tactic system. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea also restores hundreds of classic sea battle tactics and sea battle maps. The players may replay the “Wolf pack tactics”, “Competing for T head” and other famous tactics at real time, and independently design the new tactics based on the maps, natural environment, weather conditions, warship combination and other objective factors. Diversified competition modes, and team play varying from modes. The actual sea warfare is not merely the exchange of firepower. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea provides tens of combat modes, from the MOBA random matching for combat, the battle to seize the isle for testing the team tactics, to the short distance contact battle without isle, combat of small teams in different sizes, and even the super large legion PVP battlefield in the boundless water…, available to meet the different requirements of game players. Each mode includes several sets of applicable tactics and derivative skills, bringing the endless and changeable battlefield experience. Manual setting of multiple gun positions on the whole ship. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea adopts the manual control setting of the whole ship's gun positions, which can manually control multiple firepower points. Even in cruise mode, it can control the firepower from any angle and switch different attacking equipment, fully enjoying the real 'competitive competition, control' pleasure'. No island and all waters battlefield. For the first time, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea has added an island-free mode to the 3DTPS vehicle naval battle online game, simulating a real sea encounter situation, greatly improving the mobility of combat units, creating an unfettered battlefield in the entire waters, and avoiding the embarrassing situation of 'all people squatting'. Various lighting and striking methods. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea uses the water surface inertial simulation system to create real ballistics and ship inertial displacement, which greatly increases the cost of attacking moving targets. Only by constantly moving and changing the travel path during the battle can the player escape the fierce artillery fire and become the last king! Highly immersive interactive map to restore World War II scenarios. The development team of Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea accurately simulates the isles, reefs, buildings, metrological, weather conditions, etc. of many sea areas in the world, based on the results of consulting extensive historic records and many times of site surveys, and the actual geographic environment data. Separated Damage Calculation system to ensure more accurate attack. In addition to the original damage calculation by health bars of the TPS vehicle war games, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea is incorporated with the separated damage calculation system (“SDC”). Commanded by hundreds of officers of World War II, providing warships with tactic soul. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea includes the innovative warship commander system, incorporated with hundreds of famous navy generals during the 2nd World War, based on the actual history of the period, to impart the cold warships with the different tactic features. Unique legion system to create super marine legions. The fleet guild system provides a big platform for players to communicate on tactics, and also combines the team play and the fleet growth mechanism into one. Built-in radio voice to effectively restore maritime communication. One of the most critical factors deciding the success or failure of a military operation is intelligence. The information communication at any place and at any time is the basis for the battle with the team collaboration, and the key for realizing the strategic cooperation of multiple warship types in the modern sea battles.

Incorporating hundreds of classic tactics, and supporting the original tactic system. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea also restores hundreds of classic sea battle tactics and sea battle maps. The players may replay the “Wolf pack tactics”, “Competing for T head” and other famous tactics at real time, and independently design the new tactics based on the maps, natural environment, weather conditions, warship combination and other objective factors. Diversified competition modes, and team play varying from modes. The actual sea warfare is not merely the exchange of firepower. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea provides tens of combat modes, from the MOBA random matching for combat, the battle to seize the isle for testing the team tactics, to the short distance contact battle without isle, combat of small teams in different sizes, and even the super large legion PVP battlefield in the boundless water…, available to meet the different requirements of game players. Each mode includes several sets of applicable tactics and derivative skills, bringing the endless and changeable battlefield experience. Manual setting of multiple gun positions on the whole ship. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea adopts the manual control setting of the whole ship's gun positions, which can manually control multiple firepower points. Even in cruise mode, it can control the firepower from any angle and switch different attacking equipment, fully enjoying the real 'competitive competition, control' pleasure'. No island and all waters battlefield. For the first time, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea has added an island-free mode to the 3DTPS vehicle naval battle online game, simulating a real sea encounter situation, greatly improving the mobility of combat units, creating an unfettered battlefield in the entire waters, and avoiding the embarrassing situation of 'all people squatting'. Various lighting and striking methods. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea uses the water surface inertial simulation system to create real ballistics and ship inertial displacement, which greatly increases the cost of attacking moving targets. Only by constantly moving and changing the travel path during the battle can the player escape the fierce artillery fire and become the last king! Highly immersive interactive map to restore World War II scenarios. The development team of Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea accurately simulates the isles, reefs, buildings, metrological, weather conditions, etc. of many sea areas in the world, based on the results of consulting extensive historic records and many times of site surveys, and the actual geographic environment data. Separated Damage Calculation system to ensure more accurate attack. In addition to the original damage calculation by health bars of the TPS vehicle war games, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea is incorporated with the separated damage calculation system (“SDC”). Commanded by hundreds of officers of World War II, providing warships with tactic soul. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea includes the innovative warship commander system, incorporated with hundreds of famous navy generals during the 2nd World War, based on the actual history of the period, to impart the cold warships with the different tactic features. Unique legion system to create super marine legions. The fleet guild system provides a big platform for players to communicate on tactics, and also combines the team play and the fleet growth mechanism into one. Built-in radio voice to effectively restore maritime communication. One of the most critical factors deciding the success or failure of a military operation is intelligence. The information communication at any place and at any time is the basis for the battle with the team collaboration, and the key for realizing the strategic cooperation of multiple warship types in the modern sea battles.

rows.name: Welcome, Get Out!
rows.short_description: 'Welcome, Get Out!' is a puzzle game where the cranky narrator really doesn't like you being there. It is a Point&Click comedy adventure that will take you through 7 different hand-crafted levels against the wishes of the sarcastic narrator who is trying to stop you from succeeding.
rows.description_html: ' Welcome, Get Out! ' is a puzzle game where the cranky narrator really doesn't like you being there. It is a Point&Click comedy adventure that will take you through 7 different hand-crafted levels against the wishes of the sarcastic narrator who is trying to stop you from succeeding. As you play, you'll click, drag, and tap your way through a variety of puzzles. The narrator will be discouraging, but if you listen closely, they will tell you how to complete the puzzle. Will you best him? Features A Point&Click adventure. No need for a Keyboard or a Controller! Touch screen support. Your finger is like a mouse, right? Fully 2D graphics bundled with smooth animations. Nearly fully voiced. So you can hear the sarcasm too! A quick game. It can be finished in under an hour. The Levels The Main Menu - You need to start the game somehow too, right? Rock Paper Scissors - Don't break anything. Press The Button - Button Mashing Time! The Box - Unlock it to find a way through. The Clock - Even narrators need to know the time. The Machine - I think it's missing some pieces. The Code - Likely shouldn't touch that. Festivals This project was presented at Columbia College Chicago's Manifest 2021! This project was also presented at Electrify! Esports, Education, Innovation 2021!

rows.name: 8/8/88 Needle AL
rows.short_description: On the ominous date of 8/8/1888, the entire population of Needle, Alabama seemingly vanished, leaving behind only a haunting silence and an eerie sense of dread. A first-person psychological-horror drama.
rows.description_html: Old Godfrey returns from his morning walk to find the town eerily deserted. Where did the townsfolk vanish to? And what could have caused such a devastating outcome? Unravel the twisted mystery and uncover the heart-wrenching tragedy that befell this cursed town. Immerse yourself in the stunningly realistic 3D photography of 8/8/88 Needle AL, a game that seamlessly blends the visual-novel and point-and-click adventure genres to create a dark gaming experience unlike any other. With a bone-chilling storyline about a cult, corruption, and racism in the post Civil War south, this game is a must-play for horror fans who loved our previous title 'Wardwell House'.

rows.name: Ren's Demons I
rows.short_description: Did you think this game was only about saving the world from an army of demons? No. This is a game about YOU. On the surface, it may be a new form of innovative experimental philosophical narrative RPG, but its deeper secrets could make you a god.
rows.description_html: You . This is a game about you. When you clicked play, did you even wonder what it meant? Did you believe it would only be about saving a dark world from an army of demons? Did you think about games that blew your mind and pushed beyond the boundaries? Did you anticipate the powers that you would gain? Did you assume it was just a game? -------------------------------- Ren is the Promised Child , chosen by the Goddess to save the world from the forces of darkness. But nobody expected that this quest would transcend the boundaries between universes and bring a new understanding of the fabric of reality itself. In this experimental philosophical narrative RPG you will find A non-linear universe full of optional content for you to explore A quirky narrative battle system A minimalist atypical colorful art style An entirely original cross-platform game engine built for the project Favorite old school RPG features coming back: walk on the world map, name your characters, and more A procedurally generated world different for every player 15 unique characters to invite to your party, more than 74 monsters to encounter 7 different endings Between 5 and 30 hours of content depending on how exploratory you feel -------------------------------- Translation This game engine is written in web technologies. You can launch the game in your own web browser using the index.html file in the game folder. When you do that, you can use your browser translation to play the game in any language. However, the experience will be very impaired (there are wordplays, riddles, and other non translatable quirks...).

rows.name: Banana Shooter
rows.short_description: Dave is the banana man who is keep shooting enemies and get their banana,and use some cool mechanic such as dash,double jump,grapple hook and rocket jump.If you are finding fast paced shooter game,this is what you need
rows.description_html: In this game, you are not a banana, you are Dave, because you like to eat bananas, so the banana is taken away, the only way to get it is to kill other Dave. When you have the highest kill count, you will will get bananas. The whole game is a multiplayer battle type, you can configure your own gun or knife to fight against others. There are multiple maps in the game, you can get coins by killing enemies to upgrade, you can upgrade the movement speed, The upper limit of blood volume, but if you are accidentally killed, all upgrades will be cleared, which is a bit similar to roguelike, but it is a multiplayer battle type. And the map has a very hot back room recently, and my favorite strange core, which will definitely make your eyes shine.

rows.short_description: A minimalist top down shooter with slimes.

The main goal of the game is to go on slime collection missions & collect enough slime to meet your quota by shooting enemy slimes & collecting their blood with a tractor beam. Randomly generated levels & procedural enemy generation Unlockable weapons, different area styles, and different game modes. Retro styled VFX & SFX. Lots and lots of pixel carnage.

rows.name: Collapsed
rows.short_description: Challenge your mind with a 3D physics-based puzzle game. Take control of a cannon and use your limited supply of cannonballs to bring each level crashing to the ground. Using gravity, momentum, and logic, plan how to knock down each structure and leave nothing standing after the collapse!
rows.description_html: Using your intuitive understanding of physics, challenge yourself to complete each of the 50 levels and bring about a collapse in this puzzle and logic game. Select from three different types of cannonballs - normal, polished, or fire. Normal: just a heavy piece of metal to lob at fortresses. Polished: launches at high velocity - perfect for taking out stubborn targets. Fireball: does exactly what you expect - sets wood on fire! Each level contains structures made from a wide variety of individual pieces. Collapse houses, castles, and more with a varied selection of levels and components. Once every piece has been destroyed or has fallen to the ground, the level is completed. The more cannonballs you have remaining at the end of each level, the higher you will score!

rows.name: J-Jump Arena
rows.short_description: J-Jump Arena is a free-to-play, turn-based elimination party game, in which you'll probably blow yourself up - but still have a good time doing it! Think you’ve got the brains to survive the chaos?
rows.description_html: Jump, Predict, Outsmart! All moves happen at once in this fast-paced, free-to-play turn-based game! It’s like Rock, Paper, Scissors… on steroids! In J-Jump Arena, you’ll plan your moves, then watch the madness unfold as everyone acts at once.  Chaos guaranteed. Carefully predict your opponents’ actions and outmaneuver them to stay in the game. Let's be real, though... You’ll probably blow yourself up, but that’s half the fun. Various Game Modes to Keep You on Your Toes Get ready for a wild ride with a range of game modes! Fight to be the last one standing in chaotic Last Man Standing , or dominate the battlefield with the most kills in Deathmatch . Prove who's boss in intense 1 vs 1 Duels , and keep on your toes in Disappearing Platforms , where the floor vanishes under your feet. Race to victory while blasting foes in Weapon Race . And if you're all about showing off your jumping skills, Treasure Hunt 's got you covered - out-jump your rivals and snatch up the most gems! Unleash Mayhem with a Wild Arsenal Wreak havoc with over 20 weapons , each more chaotic than the last! Get inventive with the Quacknator 9001 , a rubber duck that either explodes or hilariously swells up after each turn. Or freeze your enemies in their tracks with the icy Frostcore . And if you truly despise someone, nothing says revenge quite like hurling a Jar of Mosquitos right at ’em. Prefer to go old-school? The Revolver , Grenade , and Bazooka are all locked and loaded, ready to bring the destruction. Whether you're tactical or trigger-happy, there's a weapon for every style of chaos! Explore Diverse Environments From treacherous Swamps to the fiery pits of Hell , each map brings its own dangers and chaos. Want to challenge gravity? Take your fight to the low-gravity madness on the Moon ! Or crawl through the ashes of civilization in the Postapocalypse arenas, where radiation is your new best mate. With even more unique locations, every arena forces you to adapt, improvise, or get left behind in the dust. Rich Customization Unlock ridiculous gear and cosmetic nonsense to make your fighter stand out... or stand out for all the wrong reasons. Either way, you’ll look glorious doing it. Features: Simple, easy-to-learn mechanics. Multiplayer mayhem with up to 10 players. Solo mode with bots for practice or casual play. Multiple game modes to keep things fresh. Unlock items and customize your character. Earn Steam Achievements to show off your skills. Think you’ve got the brains to survive the chaos? Prove it, sunshine.

rows.name: The Hand of Glory - The Blowtorch Files
rows.short_description: A young girl, Erica Thimber, vanishes into thin air overnight. Is it a classic teen runaway? That's not what Lazarus Bundy, renowned serial killer hunter in charge of the case, believes.
rows.description_html: Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2 Click here to check the sequel to 'The Hand of Glory' - wishlist Roots in the Sky - The Hand of Glory 2 NOW! THE HAND OF GLORY Check the game now - 97% positive reviews on Steam! About the Game A young girl, Erica Thimber, vanishes into thin air overnight. Is it a classic teen runaway? That's not what Lazarus Bundy, renowned serial killer hunter in charge of the case, believes. It is up to you, senior analyst, to help Bundy with his investigation, providing technical support and assistance. Will you shed additional light on the mystery? Or will you end up being burned by it? Prequel to the acclaimed 'The Hand of Glory' (97% positive reviews on Steam) Same setting, different formula: instead of a traditional point & click adventure, in 'The Blowtorch Files' you will face an innovative text adventure Not only text, but puzzles too: use your sight, your hearing, and conduct research in your browser in order to solve the case! Help Lazarus Bundy stop the individual who's been terrorizing Miami

rows.short_description: Compete with your friends in this 3v1 asymmetrical party game. Team up as one of the piecelings or wreak havoc as the Mapster in an exciting race against time!
rows.description_html: Experience a new take on the party game genre with Mapstermind’s array of cute characters, two unique game boards with exciting mechanics, and one evil pair of floating hands! Choose Your Character Pick from 9 uniquely adorable Piecelings or don the white gloves of the Mapster! Complete Cooperative Tasks As the Piecelings Be a giant clam’s stylist, catch a home run, bring a mermaid her crown, and much more! Unleash the Mapster’s Devastating Attacks Utilize the Mapster’s custom control board to set traps and launch attacks to delay the Piecelings! Compete On Two Unique Game Boards City Take a tour of the city and explore its many famous landmarks. Avoid the hustle and bustle of this urban environment and return order to the city! Seafloor In this underwater stage, Piecelings help the Mermaid recover her lost items. Beware of the sea life and other aquatic hazards!

rows.name: Tournament of Beans
rows.short_description: Tournament of Beans is a unique PvP game where you can alter the map to your advantage.
rows.description_html: Tournament of Beans: A high action, PvP, 2D physics fighter. Control a bean that has the power to add weapons, blocks, and other things to the map before the game begins. Use this power to crush your opponent with strategic placement. Over 18 placeable blocks, weapons and objects for gameplay variation and strategies. For people with no friends, ToB has a single player mode. In this mode you rush through levels as fast as possible. Die and your progress resets completely. Join the discord!
