rows.name: Loskop
rows.short_description: Experience a new type of puzzle-solving in this new linear second and first person puzzle solving game. Control the little robot also known as Loskop and help him escape his old factory and out into the wild.
rows.description_html: Loskop is a single-player puzzle game where you are the only one to blame in the end if Loskop the Junkbot never gets to see the outside world. You are being put behind the wheel of the robot and will maybe through what is considered mostly luck and grain of determination guide the robot through the old factory and to the outside world. The obstacles you will find on the way will challenge your previously gained experience from other games and most likely give you a headache or some grey hairs. Experience a different type of puzzle solving that you arent used to. By introducing the concept of second person puzzle solving you will meet and have to interact with puzzels that you cant solve from refrencing older games. Complete levels one by one in a linear structure.

rows.name: Rival Rides
rows.short_description: Rival Rides - the ultimate VR PARTY game! Compete, laugh, and mess with your friends in a 4-player online setting.Uncover ridiculously fun games. Who will dominate the competition? Strap on your VR headset, hop on your ride, and dive into a world of hilarity and excitement. Ready, set, ride!
rows.description_html: Rival Rides is an exciting multiplayer VR party game taking place in an out-of-this-world theme park. Compete with your friends online in various games and wild rides, in order to collect the highest amount of golden egg trophies and become the Rival Ride’s champion! Discover 4 fun action-packed games offering different challenges and clever uses for your VR headset. Race through a wild underground cart-ride while you switch your own or your rivals' routes. Fight against evil monsters with various weapons in a fast and scary haunted house ride. Jetpack your way through zero-gravity while shooting lasers at each other, or just try not to burn everything when you cook yummy meals for the theme park’s very hungry guests. Don’t forget to customize your appearance, and choose from a variety of awesome and hilarious outfits to outshine your rivals. So, what are you waiting for? Hop on in and join the ride! Race against the clock as you cook some yummy dishes for the very hungry park visitors, while trying to slow down your rivals in the wackiest and most hilarious ways. Let the food fight begin! Did you know? All the ingredients we use in our tasty dishes are imported from “Foodland”, where life is like an endless All-you-can-eat buffet, but the residents somehow always stay in shape. It’s a mystery! Race through an underground railroad and switch railways while picking up various weapons and diamonds with unique abilities! This exciting ride is inspired by the muddy “Earthland” where everybody lives deep underground. Did you know? Our hard-working “Rival Rides” employees mined each one of the “Earthland” diamonds themselves! Try to survive this scary ride! Shield yourself using your cart’s blue button, or push the red one to draw a random weapon and bust these paranormal beings. This haunted ride is inspired by the infamous “Monsterland”, where demons, ghouls, and ghosts all manage to get along with each other in perfect disharmony. Be careful! While officially the monsters in this ride are our employees, they do tend to take their job way too seriously sometimes. Use your jetpack to float through space and shoot lasers at your rivals. But try not to hit the hovering rocks because some of them might bounce your lasers right back at you! Inspired by the faraway “Cosmicland” where there’s no gravity, asteroids are everywhere, and the word oxygen has no meaning. Did you know? Our giant turtle is equipped with huge rockets that allow it to make its way all the way up to space and back.

rows.name: Cyphers Game VR
rows.short_description: It is the end of 1920. The Polish-Bolshevik war has been going on for almost two years. The battle for Korosteń – a key railway junction and technical supply base – is underway. Break Bolshevik cyphers, ensure radio communication, and neutralise the fearsome armoured trains - now in Virtual Reality.
rows.description_html: DISCOVER THE DEEPEST MYSTERIES OF ESPIONAGE AND FEEL THE RUSH OF VICTORY IN VIRTUAL REALITY Take the role of soldiers, cryptologists, and communication experts during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920! Operate historical communication devices, decode enemy ciphers, and gain access to secret information that shaped the outcome of the war. Discover the inner workings of Bolshevik armored trains and participate in crucial missions that led to Poland’s victory. Every aspect of the game has been meticulously crafted with the help of source materials or accurately replicated from historical exhibits. Players engage in documented historical events, with each character assigned a unique, vital role in determining the battle’s outcome. Now you can experience it in Virtual Reality! Key Features: A captivating story inspired by real events and featuring authentic Polish cryptographers and soldiers from the Polish-Bolshevik War Elements of stealth, cryptographic puzzles, and interaction with historical communication devices Attention to historical detail, with all devices and elements in the game carefully recreated from source materials and historical artifacts Gameplay that blends action, puzzle-solving, and exploration, offering a unique combination of education and entertainment in Virtual Reality

rows.short_description: Third person shooter with minor platforming. You have to eliminate the condiment threat.
rows.description_html: You play as a jar of mayonnaise who has to launch mayo at some bottles before they get to you. You will have to jump around to avoid them as they approach because if they touch you too many times, you lose. Stay on the shelf and stay alive. Game includes third person shooting Minor 'platforming' Jumping jar of mayonnaise Aggressive condiments (ketchup, mustard, relish, and bbq sauce) Mayo splat sound

rows.name: AQtion
rows.short_description: Get ready for intense, skill-based FPS action with AQtion! Featuring the best of Action Quake 2, enjoy fast-paced combat, realistic weapons, and thrilling multiplayer battles. Dominate the arena now on Steam!
rows.description_html: Lights, Camera, ACTION! Experience the adrenaline-fueled intensity of classic first-person shooter action with AQtion, the ultimate evolution of the beloved mod, Action Quake 2. AQtion combines the latest engine enhancements with the signature gameplay mechanics and updates from the Action Quake community, delivering a nostalgic yet revitalized gaming experience. Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat where every move counts. With realistic weapon handling, limited ammunition, and a focus on tactical gameplay, AQtion tests your reflexes and strategic thinking like never before. Master the art of precision shooting, maneuver through dynamic environments, and outsmart your opponents in heart-pounding battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Featuring regularly updated game modes and features, engine enhancements and an active pickup game community, AQtion brings the classic Action Quake 2 experience into the modern era. Jump into the action and unleash your skills in intense multiplayer matches or thrilling single-player challenges. If you're an old school veteran to first person shooters, this is the Action Quake 2 you remember, with the original charm and modern enhancements you would come to expect. If you're new to the scene, welcome to what classic first person shooters are all about!

rows.name: GoRogue
rows.short_description: GoRogue is Third person shooter with multiplayer support.
rows.description_html: Gorogue First person & third person shooter with multi player support via epic games, single play mode is also supported. Based on Unreal Engine Lyra Sample Game modified to include first person mode in 'Last Standing' and 'Firing Range', also SciFi map and City Map with option to change character in the main menu. Extra weapons (rocket launcher etc). Free to play with multiple game modes including quick play mode, host a match and search for a hosted match online. The game modes include elimination mode where the objective is to find an eliminate enough enemies. A second game mode is included where the object is to secure the control points with your team mates in order to increase your score and win. Also included is capture the flag and last player standing . Copyright 2021 – 2022, Dromosys All rights reserved. GoRogue uses Unreal® Engine. rows.name: Coalescence
rows.short_description: Coalescence is a visual novel that takes you deep within Moniker Labs to explore its secrets. Play as one of three characters, each with their own storyline and dialogue options. Form relationships with the companions you encounter and try to make it out alive!
rows.description_html: About the Game Coalescence is a visual novel that invites you into a corrupted facility known as Moniker Labs for a night of festivities, romance, and terror! Key Features As you explore Moniker's halls, you'll meet several people who have all been affected by the corporation in some capacity. These unique individuals come from a variety of backgrounds and express themselves in distinctive ways. This makes your dialogue choices very important if you want them to trust you, reveal secrets, help you in your endeavors, or depending on what you find most important; flirt! Play as one of three characters, each with their own backstory, motivation for investigating, and special abilities to use in dialogue. Playable Characters A cunning reporter who will stop at nothing to uncover the truth behind Moniker. With their strong experience in investigative reporting, the Journalist can use the Investigate ability to ask insightful questions that gives more information on the current subject. A private investigator who’s been pulled into a bigger case than they ever could’ve realized. From their many years on the force, the Detective , a now free agent gone rogue is able to use Deduction to pick up on small details that help get a better picture of the situation. A scientist who’s been forced into the Moniker conspiracy due to an incident on the job at the very facility under investigation. With their newfound ability, [REDACTED] , the Lab Tech aims to stop Moniker’s plot by any means necessary! Additional Content Enjoy Coalescence? Try Dissent! The product of a game jam that lead to the creation of this award winning release! Expand the story with the prologue game that built a foundation for our development team to iterate and evolve.

rows.short_description: Pick up, fire and dodge the bombs! An action-packed multiplayer casual shooter with basic moves but still easy to play.
rows.description_html: A multiplayer game with one Boss player and multiple tiny players. Boss players dodge the attacks of players and attack using their throwing items, grenade launcher, hammers, etc., and tiny players perform cooperative play to attack huge Boss players. tiny players' means of attack consist of regular bombs and explosive bombs, and chemical bombs that temporarily blind the opponent. An electronic bomb that temporarily limits an opponent's movement, a painkiller bomb that removes all restrictions and restores energy. The basic map terrain of the game is in the form of a cube, and in the future, we plan to allow users to create and distribute custom maps and to play the game in more diverse backgrounds. rows.name: 7Groves
rows.short_description: A game in which you explore surreal and beautiful forests.
rows.description_html: There's no rush. Just take a leisurely stroll through beautiful and surreal forests that look like paintings come alive. 7Groves is a relaxing game of exploration and walking simulator. You can take your time exploring the game's strange worlds. Along the way, you'll collect items and complete puzzles to explore the furthest reaches of the game and experience all seven dream-like worlds. 7Groves is a labour of love and started life as a graphics demo that was meant to have 3d worlds look like 2d paintings. I've had a lot of comments that the game looks like it has been AI generated, but it is not. The painterly effects are achieved with loads of deferred lights, the creative use of textures as well as tons of post processing, including real-time Kuwahara filters. I hope you enjoy wandering about these pretty -entirely human generated- forests as much as I enjoyed making them! - Explore 7 strange worlds - Enjoy beautiful 3d graphics that look like impressionistic paintings that have come alive - Collect and puzzle to unlock all areas of the game - Listen to gorgeous choral soundtracks tailored to the game's environments

rows.name: FreedroidRPG
rows.short_description: FreedroidRPG is an open source sci-fi role playing game, where the player fights against hordes of bots in order to free humanity from rebel bots whom know no mercy.
rows.description_html: FreedroidRPG is an open source role playing game. The game tells the story of a world destroyed by a conflict between robots and their human masters. Play as Tux in a quest to save the world from the murderous rebel bots who know no mercy. You get to choose which path you wish to follow, and freedom of choice is everywhere in the game. FreedroidRPG features a real time combat system with melee and ranged weapons, fairly similar to the proprietary game Diablo. There is an innovative system of programs that can be run in order to take control of enemy robots, alter their behavior, or improve one's characteristics. You can use over 50 different kinds of items and fight countless enemies on your way to your destiny. An advanced dialog system provides story background and immersive role playing situations. The game is complete, fully playable, and can provide about 12 hours of fun. While release 1.0 is stable, it is still being actively developed, and help is welcome in many areas. People having - or trying to acquire - programming, map editing, or writing skills will find FreedroidRPG to be an exciting, fast-moving project in which they can fully express their creativity.

rows.name: Two Colours
rows.short_description: Jump from platform to platform, red to blue, blue to red, timing your jumps precisely, and dodging falls and blocks which kill you over the course of 40 levels, grabbing the 20 collectibles to unlock a secret at the end of the game. Don't lose your focus, don't lose your patience.
rows.description_html: Two Colours is a simple platformer with three, core concepts: you have to keep moving, you have to stay patient, and you can't lose your focus. Combining the traditional elements of a platformer with the idea of certain platforms ping-ponging from being safe to stand on to being dangerous to stand on, Two Colours features 20 basic levels, 20 advanced levels, 20 keys to collect, and a secret to unlock at the end of the game. As additional features unlock over the course of the game, making the game increase in difficulty as you progress, you must keep your focus. You primarily have two seconds to get onto and to get off of the red and blue platforms as they bounce back and forth from being platforms which you can stand on, and platforms which will kill you, as you try to reach the golden blocks to beat the level. Don't lose your focus, don't lose your patience. Rushing is a sure-fire way to death and frustration.

rows.short_description: BEWBEWBEW is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game!
rows.description_html: BEWBEWBEW is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game! Completely original fighting system! Charge spawns before releasing them in one big wave. Fights are all about optimizing your move usage to hit as many spawns as possible. A ton of playable characters and abilities! 50+ characters, each with their own set of abilities from a pool of 150+ unique moves of different types, elements, and usage. No two characters play the exact same! Partake in intense 1-vs-1 and whole party fights! Each side can have up to 3 party members. Hectically switching between your party members to burn through all your Energy and cooldowns is key! Hand-drawn graphics! Nearly every sprite and background in this game was drawn on paper first before being digitally colored, all done to make the art pop out. Combine different attacks for devastating effects! Set embers ablaze to start a fire! Place down a lightning rod before using a shock attack to do massive damage! Plant seeds and grow spiky roses! Play through 70+ fun levels, including a challenging Adventure mode! Some levels have unique twists and conditions. Be ready for anything! Endless Classic mode! Unlock characters and play through an endless gauntlet of levels as your power up your party!

rows.name: WordWar
rows.short_description: Word War is a unique party game based on making words. Fight for the letters in the Arena and try to create words with them in order to score points.
rows.description_html: What is it? WordWar is a couch multiplayer game from 1 to 4 players. Its particular aspect is that it combines word game goals with chaotic couch game dynamics. In fact, the players have to fight for the letters scattered in the Arena in order to build words and score points What it looks like? In WordWar you will chase the opponents to steal the letters they have and try to carry them on your team's base. A big part of the game is based on throwing the letters around, to your teammate (pass) or to your opponents (hit) - this last part is the funniest one😂 You can write any word with 2 or 3 letters, so be creative!

rows.name: Equinox
rows.short_description: Equinox is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter. Equinox mixes advanced movement techniques and projectile-based combat, producing a high-skill combat system. The game's objective is to capture the enemy's flag with adjustable team size, max score and match time.
rows.description_html: Equinox is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter. Equinox mixes advanced movement techniques and projectile-based combat, producing a high-skill combat system. The game's objective is to capture the enemy's flag with adjustable team size, max score and match time. Developed initially as a school project using Unreal Engine with a group of programmers and artists, the game evolved into something more. Key Features Objective-Based Gameplay The objective of both teams in Equinox is to capture the enemy's flag. The opponent's flag is located in the opponent's base. The flag can also not be scored if both are currently being carried. Physics-Based Weapons The weapons that the player can utilize in Equinox resemble dodgeballs. Once thrown, the dodgeballs will bounce around corners and if travelling slow enough, can be picked up. Various Weapon Types There are three types of dodgeballs in Equinox. First, there is the standard dodgeball which the player always has access to. This dodgeball deals a flat amount of damage. Special dodgeballs spawn around the map at critical locations. The special dodgeballs include fireballs, which deal damage over time, and iceballs slow the target for a duration. Abilities There are three abilities that the player can utilize throughout the match. The first ability is a ball repulsor, which protects the player from any dodgeballs for a duration. The second ability is a dash, which allows the player to move quickly in a desired direction. The third ability is a strafe, which enables the player to gain momentum and direct their air movement. Online Play The game can be played online with 2 to 8 friends via lobby hosting. When hosting a lobby, the host can define the team size, max score and match time. The game also utilizes VOIP, with a proximity voice chat system to communicate with other users.

In a post-apocalyptic future, the world has been corrupted by the darkness. The only place in the world that remains free from the control of the dark empire is The Grand Canyon. Master the four-car elements: Drifting! Flashing! Boosting! Bumping! Save the valley by exploring a cursed world, filled with battles, secrets, amazing characters, and exciting racing challenges against the best racers in the land. rows.name: Interitus
rows.short_description: Embark on a dangerous journey to a monastery where only death and decay remain. Explore the cursed hellscape and fight against challenging monsters in a realistic 3D-environment. Each play-session is unique from the previous one thanks to a randomized dungeon, with handcrafted rooms.
rows.description_html: ABOUT THIS GAME: Travel to the Hidden Monastery to the East In Interitus you play as a young elf, Liara, plagued by a soul-corrupting curse who must travel to a long-forgotten monastery located far behind the vast forests of the world of Nai'ru. You must fight through countless enemies and ensure your survival through the maze-like corridors of the monastery while searching for keys to open doors and progress further into the darkness. Defeat the boss and find the cure to your curse and unveil the secrets of the environment to complete the game. Interitus is a dark and atmospheric Souls-like with Roguelite-elements, realistic 3D graphics and a grotesque, medieval-styled environment. Slash your way through monsters with satisfying combat moves and find your way through the ever-changing dungeon, that is built different with every playthrough. BEAUTIFUL VISUALS: Immerse yourself with enchanting visuals, stunning 2d-cutscenes and a dazzling beastiary!

Keep your combo as high as possible and get stronger with items and powerups as you try to gain highscores in this chaotic 2D horde shooter.
rows.description_html: Key Features: • Lots of Shooting • Endless Waves of Enemies • Items and Powerups • Combo Counter • Highscores MewMew – PewPew is an endless wave arena shooter where you play as MewMew, whose home gets invaded by dinosaurs from alternative reality. Your goal is to survive for as long as you can, while trying to break the highscores. To gain the maximum score, stay in combat and kill the enemies to increase your combo counter, which directly affects your score gained. Get hit or stay out of combat for too long and your combo will decrease. In short, kill everything that moves until the inevitable death reaches you.

rows.short_description: In this apocalyptic world a cosmic being has taken over Earth and spread its corruption all over. Join the bounty hunter Cassius on his mission to destroy the corruption from the mansion in this FPS game. Be warned, grotesque monsters are hell-bent on stopping Cassius from reaching his goal.
rows.description_html: Key features - Single player - Action FPS - Cosmic Horror, Dark Fantasy - Game has 3D stylized art - Lots of shooting enemies - Power Punch has a cooldown and it heals - 4 levels, yard and mansion three floors - Checkpoints Gameplay In this FPS the player moves through unique environments killing enemies, while trying to destroy Spawners from which they emerge. Different weapons are used to kill enemies and enemies drop ammo for the player. Ammo drops are randomized. Player is goal is to reach the top floor to kill the boss of the game. Story The bounty hunter Cassius has an arsenal of weapons and has been sent on a mission to purge the corruption from a mansion in this cosmic horror inspired FPS game. In an alternative universe a cosmic creature from vast space appeared before humanity. This being granted its power to mankind, and quickly became a god to them. What we knew as the industrial revolution came to be known as the golden era. Unfortunately their god wasn't so benevolent. After 200 hundred years, corruption started to spread and consume every living thing on its path. In this new age humanity, now on the brink of extinction, formed a new organization to fight back against this plaque of destruction.

rows.name: Watercolor Hell
rows.short_description: A rouge-lite wave survival bullet hell focused on customizing weapons. Evolve weapon specializations from base weapons each run. Level up to compliment your next build with more projectiles, speed, and starting weapons. Complete chapters to get permanent stacking damage and new weapons.
rows.description_html: Watercolor Hell is a wave survival bullet hell focused on evolving base weapons each run. Customize a base wand into a large fire blast that knocks back enemies or a defensive ice razor that shoots down projectiles. Evolve base weapons with meaningful choices that change your run's playstyle. After each run buy upgrades and change your starting weapon. Each time you fully complete a Chapter, your character unlocks new weapons, permanent stacking damage, and other stat bonuses. 33 level upgrade choices to complement the weapon style you're building 8 wand weapon specializations 6 base weapons 9 xp upgrades 10 chapter unlocks A wave survival game with rogue-lite elements.

rows.short_description: A cyberpunk-ninja FPS 3D-platformer. Throw kunai and teleport to them across 5 individual levels. Chain teleports with wall-runs and jumps to reach the goal in the fastest time and avoid falling to certain death along the way.
rows.description_html: Kunai Strike is a fast-paced ninja styled 3D-platformer with first person controls. Compete in time trials utilizing the teleport kunai ninja tool to instantly warp from platform to platform. Game Features 3D percision platforming Cyberpunk ninja asthetic Keyboard and mouse first person controls Unique first person movement mechanic Teleport, wall-run, and jump along high elevation platforms 5 time trial based levels Local in game leaderboard system Compete to prove your skill as a high flying shinobi

rows.description_html: One of the four heroes of legend awakens from their slumber and protects a small army amidst the end of the world. rows.name: Viltnemda
rows.short_description: You've been called into the forest to investigate a wounded deer, but the forest is dark and all you have is a flashlight. Oh bother, what a Tuesday you're having.A retro PSX style horror game
rows.description_html: You are viltnemda. A retro PSX style era horror game You've been called into the forest to investigate a wounded deer, but the forest is dark and all you have is a flashlight. Oh bother, what a Tuesday you're having. --- Viltnemda is a horror walking-sim experience with a retro artstyle With your trusty flashlight, you must traverse through the dark forest to find the wounded deer and uncover the secrets of the forest. Flashlight mechanics that turns the flashlight on AND off! Possibly a deer So spooky the programmer won't even play it A lot of trees like, a lot of trees Atmospheric audiodesign that resembles an actual forest Viltnemda was developed over the course of 5 days for Brackeys Game jam 2022 Was also entered to participate in Norwegian Game Awards 2022. This game would not be released on Steam without the help of Skeive Spillutviklere

rows.name: ULTRAFUN
rows.short_description: Explore the Void. Gamer.
rows.description_html: ULTRAFUN is a game about patience, rewards, and goals. ... Take care of the last remaining fragment of Planet Ky , a world obliterated long ago by the Greater Void lying within. The Kyzt , in a last-ditch effort to tether itself to our world, formed into one Kyztling: ... Qubert. A renowned scientist, you must help Qubert to restore the ecological balance of Planet Ky, and to eventually reconnect your species with the Intergalactic Federation . Relax . You've got this. This is all you have to do: Feed your scientists some delicious and ethically-sourced Voidling cuisine! Channel your progress into the psychic relay, a natural and vaguely tree-like organism growing within the Ky Fragment. Make friends with your Kyztlings. To be clear, this is not a multiplayer game. I am talking about virtual friends. Realize that this game challenges you beyond the limits of any lesser game. Are you gamer enough to attain GAMER VALHALLA ? . That's right. If you download & play this game, I will personally send you to GAMER VALHALLA . I'm the developer and I am allowed to send you there. Buckle up, because you're going to be sent there at an extremely high velocity. Wear a helmet. Join the Discord!

rows.name: Chromatic
rows.short_description: Chromatic is a 2D Side-Scroller where your goal is to bring color into a monochrome world by using your abilities to traverse new terrain and defeat enemies.
rows.description_html: The world is monochrome. It is your quest to defeat those evil adversaries who have taken the color, and restore the world to its colorful state. In this 2D Side-Scroller, you will travel across four different levels, restoring color to the world as you progress. Jump, Dash, Grapple, and more in this colorful 2D adventure! Progression In Chromatic, you will fight multiple bosses, each releasing a new color when you defeat it. As you restore color to the world (and yourself), you will also discover new abilities to help you traverse difficult landscapes and give you an advantage against enemies. Features - Four unique levels containing varying landscapes, themes, obstacles, enemies, and bosses - Four special abilities unlocked with new colors - Themed music for each level - Color. Development This game was made across two semesters (15% of the game in the first semester, and 85% in the second). Warning: This game may not be for you if you have an avid fear of any of the following: water, color, vibrance, bunnies that pelt you with wooden pellets, giant two-dimensional frogs, music, clouds, wind, annoying lava chickens, falling, failing, running, dashing, jumping, moving, sand, people, or fun.

rows.name: Cosmopoly
rows.short_description: COSMOPOLY - is a multiplayer board game for 1-6 players. Play with friends, buy planets and space stations, participate in auctions and trade, build upgrades and become dominant in space.
rows.description_html: COSMOPOLY is an economic/random/strategic board game for groups of up to 6 players. Look for optimal ways, hope for luck and capture as many businesses on the field as possible, avoiding penalty cells and other people's businesses. Build your strategy by collecting and using items at the right moment. Be careful and monitor the situation in the system, Anthony will help you keep up to date with all the latest news. And don't forget, the longer the game goes on, the higher the penalties and costs! Take money from other players, make profitable deals and become the richest man in the solar system! And detailed statistics at the end of the game will help you analyze the game and measure success with other players. Chat, argue, laugh and have fun If you like Monopoly, Manager or Merchant, then this game is for you.

rows.name: MYRNEscapes
rows.short_description: A single player exploration game, with audio-reactive elements set to the music of MYRNE's Circles EP
rows.description_html: Explore 4 vast, scenic landscapes with audio-reactive elements inspired by the music of MYRNE's EP 'Circles'. What Can I Do: Set amongst red sands, this world is littered with runes and artefacts of a once-powerful society. Undiscovered constellations and celestial bodies move across the sky above you as you explore, illuminating new secrets to discover. Circles: A spelunking adventure within a vast, mystical cave. Unlock and interact with the mysteries of the Circles as you make your way through an ancient cave system. Emotion: Set in a verdant, lush plateau, explore the remnants of a lost tribe as they try to tell you their stories through flickering artefacts. Relax in a stoic experience atop the cliffs; but stay away from the edges. Faithless: A dense, forested jungle is littered with bioluminescent flora, surrounding a mystic river. Cliffs and otherworldly plants keep vantage points well-hidden. Daylight cycles are extremely short, so plan your explorations wisely.

rows.name: Temple Trashers
rows.short_description: A couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies!
rows.description_html: Temple Trashers is a couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies! You can play both: alone or with friends, with keyboard or controller, but we do recommend friends and controllers :) The only limit to the amount of players able to play at the same time is the amount of controllers and/or friends you have! The game is developed by a group of volunteer students from the Hackerspace NTNU student organization over the span of 2 years. The game is open-source and 100% free! Want to contribute, give feedback, report a bug or even just peek at our code? Head over to the official github page! For other projects and information, take a look at Hackerspace's website.

rows.name: The Tyrning Combat Challenge
rows.short_description: The player, Tal, has been issued a combat challenge. Participate in a one-on-one duel to the death in order to secure your team’s position in the Tyrning. Using artifacts secured during previous hunts, engage in melee combat with the opposing team’s champion. Made by four Drury University students.
rows.description_html: Game Overview: The Turning: Combat Challenge, is a 3rd person action combat game that takes place in a gladiatorial arena. Playing as Tal, the player will re-enact the final battle in Tim Fox’s Novel Scavenger Hunt . The player and enemy each start with a set of items that include a weapon, armor and a shield. Each item is unique and comes with a corresponding special ability. You will participate in a one-on-one duel to the death in order to secure your team’s position in the Tyrning. This game was made by four Drury University students using the Unreal Engine. Features: Interaction system that allows the player to mix and match with equipping different unique items Five equippable items each with unique attributes and special abilities Combo attack system for the player Intelligent enemy that can chase, attack, block and use special abilities. Advanced Niagara and Cascade particle systems for VFX Cool atmosphere with post processing, lighting, and animated crowd. Informative and sleek HUD Crisp UI that matches the atmosphere and aesthetic of the game Settings for adjusting key bindings and audio Custom artwork and models such as the arena and characters Used assets and writing material that was given to us directly by author Tim Fox Original music composition System that changes the music based on the state of the game Sound effects

CROSS THE ROAD：Carefully avoid vehicles and cross the road Feature The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.

rows.name: Memoir
rows.short_description: A short memoir of first love.
rows.description_html: The Emotional Visual Novel About Memories of First Love Synopsis Jaeyoon founded a programming club at school, cleverly disguising it as a gaming club. The club, on the brink of disbandment due to a lack of members, is invigorated by the introduction of a new member, infusing new life into Jaeyoon's otherwise mundane daily routine. Understanding Seo-ah's need for a quiet space, Jaeyoon finds himself confronting an unexpected and hidden side of her defensiveness. When he discovers that Seo-ah may soon depart for Finland as an exchange student, he comes to the realization that their time together is limited. - This cute puzzle game features a single ending and full voice acting for the heroine, offering 1-2 hours of playtime.

rows.name: Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue
rows.short_description: Begin your monster-taming journey in Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue. Fight, collect, upgrade and evolve Kādomon to build your ultimate team in this prologue version of Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers. Experience the brand-new features, mechanics and Kādomon for the first time.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game Welcome to the world of Kādomon, a mysterious land where cute and quirky monsters roam freely. Journey through randomly generated regions, battling and collecting Kādomon on your quest to be the best. There’s 180+ monsters to add to your Kādodex, and each Kādomon has 2 super rare misprints to discover! Find over 60 of these monsters and their misprints to build the ultimate unstoppable team in the Kādomon prologue! All Kādomon have special characteristics, such as activated abilities, passive abilities and different typings (there’s 12 types in total!). Synergise your Kādomon’s attacks and create a super effective combo of monsters. Grow even stronger with every battle by levelling-up and evolving your team! Once fully evolved, every Kādomon has the chance to get HYPER! Acquire very rare items that allow your Kādomon to break their limits and discover a hyper-powerful 4th form! With brand new designs and souped-up stats, you’ll be able to tackle the greatest of challenges, in the Kādomon prologue you will be able to discover Hyper Evolution for every starter Kādomon! Battle your team against elite enemies and bosses. Get your team ready to fight against MEGA opponents, and unlock brand new Kādomon if you win! Remember, there is always a greater foe to test your strength! The Kādomon world is bustling with secrets, including random events that will change the tide of battle! In the Early Access release, experiment with different items and monsters, Kādomon might evolve in different ways, and if you’re lucky you might just encounter a Legendary Kādomon to join your team… In between battles, take a mosey around Shonkka's Shop! Here you can use the Money Berries you’ve earned to buy new Kādomon and items. Held items are incredibly useful to have as they give you permanent buffs or powerful single use effects when used wisely!

rows.name: Ukraine War Stories
rows.short_description: Ukraine War Stories is a set of visual novels about the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Set in the early months of the war, it tells the stories of civilians trapped on Russian-occupied territory. All stories are based on real events and eyewitness accounts.
rows.description_html: Ukraine War Stories is a set of visual novels about the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Set in the early months of the war, it tells the stories of civilians trapped on Russian-occupied territory. In their shoes, you will not be a fighter, only a survivor. The novels will take you from the first volleys of the war in Hostomel, to the terror in Bucha, to the defiant resistance in Mariupol. You will have to keep yourself and your loved ones safe, and eventually escape to safety. This will take courage and resourcefulness — and sometimes, sacrifices. Based on real events Every novel is a dramatization of eyewitness accounts and real events recorded in the area, condensed into one story. The gameplay is text-based and accompanied by music and illustrations. The game's art comes from authentic war photographs taken in the areas where the stories take place. Truly free — no catch The full game is completely free (no in-app purchases, etc) + a free Demo is available until the full game is released. We do not try to profit from this project. Our goal is to share the recent experiences of the people of Ukraine with a worldwide audience. Devs are from Ukraine Developed by a small team located in Kyiv, Ukraine, working from our office despite the wartime conditions. As a Ukraine-based company, we could not sit idly by as the war rages in our country, with enemy forces stopping 3 km short of Kyiv itself, and a large portion of Ukraine being occupied. One of the guys from our team was caught by the Russian invading forces in Bucha (where one of our stories takes place) and had to hide in a garage basement for a week with his family until they managed to evacuate. His house was plundered and looted by the Russians along with many other houses in the town. He told us his eyewitness account, which we used along with other public sources. A lot of our relatives' or friends' lives were also affected. Fortunately, everyone on our team survived so far, but the war continues… THREE STORIES The game includes three interactive novels about some of the first towns that were hit during the invasion: Hostomel, Bucha, and Mariupol. In each story you will play a civilian, completely outmatched against the invading Russians. Your only task is to keep yourself and your loved ones safe, and escape with your lives. But remember: as a civilian, you can only do so much. Hostomel Available in Free Demo On Feb 24, 2022 Ukrainians woke up to the sound of air raid sirens and rocket strikes. A massive Russian airborne attack upon the outskirts of Kyiv followed. The town of Hostomel was among the first targets. This is where it all began. As a retired aviation engineer, Oleksiy Borisov is not equipped to handle the challenges of the war. In this role, you will have to manage your survival resources, and take care of your group's emotional needs. It's not about winning the war — it's about seeing your loved ones to safety. Bucha Available in Full Game for free After a week of intense fighting, the North-Western outskirts of Kyiv fell to the Russians on Mar 5, 2022. Like many other small towns in the area, Bucha was under a month-long occupation. This occupation was among the most brutal in the history of warfare. Yarik Kravchenko and his sister Vika came to Bucha to wait out the assault on Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine. Their mother Yana is a medic defending the capital, while Yarik and Vika are stuck in Bucha, unable to escape on their own. And the occupation is becoming more brutal by the day. In this story, you will be the most vulnerable in the face of the war. You will face tough choices, and a happy outcome will not be assured. Mariupol Available in Full Game for free In the 8 years of the war, the city of Mariupol had already fallen under attack before. Back then it was over quickly. Now, it's about to become one of the biggest and bloodiest sieges of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Dima Kornienko is a talented surgeon and a native of Mariupol. When the war comes to his city once more, he finds himself on the frontline along with other medics. Your staff is well-trained and motivated, but the situation in the city is growing desperate, and supplies are quickly running out. In this story, hard choices will have to be made — choices nobody can make for you. To save as many as you can, you must keep track of your hospital's readiness and your own mental state. rows.name: Spectral Showdown
rows.short_description: Spectral Showdown is a party brawl game where you fight your friends, family or greatest enemies to the death! Possess creatures at your will and use their abilities to help you! May the best fighter win!
rows.description_html: Do you like Prop Hunt? Too bad! This is Spectral Showdown! Overview In Spectral Showdown, You possess creatures and fight your friends, family or greatest enemies to the death using the creature's abilities! Similar to prop hunt, but animals instead! The last one standing wins! Play offline or online and watch as your friendships begin to crumble! Unlock achievements for being the greatest fighter out of your friends or even for simply trying your best (we won't judge). Key Features Offline/Online play (includes LAN) for up to 4 players. Same keyboard support so you can play together on the same keyboard (offline-only). 2 Maps. Achievements. Steam Cloud Support (to make sure your settings are on the cloud)! Cartoony style.

rows.name: The Looker
rows.short_description: You wake up, alone, on a strangely familiar island full of puzzles that will frustrate and annoy you.
rows.description_html: Explore several charmed locations on a mysterious island replete with over 55 creative puzzles. Over an approximately two-hour playing duration, you will face unique challenges, ponderous ideas, and feebly amusing in-jokes. The Looker is a single-player game that respects you as an intelligent player, and it treats your time as... reasonably valuable (I mean, don't let me pull you off solving the Riemann hypothesis or anything). As such, I will level with you here—not every joke will be a hit, but there is no filler material, the puzzles are fun, and, if you really think about it, aren't the real solutions the, uhh... friends we make along the way?

rows.name: A War of a Madman's Making
rows.short_description: You are subordinate to the deranged dictator and must plan his doomed invasion in this text-based RPG / Visual Novel. Navigate the shark-filled waters of the Great Leader's presidential cabinet, try to save your family, and survive the purges in a world of power-hungry leaders and nuclear warfare.
rows.description_html: This is A War of a Madman's Making : A combination of Visual Novel and text-based RPG centered around war planning and political survival, inspired by games like Suzerain and Decisive Campaigns: Barbarossa . War of a Madman's Making is set in a fictional world where nuclear escalation has blackened the skies. You are a citizen who has been mysteriously called up to serve as Field Marshal of the Great Leader's army. Through a combination of resource management, political maneuvering, and strategic military planning, you must survive the impending war - and the purges and assassinations that will come along with it. You have the freedom to be ruthless in your methods, but doing so too freely could have consequences - particularly if you face a tribunal for crimes against humanity. However, mismanage your resources pursuing nobler causes, and you'll find a similar fate at the hands of your beloved Great Leader. Rein in the disaster, protect your family, and survive the purges. Features ~70k word story with 5 major endings. Resource management . Maintain a military budget, popularity with the Leader's cabinet, and favor with the Great Leader himself. Choose your allies and enemies . Scheme amongst the Leader's staff or even against the Leader himself. Manipulate your reports when you must give bad news to the Great Leader, but be careful not to push your luck. Retro-style soundtrack by Borealis (Shirli Ainsworth) full of tense overtures and bombastic battle themes. An encyclopaedia filled with lore and character details - including nuggets that an astute player will find useful. Join the Discord and contribute to game development!

rows.name: Kingdom Draw
rows.short_description: A hybrid of challenging turn-based strategy and customizable card collection gameplay set in a medieval fantasy universe.
rows.description_html: A hybrid of challenging turn-based strategy and customizable card collection gameplay set in a medieval fantasy universe. Campaigns Gather your armies, ready your spells and delve into an engaging single player campaign. Complete missions for each of the 4 factions to gain more cards and immerse yourself in the unique story of each of Humans, Undead, Orcs, and Elves. With more chapters released each season, unravel the epic story arc underpinning the Kingdom Draw universe. Online Ladder Play Pit yourself against other players from around the world with cross-platform ladder play. Do you have what it takes to ascend the ladder with every victory and reap your rewards? At the end of each season, earn bonus rewards for how high you progressed up the ladder. Make it to the Titan league to have your alias displayed (and glorified for all time) in the Hall of Fame. Deck Building Buy randomised card packs with gems earned through ladder play and campaigns; or redeem victory tokens to obtain specific cards of your choice. Build your own custom, synergising decks to dominate your opponents and become a Titan of Kingdom Draw. With 185 distinct cards to collect, and more cards being released each season, you can always craft new variations to trial out in battle. Turn-based Strategy Hone your turn-based strategy skills. Matches in Kingdom Draw take place on a hexagonal grid where you play army, support, and beast cards on the map. Strategically control locations to earn more resources, take advantage of terrain, and be the first to destroy your opponent’s castle. Use power cards to decimate your enemies, alter your cards’ combat effectiveness, and modify the terrain. Friendly Matches Looking for something more casual? Stick with the devil you know and add friends to challenge them to friendly battles. Friendly battles do not alter your ladder ranking or provide rewards, so you can trial your deck creations in a more relaxed arena. Cross Platform Link your account across multiple platforms, allowing you to continue playing wherever you are. Available on PC, MAC, Linux, Android, Chromebooks, and IOS.

rows.name: Chaste Tris
rows.short_description: Chaste Tris is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks!
rows.description_html: Hard Drop In response to requests in the Steam reviews, which I do actually read, I have added the hard drop into the game now. Try it out with space bar or H key. About the Game Chaste Tris is my first complete video game I have made. It is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks! But my game also allows for a new feature that none of the other games have. It is possible to save the state of the game by pressing the I key and reload it with the L key to go back and correct mistakes. This makes it the perfect tool to test out playing styles which would be perfectly valid on other puzzle block style games but would be very difficult. Consider this game as a relaxing practice tool to test the limits of what you can think of when you have all the time in the world to get it right! This game is not meant to compete with the officially licensed Tetris games. However, I think it adds the feeling of the 1980s and 1990s. It is meant to run on even the oldest and slowest of computers. It is fully Open-Source and was developed on Linux. However, this Steam port is the Windows port which I have confirmed also works on Debian Linux using Proton Emulation. For more information on how you can use the source code and modify it to your own needs, you can visit the GitHub page

rows.name: Grizelda:  Lynx and the Nine Lives
rows.short_description: Join Lynx on an adventure to rescue a princess and collect 9 souls. A retro-action RPG filled with puzzles, dungeons, and treasure. Play for free, donate to your local ASPCA.
rows.description_html: Join Lynx on an adventure to rescue a princess and collect 9 souls. A retro-action RPG filled with puzzles, dungeons, and treasure. What happens when a sleeping kitty cat follows a mouse into his hole? Plunged into a magical land where dogs have taken over, Lynx must win back the mythical artifacts that will lead him to Princess Grizelda. Granny Tortoise sets you on a journey to defeat the soul guardians and rescue Whinnie and Ricky Mouse, Rascal the Racoon, Herb the Sheep, and more. Inspired by classic pixel RPG games like Zelda, Kings Quest, Final Fantasy, and more, rediscover the nostalgia of 1980 & 90s adventure games. Help kitties in real life, and consider donating to your local animal shelter or ASPCA.

rows.name: Last Meow Standing
rows.short_description: This lightning fast arena shooter brings you right back to the highscore hunts of the arcade era. Use your arsenal of deadly weapons wisely against the increasingly ferocious monster hordes to survive as long as you can.
rows.description_html: You play as the world renowned CATventurer fighting off the ferocious hordes of the mouse mutants. To survive you need to master your arsenal of deadly weapons... and the banana gun. Test your skill and shoot for the highscore on the leaderboards. Gameplay You start with your full arsenal at your hands, ready to fight the mutants. Don't worry about ammunition. When you empty your magazine you get a random new weapon. When you get hit you lose a random piece of equipment. Use your dash move to get out of precarious situations. And that's about it. Pretty straight forward, isn't it? So what are you waiting for? Hop in and see if you can beat the highscores of your friends!

rows.name: Mortmentum
rows.short_description: Fight endless waves of different enemies using your grappling hook in clever ways while trying hopelessly to stay alive just a little longer so you can get a higher score.
rows.description_html: Beat My Highscore, I Dare You. But like, this shit ramps up quick . Five types of enemies, deadly lasers, your own incompetence and only a grappling hook and physics to deal with it. Good luck :P Get creative and improve your control, dodge between enemies with more precision than it takes to do surgery on a grape, grab hold of an enemy and use their own laser to kill everyone else or go with the classic and slam your foes into the ground or each other. That's a least like, 3 possibilities (maybe more, I'm bad at math). Simple description: You play as a ball with a grappling hook in a small arena. You get points by destroying other shapes, where the shape corresponds to what they do (the triangles shoot lasers). The more points you have, the more difficult the game becomes and when you die, you try again from the beginning. You destroy shapes by grappling them and flinging them at walls or other hard objects.

rows.name: Police Stories: The Academy
rows.short_description: Welcome, trainee! Use tactics and special equipment to become a true cop in the free version of Police Stories: The Academy. Neutralize criminals, search for clues and find a 'rat' in the police station alone or in co-op with a partner.
rows.description_html: Main Game About the Game Police Stories: The Academy is a free version of Police Stories with a new story, missions, and locations. Here, Rick and John are still inexperienced trainees who are just learning to be cops. Another day at the police academy goes awry when unrest breaks out in the city. To make matters worse, a 'rat' who works with the local mafia has turned up at the police station. And, of course, only two student cops can defy all the trouble! Like the original game, The Academy is inspired by SWAT 4 and cop TV shows. A fresh take on top-down shooters with an emphasis on tactics where decisions have to be made in a split second. Rescue hostages, neutralize criminals and defuse bombs in single-player or co-op mode. And remember, shooting first is not the best decision! 3 new missions and locations, plus the police academy training ground. Help young Rick and John become brutal cops! The Surrender System allows you to apprehend the suspects without resorting to violence. Fire a warning shot near them or engage them in melee combat - those are just some of the ways you can make them submit. Issue commands to your fellow cop Rick Jones. Make sure to use him wisely - and who knows, he might save your life in return. Randomly placed criminals, hostages and evidence make every level run unique. The placement changes every time you restart, leading to new interesting situations and opportunities. As a law enforcement officer, you will have access to end-of-the-line police equipment, such as under-the-door cameras, door blast charges and many others. Various types of lawbreakers, from small petty criminals to well organised gangs and terrorists. Each type has not only unique weapons, but different behaviour and shooting skill. Complex Tactical Gameplay: Try not to get spotted, don't waste bullets, regularly check your surroundings and make sure to take criminals down quietly. All your actions are scored in real time. Playing aggressively won't get you a high enough result to start the next mission - so keep that in mind! Co-op. Complete mission together for better scores and more fun!

rows.name: Jacktus Green: The Fluffy, the Spiky and the Spicy
rows.short_description: Chase Guindilla to retrieve your beloved Cattus! Jump, dash, and hook around in this 2.5D platformer. Discover different levels, fight enemies, ride minecarts and meet the bizarre neighbors of Sofrito Town.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Sofrito Town, a fantasy city set in the Wild West, ruled by plants! Help Jacktus Green, a bounty hunter, who has been tricked into betting his pet Cattus in a poker game against the dangerous outlaw Guindilla. She is planning to use Cattus to find golden avocados, and Jacktus wants to recover his beloved friend! 🌵 Travel through 5 different levels: Discover new locations, skills and enemies, while the world reacts to your presence. Complete each zone as fast as you can to beat the previous mark! 🌵 Explore: Investigate and find hidden places, and discover the secrets of Sofrito Town! 🌵 Boss Fight: Challenge Guindilla in three unique encounters. 🌵 Destroy: Break walls and crates, throw dynamite and unleash chaos! COMING SOON! 🌵 Shop: Collect all the gold pieces you can find and exchange them for many goodies!

Complete each zone as fast as you can to beat the previous mark! 🌵 Explore: Investigate and find hidden places, and discover the secrets of Sofrito Town! 🌵 Boss Fight: Challenge Guindilla in three unique encounters. 🌵 Destroy: Break walls and crates, throw dynamite and unleash chaos! rows.name: MetälBörn
rows.short_description: Techno has taken over your neighborhood. Honor your metal god Kilmister, arm yourself up to the baffles, raise the volume and show these punks which is the music that makes the shells shake. The metalheads are not dead, but the technos will be…
rows.description_html: When was the last time you felt like a heavy metal fan? MetalBorn gives you the feeling of the golden age of the genre and also the emergence of a new musical group which is on the rise and it is called: Electronic Music. You will immerse yourself in this first person shooter in a world where our hero, the last follower of heavy metal, is chosen by his god to reconquer the key points of power in his neighborhood, these being three points of conquest. Set to fulfill his hellish mission, our heavy metal warrior heads to the streets of Blüdstock equipped with his Kilmister-blessed weaponry. Arriving at street level, he realizes that his house is the last bastion of the 'Metallic Fortress', the name by which Blüdstock is known, the flagship place and cradle of Heavy Metal. Finding himself surrounded by minions of the evil goddess Lillith, Robert fights his way through the angry mob to the sources of power. Having the path to trace under his choice, Robert will decide which party to conquer which he used to attend as a child, as this became a source of power after the incident with Father Judas, which allowed parties and concerts to celebrate Lilith's Faith. Once there, and after bathing in the electronic blood of his enemies, our dark paladin performs the sacred act of 'The Disc Change'. This deadly sin causes the source of power to change masters and therefore its former owner loses power. According to the scriptures of the Sacred Pantheon, when one of the sons of music decides to claim his territory, he must perform the ritual at least 3 times to rule it. Therefore, the main objective of our infernal hero is to reconquer the parties of the city while the followers of Lillith try to stop him. In this action game with acrobatic movements and verticality, it generates an atmosphere of tension and frenzy when facing the enemies of electronic music that don't stop appearing until they defeat you.

rows.description_html: Seeking Light is an action adventure game in isometric perspective with a focus on boss fights. Take control of Sunny, a girl immersed in her subconscious world through meditation where she will have to face her fears in order to leave behind all the pain from the past. Breath in… Breath out… Ready? USE YOUR ENVIRONMENT TO FIGHT Break pillars to get broken stones, pick up bombs and jumping platforms to help yourself through the levels. BE BRAVE, LITTLE GIRL! Explore your inner world and collect the pieces of your childhood diary to confront the causes of your fears. KEY FEATURES: Tightly tuned controls. Dash, attack and throw objects to defeat your fears. Five world zones with their own identity and theme. Five unique boss fights. Collect pages of Sunny's diary to discover the details of her past. Solve puzzles and explore the world of Sunny’s inner mind.

rows.name: Insurrection: Cyborgs Awakening
rows.short_description: Kick some asses in this cooperative retrowave game!!! Use powerful abilities and combos to destroy the evil minions of the Driftonics mega corporation and free humanity from the cyborg threat.
rows.description_html: Chrome Hero Insurrection: Cyborgs Awakening features a classic beat em’ up gameplay. Make your way through the neon city of Beat Bay, a place where peace has never been an option. Fight as Michael, the pilot of the incredible TH-3000, unleash devastating combos to take down your enemies or destroy them completely by making powerful and unique abilities. Fight for humankind The corporation ‘Driftonics’ has taken advantage of this by providing cures to deadly diseases to its inhabitants through nanotechnology or modifying their bodies with robotic parts to achieve technological utopia. What no one knew is that this was all just an evil plan to possess the minds of their citizens and turn them into cyborgs ready to kill. Fight against a variety of enemies, from the weak and volatile Scout, through the agile and deadly gang members of the High Heels, to the mighty Iron Hearts. Stop the Massacre Help Michael take down the top executives of “Driftonics” Corporation. Starting with the beautiful but fearsome Cyberna, a powerful winged cyborg who will be willing to destroy everything in her path in order to complete her campaign of world domination. The Purest Retrowave Style Enjoy fantastic 3D graphics with handpainted textures. Move through the awesome Beat Bay, featuring four different levels with their own theme. Enjoy an exciting story of hilarious action in the purest style of the 80s and above all, be ready to kick metal asses.

rows.name: Arclight Beat
rows.short_description: Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music.
rows.description_html: Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm-based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music. Jump and control the world at the rhythm of the beat in order to beat challenging music-inspired levels in this charming mix of platforming and puzzles! Create a custom soundtrack by placing beats in different spots and watch as the world adapts to the music. Rearrange the beat mixer, run and jump in order to reach the end! 20 levels with 4 different music themes Rhythm-based 3d platforming Engaging puzzles 4 bonus scrolling levels This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Mebula
rows.short_description: Mebula, seal Mebulies, train them and fight to be the best!
rows.description_html: Champkin in Danger! Help Champkin to Escape from the Spiders-Trap! About the Game Hello Master! Mebula is a fantastical world where players can catch monsters called “Mebulies”, train them and compete against each other. Experience a journey into foreign lands and fight against your friends, NPCs or defeat the elite of the Mebula world in glorious battles. Explore this world and master many quests. Train your Mebulies and let them become great heroes. Play your game as you want it and get great rewards. Everything Has A Beginning To start you can choose between the plant Mebuly 'Sproutly', the fire Mebuly 'Flambini' and the water Mebuly 'Drizzlet'. Then you can start! Master Shin, a former Grand Master of Mebula, will assist you during your first steps. You will have to fight a fight with his student Daisuke and have to explore a few places on the starting islands and then fight a fight against the former champion himself. The Great Adventure Starts! Enter the world, fight your challengers and become stronger. The goal is not only to start with your Start-Mebuly and your first friend 'Sparokeet'. You need new team mates! Look for special places and look for other Mebulies there. A special volcanic crater or a hidden coastal section could harbor them! Train with your team to make it stronger, teach them new attacks, and then travel more areas with other Mebulies. Find the Challenge! As soon as you feel strong enough, compete against your friends or members in matches! Whether you need to train even more or take other Mebulies into your team, to become even stronger, will show up! Your strategy will never be perfect, someone will always try to defeat you with a new strategy! What Will the Future Bring? The disturbances of the Mebus, the most mythical of all Mebulies, are already visible. The large cloud serpent was very rarely seen by humans. But where it appears, there are great storms. Will the Mebu soon show up above Mebula?

rows.description_html: After working or studying for a long period, you couldn’t imagine how fancy it is to leave your seat and listen to relaxing music on your skateboard, especially at sunset or early morning. Get rid of fatigue in Silent World ! This is a simple 2D pixel game. Here, being relaxed is the only purpose. Players can switch different scenes from home page. In your game, you only need to use the direction key (WASD) to control your character to accelerate, decelerate, flip and jump. Here are four different scenes, and new scenes will be continuously coming in the future. Main features: Leisure and relaxation Slide simulation Free content updates

rows.name: Project Crypt
rows.short_description: Project Crypt: The horror adventure about escaping a city overrun by monsters.
rows.description_html: Project Crypt is an action-adventure horror game inspired by critically-acclaimed horror titles such as Cry of Fear. You play as a disturbed young individual trying to find a way out of a city filled with horrific enemies. Find out the truth of your past and make it out to safety alive! Project Crypt is a game built on GZDoom, featuring action-packed combat encounters and creepy atmospheric areas in a variety of different environments. This world is a hostile place, so you will have to be careful, with managing your ammo supply and constantly be on the lookout for your health. Photosensitivity warning: This video game contains scenes with flashing and flickering lights that may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Key Features: Extensive single-player campaign Multiple outcomes of the story depending on your actions in the game Moody soundtrack to enhance the atmosphere Robust inventory system to enhance the gameplay A new survival-horror experience Nostalgic visual style echoing back to the early 2000s

rows.name: Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue
rows.short_description: Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is some part of the full version of the game. The gameplay starts in the realities of World War II, the Soviets and Allies are coming. Your task in the game is to keep enemy troops as far away from your base as possible. Fight and survive!
rows.description_html: Buzz About the Game WARNING! You have just moved into the realities of World War II and you are in a super-secret base. Soviets and Allies are coming, and they are getting closer! For many, the fate of the war is doomed. However, those who are still fighting will fight with you to the end! In Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue, your job is to SURVIVE! The goal in the game is to constantly fight on the fronts in order to gain time and force enemy troops to move away from your base. Remember, you have to be vigilant at every step. Your enemies are just waiting for you to stumble. One of the main gameplay features of Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is the constantly pressing fronts. In order to stave off the attack that surrounds you from almost every side, you will be able to use game mechanics such as: building a Research Center - in order to obtain amazing technologies, breaking codes, extracting resources, developing the technology tree and recruiting the best scientists, spies and agents into your ranks. They will provide you with the key information about the march of the opposing, destructive troops. So make good use of the time you have and create the most terrifying weapon in the history of mankind! Extracting raw materials is also a very important part of managing the entire underground base. The acquired resources will allow you to develop your base, obtain completely new materials - without which survival will be really difficult, and, most importantly, delay the enemy's attack. Use your resources wisely during the gameplay. Additionally, during the game, you can expect all sorts of challenges to thwart your plans. Your enemies will try absolutely anything, including destroying your base from within! Some of the challenges that await you in the game are sabotage or attacks on raw materials. And these are just some of the problems you will have to face in Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue.

For many, the fate of the war is doomed. However, those who are still fighting will fight with you to the end! In Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue, your job is to SURVIVE! The goal in the game is to constantly fight on the fronts in order to gain time and force enemy troops to move away from your base. Remember, you have to be vigilant at every step. Your enemies are just waiting for you to stumble. One of the main gameplay features of Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is the constantly pressing fronts. In order to stave off the attack that surrounds you from almost every side, you will be able to use game mechanics such as: building a Research Center - in order to obtain amazing technologies, breaking codes, extracting resources, developing the technology tree and recruiting the best scientists, spies and agents into your ranks. They will provide you with the key information about the march of the opposing, destructive troops. So make good use of the time you have and create the most terrifying weapon in the history of mankind! Extracting raw materials is also a very important part of managing the entire underground base. The acquired resources will allow you to develop your base, obtain completely new materials - without which survival will be really difficult, and, most importantly, delay the enemy's attack. Use your resources wisely during the gameplay. Additionally, during the game, you can expect all sorts of challenges to thwart your plans. Your enemies will try absolutely anything, including destroying your base from within! Some of the challenges that await you in the game are sabotage or attacks on raw materials. And these are just some of the problems you will have to face in Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue.

rows.name: Little Rhapsody of Game
rows.short_description: In a mysterious map, engage in a hardcore and passionate battle carnival with several friend players, master excellent combat experience, and defeat opponents with sufficient reactions and skills to become the king of this world.
rows.description_html: Several players fight each other in a small map, and there is only one winner. The basic combat system is block can block common attack, heavy attack can break block, roll can avoid heavy attack. There are many beads that can be picked up. The bead of life can increase maximum life, the bead of strength can increase strength, the bead of speed can increase speed, the bead of blood can fill up blood，the bead of flash can flash once. I don't have a server. You create rooms with your own computers. Homeowners can set attack speed, number of beads, time per game and other coefficients to adapt to the player level of each game. If you think the attack speed is fast, change it slower, otherwise change it faster. No one helped me to test, so I demonstrated and played with AI, so I don't know what BUGs there are when it's online, how many players it can accommodate and isn't lag, whether the balance of the game is , whether it can find a room, whether it can join and invite friends, etc.

rows.name: Syndeo-Complex
rows.short_description: In Syndeo-Complex you will explore five different environments connected by a hub. Each level has its own mechanics, weapons, enemies and bosses. The Keli, small droids, will (probably) guide you in your quest.
rows.description_html: Syndeo-Complex is a first-person shooter. It is inspired by games like Half-Life and Doom (1993). You will have to explore twisting levels, fight enemies and solve puzzles. At the end of each level, you will have to defeat tougher enemies: the Nekron Kyttaron. This will allow you to progress in the game and unlock the characters' stories. -- Here is the story so far You are Dyo. You were born in the spaceship Prophet 60091. You are an annihilator, a human genetically modified and augmented. Your mother, whose identity remains secret, died under mysterious circumstances. She was the founder of the mega corporation Syndeo. Your father, Enas, commander of the spaceship Prophet 60091, captured Miden, your loved one. His plans are unknown. Your goal is to decimate your father's army and to save Miden. To do this, you must kill all the Nekron Kyttaron and then destroy the Prophet 60091 with the SH10151 orbital gun. No one will do it for you. -- The game includes: 1 mysterious hub that connects all levels 4 levels (5 planned), each with its own environment 3 bosses (5 planned) called Nekron Kyttaron 7 weapons (10 planned) including a pistol, an assault rifle, a missile launcher, a shotgun, etc 16 enemies and characters (19 planned) with their own stories to unlock 3 drugs 12 music tracks (50 minutes), downloadable as free DLC Philosophical dialogues Enigmatic storyline

rows.short_description: 'Colorful Party Wars' is a RTS (real-time simulation) game based on 'Colorful Party' (a.k.a. 'Color-pari') the group in the virtual reality social game VRChat ! Select your favorite club and prove you’re the best to the rest of the members in Color-pari!
rows.description_html: 'Colorful Party Wars' is a RTS (real-time simulation) game based on 'Colorful Party' (a.k.a. 'Color-pari') the group in the virtual reality social game VRChat! There are many clubs in Color-pari ! The Student Council: the head coordinating group for the members of Color-pari The Dance Club: practicing every Tuesday and Thursday with a live exhibition once a month. The Broadcasting Club: Reading up on hot topics and broadcasting news to members. The Gaming Club: Playing all sorts of fun games and doing cool activities And so much more! Get fired up and show the rest of Color-pari your club spirit! Meet and collect the cute members of the Color-pari roster with more being added in future updates!

rows.name: 白娘子
rows.short_description: 'White lady' is a 3D stand-alone role-playing game developed by broken DuanQiaoCanXue studio. This game adopts the full real-time combat mode, and the combat experience is free and refreshing. The game depicts the legend of the White Snake, one of China's four major love myths and legends
rows.description_html: 'White lady' is a 3D stand-alone role-playing game developed by broken DuanQiaoCanXue studio. This game adopts the full real-time combat mode, and the combat experience is free and refreshing. The game depicts the legend of the White Snake, one of China's four major love myths and legends, in a realistic and aesthetic style, and takes the popular TV series 'the legend of the new white lady' as the plot blueprint to bring players a new play experience and beautiful plot memories Synopsis of the story A good marriage, once in a thousand years. 1700 years ago, the shepherd boy saved a white snake from the snake catcher. In order to repay the kindness of saving lives, the White Snake, after 1700 years of cultivation, turned into a human shape and became a beautiful woman Bai Suzhen. Together with the smart woman Xiaoqing, who was transformed by the green snake, she experienced the world affairs. She and the shepherd boy of that year have now become a handsome, hardworking and promising scholar Xu Xian, performing a love story of gratitude, gratitude and resentment Game chapter The game is divided into: illusory human shape, borrowing umbrella, fairy mountain, stealing treasure, Jinshan and so on. Players can not only enjoy the beautiful scenery of Hangzhou and Qingcheng Mountain, feel the style of the Southern Song Dynasty, but also experience the fun of real-time combat Game features The game contains a wealth of prop systems, which players can obtain by picking up or rewarding silver transactions. In addition to ordinary attacks, the protagonist also has five attack skills of gold, wood, water, fire and earth. The combination of skills can achieve perfect attack effect. The game contains a variety of tasks for players to choose from. Players can also watch dragon boat racing, play pot throwing games and experience the entertainment of the ancients

rows.name: Snack Stall
rows.short_description: This game is a simulation fast food restaurant game. Do your best to satisfy your customers and earn more money.
rows.description_html: About This game is a simulation fast food restaurant game. First of all, you have to play the role of the receptionist and firmly remember what the guests ordered. Only the correct dishes can bring income, and the wrong dishes must be compensated for the guests. Secondly, you have to fry eggs and steaks for the guests. Please remember the maturity of the omelettes and steaks that the guests want. The closer to the requirements of the guests, the higher the income. Third, you have to prepare drinks for the guests, according to the requirements of the guests, if it is wrong, it may lead to failure. Fourth, you have to make hamburgers for the guests. The guests will ask for a few pieces of meat, a few eggs, etc., and you need to record them immediately. Feature The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.
