rows.name: Touhou Crisis
rows.short_description: Classic arcade nostalgia and modern-indie design collide in this shooting-gallery boss battler! Play as a one-man army in offline solo OR bring a friend in online co-op/versus mode! Supports Mouse AND Lightgun play!
rows.description_html: This is a derivative fan-work of the Touhou Project series and is not affiliated with Team Shanghai Alice. Remember to support the official games on Steam. Take on a menacing boss with nothing but your gun, your reflexes, and your other, bigger gun in this short, arcade-style, lightgun game! Originally developed in 72 hours for the 6th Touhou Fan Game Jam, the game has since been polished into a complete experience! Story One leisurely spring day, a large crate landed in a certain shrine courtyard, piquing the curiosity of a shrine maiden and her magician friend lounging nearby. Inside were some guns and a treasure trove of ammunition. Unfamiliar with kinetic warfare, the two girls treated the weapons as toys and played until the sun went down. It was then that a rare guest made a surprise visit to the shrine gates. 'So anyway, I started blastin'' , said the shrine maiden, recalling the incident. Also there are UFOs, but don't think about it. It's probably another Myouren Temple conspiracy. Two Playable Characters: Play as either Reimu with her powerful shotgun, or as Marisa with her full-auto assault rifle! Online Co-Op and Versus Modes: Bring along a friend to take out the boss together! If you're feeling competitive, compete with each other for a high score! Built for Lightgun Play: Everything from the gameplay, to the user interface itself, has been designed by a lightgun user, for lightgun users! Gameplay Modifiers: Hard mode? Lunatic mode? Easy Modo??? Make your own dang difficulty level! You can live out your power fantasy with infinite lives! Alternatively, you can just give yourself 1 life, you masochist !

rows.name: Achromatic
rows.short_description: Achromatic is a first-person horror puzzle game — Walk around the carnival you have been tasked with repairing and uncover the darker secrets that lie within. Solve puzzles and avoid the carnival workers as you try to escape.
rows.description_html: Achromatic is a first-person horror puzzle game where the player takes the role of a hired technician who has been called in to repair a faulty carousel. Upon entering the carnival however, they find that there is more wrong here than a couple loose wires, and they find that the biggest challenge they will have is escaping the carnival in one piece. Features Of This Game Immersive Experience: Prepare for a night at the carnival, don't forget to stop by the carousel before heading into the funhouse! Haunting Environments: Beware of the funhouse, and who lurks inside Terrifying Monsters: Two monstrous enemies who will chase you down

rows.description_html: Frog Game: Formerly Known as: Phromg Game is a vertical platformer where the layout of platforms changes every play. Jump your way up to Phromg Heaven or dive your way to the Depths of Hell. Avoid bad critters and munch on the tasty bugs, 7 unique areas, over 20 enemies, multiple types of pickup boosts, and 2 paths to glory means there's always somewhere to go. It's Sink or Swim baby!

rows.short_description: Complete physics-based platformer puzzles as you venture deeper into an abandoned research facility responsible for developing ominously powerful quantum entanglement technology.

They awaken alone, with a mysterious ability to manipulate distant objects using quantum entanglement, and must harness this skill to solve puzzles and make their way through the facility.

rows.name: Tales of Agaris
rows.short_description: This game is a prequel to Heroes of Time, set 1000 years before the events of said game.
rows.description_html: This game accurs in the same universe of Heroes of Time A CLASSIC JRPG. Containing all the elements of a turn-based RPG. Elliot, Louis and Kary will be our heroes, facing a man named Lars and other challenges that will be awating for you. Rumors have speculated on the possibility of a frightening creature emerging. Indeed, may religious texts had spoken of the demon's arrival, and some rumors were based on such prophecies. However, the efforts of Lars, among the elite soldiers of King Grimfur's army, has helped to make the emergence a grim reality. Three soldiers work for world peace. They had established themselves in Ágaris, and other portions of the world. One of their stated tasks to revive Rion. King Grimfur has a secret confidence for Rion to become in composition of the ever-grown armies of darkness. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, it is up to you, intrepid heroes, to defeat evil!

rows.name: Realms
rows.short_description: Welcome to Realms, a first-person shooter inspired by the rules and aesthetics of popular tabletop RPGs. Use The Die of Chaos along with your abilities and alternate gun fire to help Fortuna explore different realms and destroy any and all threats along the way.
rows.description_html: You are Fortuna, a young guardian who travels from realm to realm in search of a monster that seeks The Die of Chaos and to destroy your universe. The Die of Chaos is the energy source in which this whole dimension is built on. It is always rolling and calculating random events happening across all realms within this dimension. It is also randomly creating new realms influenced by the Primordial Realms. Without it, the dimension will become still and lifeless. Your mentor, Alden, will help you explore the different realms as you fight, explore, solve puzzles and use all your powers for both exploration and combat. As you traverse through the realms you will have your trusty weapon, the Guardian's Gun. This is the only weapon able to channel The Die of Chaos' energy to aid the guardian. The gun however can also equip magic spells. Throughout the realms the player will encounter magic spells that will be needed to traverse through the realms and reach areas that otherwise would be unreachable. You will also have primary abilities mostly focused on environmental usage. These include double jump, dash, perception, and wave blast. Perception is an ability unique to guardians that allows you to see hidden objects and paths throughout the levels. Wave blast is a force that will knock back enemies, push objects, or break down weak structures. Use all of these abilities and magic spells to combat enemies and explore these unique realms!

rows.name: Cooking Live - Italian Kitchen Simulator
rows.short_description: Hello everyone! My name is Jane, and I need your help! I travel around the world and create a blog about local restaurants and cuisine. I’ve seen how big corporations squeeze out talented local cooks and their restaurants! Let’s take matters into our own hands and give them back their zest for life!
rows.description_html: Cooking Live combines elements of business, time management and cooking games. Progress through the plot step by step and unlock new themed cafe shops and beautiful locations. Whether it's a pizzeria, bakery, or diner, every chef has their own unique taste and their own recipes and stories. Show off your cooking skills and help save every cozy restaurant from the hands of soulless corporations! In this game, you will be traveling around the world in an attempt to revive the failing restaurant business. Be ready to discover stories and help people make their dreams come true. Each episode develops its own unique story. Here are some of them: Episode 1. Good Morning! Good Morning is a cozy restaurant in Amsterdam. The owner, Leah, had gotten tired of her monotonous job at a bank. One day, she decides to change her life and rents an empty building to create a sunny restaurant. But the new work feels too hard, and Leah is about to give up and turn over the location to a fast-food chain. Jane and her cooking show are the last hope to save the restaurant and make Leah’s dream come true! Episode 3. Get Cool Get Cool is a retro drive-in cafe in Atlanta, USA. After college, a happily married couple returns to the city of their childhood to buy a drive-in cafe and breathe new life into the place where they met. But nothing goes as planned, and the once-happy couple is facing a relationship crisis. A junk-food company is ready to buy the place for a song. Jane is there to turn things around and make the drive-in cafe more popular than ever before, so the couple can work together and be happy again. Episode 5. Shell Shell is a seafood restaurant in Tokyo, Japan. Kaito hears about the sale of an old aquarium complex, and he and his wife Asami decide to buy it. Kaito’s dream is to make a restaurant where Asami can put her many years of experience as a restaurateur and culinary ideas to use. But things get complicated when they are forced to sell their house to pay their bills. Desperate for help, Kaito asks Jane to come, hoping she might make a difference. We are currently working on: New episodes: - Detective Story New characters for each new episode and their unique stories. The beginning of Jane and Mike’s story and his betrayal.

rows.name: Pylorus - Footsteps of Greed
rows.short_description: A free 2d roguelite where enemies form a living ecosystem with rivalries and alliances. This is not your war: scavenge some gold and escape with your life... Or stay longer to uncover secrets and more riches, the choice is yours. Strange things happen to those that follow the footsteps of Greed...
rows.description_html: Pylorus is a 2d roguelite with fantasy medieval setting and a few peculiar twists. Enemies form a dynamic ecosystem with factions and rivalries, you'll need to learn how to exploit their behaviour if you want to succeed. It's up to you to decide when a run is over: escape as soon as possible or stay for more gold - but risk losing everything! Can you solve the mysteries hidden in the deepest tunnels? Long-time roguelike players and newcomers alike may enjoy the challenging (yet highly customizable) gameplay and the non-linear complex lore, set in a procedural environment that encourages experimentation and emergent gameplay. Everyone knows that the underground caves are full of gold coins, jewels and gems just scattered around for anyone to collect. But they're also home to horrible monsters, hideous and evil creatures that murder each other and anyone that dares to enter. For every ten people who get in, only one comes back: always traumatized, often wounded... sometimes filthy rich. With such low odds only a madman would willingly descend into the abyss... or perhaps someone with no other options left. Features Living ecosystem From the first few tunnels to the deepest reaches of the Abyss a great and bloody war is taking place. Monsters aren't just mindless entities solely focused on killing the player, their behaviour forms a deadly subterranean ecosystem with alliances and rivalries. You'll need to learn how to exploit these rules to your advantage if you want to survive. Each life is valuable... You can't 'save and reload' your way out of a difficult situation: choices have consequences, accept them and learn from your mistakes. Think twice before sacrificing your characters: 'at least I got a new highscore' means nothing to a newly deceased explorer. ... and each life is worthless This is not your war and you're not a hero. You're just a passerby trying to scavenge some gold and run away without being killed. Your presence underground is mostly inconsequential, and your demise isn't a great accomplishment to the monsters. It's a ruthless world, finding a way to make your life worth something is up to you. Risks and rewards At the end of each level you may decide to leave the underground: your character will return home with the gold he has found, hoping it'll be enough to secure a future for his family. You may decide instead to dive into deeper tunnels to find more gold, perhaps uncover forgotten secrets to help future explorers... But remember: all your efforts are meaningless if you die underground. Discovery and mystery Be mindful of your surroundings, there's more than meets the eye. The story is not directly or linearly told, you may find pieces of lore scattered all around the game. This also applies to game mechanics: the tutorial covers only the basics, it's up to you to figure out what to do. Try not to read guides, it's best if you succeed with your strength alone, learning at your own pace. Observe, make a hypothesis, test your hypothesis, improve, survive. Find your own path Your choices will influence the game, each option has pros and cons and sometimes you'll be making decisions without knowing it. The tools at your disposal will change: you'll need to adapt your strategies. Each level is procedurally generated to make every run unique. There are 'better strategies' but there's no entirely 'right' or 'wrong' way to play, find your own path. Great peril and great rewards await you, as you follow the Footsteps of Greed. My best wishes to you, Explorer. Good luck! FAQ > What the heck am I supposed to do? Discovery is part of the experience, set your own goal and figure out how to achieve it. More exaustive (but still spoiler-free) answer: progress is linked to an internal achievement system, if you feel stuck you may want to scroll through the missing objectives. Unlocking new items is often helpful to make progress. A 'true victory' exists, but finding it may not be easy... > The game is too hard / The game is too easy / The mechanic X is super annoying, can you change it? Each player has fun in different ways and the default experience may not suit everyone. I encourage you to try the game in the original mode first, if you feel it's not your thing you can use the Advanced Settings to make it easier, harder, or to fine-tune everything in detail (a wide range of game-altering options is present). > Is the game really 'free'? Yes, free means free. No content locked behind a paywall, no ingame purchases, no ads, no weird ingame currencies that you get with real-world money, no lootboxes (well, there are chests and crates with loot in the levels, but you probably get what I mean), no malicious software attached. Donations are accepted but not necessary to play. > Can I make videos of this game? Can I stream it? Can I do X, Y or Z? Most likely yes, the game is released under a fairly permissive license and I welcome derivative works in pretty much any form, as long as you provide proper attribution (i.e. a link to the official game page). Sidenote about music licenses, if you record/stream: it may be necessary to add the name of the author and list each track in the video description, i.e. by copying the relevant portions of the ingame credits screen. > Why the name 'Pylorus - Footsteps of Greed'? The first part was a temporary name that I grew attached to, while the second part finds an explanation in the game lore. > Can I change the list of predefined explorer names? Yes, edit the file explorer_names.txt in your game save folder. The list shouldn't be shorter than 100 names (300-400 or more is ideal). You can always input a custom explorer name when starting a new run, regardless of the current name list. > How accessible is this game? Alas, not as much as I wanted: various accessibility features were planned but cut due to lack of time. The missing features may be added in future updates, in the meantime you should check the Advanced Settings for workarounds. > Can you add the language X to the game? Maybe? I don't know language X at all / enough to make a translation, and I can't hire translators. I'm more than willing to add community-made translations however.

rows.name: Arruyo
rows.short_description: Arruyo is a 3D first-person horror game, where the player is inside a farmhouse with different monsters that will try to kill him/her. To survive and discover the mystery of that place, the player will have to hide from these monsters while investigating the farmhouse.
rows.description_html: Spain. In the 1950s. the memories of the civil war still tower over the country. Alone at home, shut away, Francisco paints the horrors of conflict. Remembrances of famine and death torment him, and voices of betrayal echo through the house hallways. Something is near, calling him, crawling inside the walls, deep below the foundation of his house. The heart of the nightmare awaits, for the painter to face the darkest episodes of his life. Arruyo is a 3D first-person horror game inspired by Francisco de Goya’s “Black Paintings” and “ The Disasters of War”. The player will have to uncover the mysteries that await in the house to survive the horrors born of the disasters of the Spanish Civil War. Survival Horror mechanics 3 different levels inspired by the architecture of the country houses of Andalucia. Story inspired by the events that occurred during the Spanish Civil War. Original soundtrack inspired by classical Spanish music. Languages: Spanish, English, Basque. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Navy War: Battleship Games
rows.short_description: Ready for the naval battle? Online ships are waiting for you!
rows.description_html: Navy War is a realistic multiplayer naval combat game of the First and Second World War! Action army games and team battles are waiting for you! Steer a legendary battleship of yesteryear, use naval tactics and destroy enemy ships! Direct your fleet to glorious victory! What are you waiting for, captain?! ONLINE PvP Exciting PvP naval battles - command and attack teams of players from all over the battleship. Prove that you are the best captain in this war game and your fleet is invincible. VARIOUS SHIPS OF THE FIRST AND SECOND WORLD WARS Lots battleships of your choice! From Aurora to Yamato! Choose a fraction you like and fight back against your opponent! TACTICAL ADVANTAGE Choose the warship that suits best your PvP style. When placing ships, be sure to come up with new ideas, constantly change old concepts, use flexible tactics, and improve your strategy to successfully suppress the enemy! DEVELOP AND IMPROVE YOUR FLEET The upgrade systems allow you to create a unique fleet for a military sea shooter. Improve the combat characteristics of battleships, equipment, and weapons. Use emblems, special torpedoes, and consumables to change the course of the combat! AWARDS AND TOURNAMENTS Participate in weekly tournaments, and win prizes and awards! Complete daily quests and challenges for even greater rewards! GREAT GRAPHICS Realistic graphics, colorful special effects, detailed vehicles, wonderful arenas for naval battles, and the irreplaceable military spirit! Ready for the naval battle? Online ships are waiting for you!

rows.short_description: Direct your battleship to glorious victory! Online battle under your leadership!
rows.description_html: Force of Warships is the dynamic online ship battles! The game will give you a valuable experience of participation in military battles! Become the captain of a real battleship and fight against players from all over the world in a dynamic shooter. Steer real ships of the after wartime and the present. Challenge yourself as a captain and send warship of any class to the sea. Use guns, torpedoes, artillery and missiles! Action army games begin! Lead an exciting 3D sea battle, play online with friends against enemies and win epic battles against destroyers, cruisers and battleship! Fight together with players from all over the world, feel the tension of naval combat and wars of ships! Win the Ultimate Victory. ONLINE PvP ACTION GAME Team up and fight multiplayer games with real captains from all over the world. PvP fights will determine the best navy! Prove that you are the best captain in this war game and your fleet is invincible. VARIOUS SHIPS FROM AROUND THE WORLD Drive legendary and modern warships from all over the world from the after wartime and the present! TACTICAL ADVANTAGE Choose the warship that suits best your battle style. All ships will be under your control! And remember, the sea does not forgive mistakes! WEAPON OF VICTORY Use all the weapons of the warship - torpedoes, missiles, guns, and the latest equipment to complete the combat missions of the navy. DEVELOP AND IMPROVE YOUR FLEET Upgrading ships and weapons plays an important role in achieving victory in naval battles. Ship upgrade systems allow your warship to show the highest level in the battle! The system of upgrades and perks will allow you to create a unique fleet for a military shooter. Upgrade your engine, hull and weapons. COOL AWARDS AND TOURNAMENTS Participate in weekly tournaments, win prizes and awards! Complete daily quests and challenges for even greater rewards! GREAT GRAPHICS Modern graphics, excellent special effects, beautiful arenas for sea fight and the irreplaceable spirit of sea battles will allow you to enjoy every second of the battle in the war game! Give the order and a battleship will complete the task! An exciting 3D war shooter will take you to the atmosphere of a naval battle! Compete with your friends for military glory! Ready for the combat ? Join Force of Warships - an online military simulator game that will surpass all expectations. This is for fans of PvP, naval combat and everyone who loves action, military and naval shooters. What are you waiting for, captain?

rows.name: Gamebook Edgar A. Poe: The Oval Portrait
rows.short_description: Put on your headphones, close your eyes and watch the story in your imagination. What seems like a game may be something more. Is it a story waiting to be told or... felt? Enter the universe of Edgar A. Poe, where reason, like the devil, says 'Goodnight'.
rows.description_html: Put on your headphones, close your eyes and watch the story in your imagination... The wisdom that we get from the “already told” stories makes us deeply feel that we cannot hide from the inevitable (*). ⠀ ⠀ Be an active participant in a story true to the original. Play the role intended for you by the master Edgar Allan Poe. and uncover the dark secret behind the portrait of a muse. The show must go on... in the right way. Make choices and follow the illustrative sounds and music. Images arise and disappear in the fumes of the gothic atmosphere. Experience the story as realistically as your imagination allows you to. ⠀ ⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀    Story mode ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀You decide when to unfold the rest of the story. ⠀ ⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀    Explore mode ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀Follow the music to discover locations and push the action forward. ⠀ ⠀ ⠀ We strongly recommend using headphones for the full 3d audio environment experience. Enjoy the Gamebook in your favorite armchair or while traveling. Just run your Gamebook on any laptop/PC. No Internet access is required when installed. Using headphones is strongly recommended. Once you start playing, you don't even need to look at the screen. You will see what you hear through imagination. ⠀ Audio-active production is free , expected adventure time is 30 minutes. ⠀ ⠀ (*) Inspired by: Umberto Eco “I nuovi mezzi di comunicazione e il destino del libro”.

rows.name: Cheese Game
rows.short_description: Armed with nothing more than a dash and a hunger for survival, fend off the beasts that desire to slice you up and put you on a platter (with bread or crackers as a palette cleanser of course).
rows.description_html: Survive! Play as a sentient slice of cheese. Armed with nothing more than a dash and a hunger for survival, fend off the beasts that desire to slice you up and put you on a platter. In this boss rush game, you are confined in a small enclosed space, and you must weave around the boss and their many attacks, and wait for an opportunity to retaliate. Three Unique And Challenging Enemies A miner from deep underground, a sheriff from far in the desert, a ghost king on a floating graveyard, and more to come... Challenge three difficult bosses, and die trying. Each boss has a range of different moves, and a completely different fighting style. Learn their movesets, and work your way to eventually defeating them. Difficulty Settings For All Gamers Fight and master the bosses in 3 different difficulty modes, and compete to beat them all with the least amount of deaths possible.

rows.name: Space Aces
rows.short_description: Space Aces is a video game made for the spring 2022 offering of CAP 4053 at UCF. The player controls a space fighter capable of movement in 3 directions and rotation in 3 directions. The game supports any controller, keyboard, and the Thrustmaster 1600M flight stick.
rows.description_html: Space Aces is a video game made for the spring 2022 offering of CAP 4053 at UCF. The player controls a space fighter capable of movement in 3 directions and rotation in 3 directions. The game supports any controller, keyboard, and the Thrustmaster 1600M flight stick. The game has 3 levels where you will fly a spaceship around a 3d space attempting to shoot down your enemies before they can do the same for you. In space, there is nothing to slow you down, so you will have to do your best to utilize your momentum to your advantage. It can be a challenge to control a spaceship in a dogfight, but that's part of the fun! Fly through asteroid fields avoiding enemy attacks as you get your sights on target and take down your enemies. The game features unique music in each level, with titles and attributions on the credits screen. Joystick Controls: trigger shoot, hat switch heave and sway strafing, center thumb button toggle Flight Assist, left thumb button thrust forward, right thumb button thrust backward, joystick left/right axis roll, joystick up/down axis pitch, joystick twist axis yaw Controller controls: right trigger shoot, left stick has yaw and pitch, right stick has roll and heave, left bumper is backwards thrust, right bumper is forwards thrust, south face button is toggle flight assist keyboard controls: See diagram above. qweasd are translational axes and uiojkl are rotational axes. left shift is toggle flight assit, and space bar is shoot. There is no pause menu. We had last minute issues getting it to work. If you cant beat the game, and you get stuck on a level, you'll have to alt f4 the game.

rows.name: Cyrah's Ascent
rows.short_description: Cyrah's Ascent is a third-person combat game with high mobility. Imbued with essence, Cyrah must defeat the Laust and avenge her people.
rows.description_html: Following the destruction of her village and people by the Laust, Cyrah takes up the mantle of the Ancient Matriarchs to avenge her people. Harness the power of Essence in its multiple forms to scale the mountain and destroy the source corrupting the land in Cyrah’s Ascent. In this 3D action combat game, channel ancient powers into several ranged spells and melee attacks to deal with several different enemies. Use your Essence-enhanced capabilities to jump and dash to the peak, traversing the snowy landscape riddled with crumbling remnants of a forgotten civilization. By destroying the source of their power, Cyrah hopes to bring peace to her ravaged homeland. Face-paced melee and ranged combat, allowing the player to choose how they approach enemy encounters. Dynamic ambient audio and music. Immersive environments, ranging from ancient temples to frigid mountains. An array of unique enemy types Engaging traversal through caves, chasms, and decrepit architecture. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Endure Island
rows.short_description: On a deserted island, a recurring phenomenon of large numbers of infected individuals appearing and disappearing continued. It was discovered that the cause was a virus, and efforts to uncover the virus and eradicate it have begun.
rows.description_html: Basic Explanation On a deserted island, there was a repeated phenomenon of large numbers of infected individuals appearing and then disappearing. As a result of the investigation, it was discovered that a virus was the cause, and the organization to which the protagonist belongs began an investigation. The player’s goal is to uncover the mystery of this virus and eradicate it. This game is developed using Unreal Engine, and we have released videos explaining the development process up to version 0.1 on YouTube. We hope this will be of some help to anyone interested in game development. Virus Research The abnormal phenomena occurring on this deserted island are caused by the virus. It continuously mutates and multiplies, gradually making the environment more hostile. The player's objective is to research and eradicate this virus. First, you must explore various areas and collect items from which the virus can be extracted for research. Your role is to understand the virus's characteristics and interactions, and then bring the results back to headquarters. Research takes time, but you can speed up the process significantly by conducting research simultaneously at multiple facilities or by injecting a large quantity of the virus into specific equipment. However, you can't begin anything without first acquiring the virus. Players won't just wait around either. As the story progresses, you'll be able to release the virus from your research facilities. For example, you can release a virus found in the 'forest' into the 'city,' causing changes that wouldn't normally occur in that environment. Promote virus proliferation to improve investigation efficiency. Trigger mutations through interactions between different viruses. Utilize virus interference to mitigate environmental degradation. Since there are viruses that cannot be acquired solely through exploration, it's crucial to uncover their interactions and continue your research. However, be careful—recklessly releasing viruses can quickly make the environment much harsher. Escape The player always has one most important goal: to survive and return from the deserted island alive. If you fail to make it back, you’ll lose everything you've gained from the exploration. Call a helicopter via the radio attached to the virus research facility and escape. However, it will take time for the helicopter to arrive, so act before the situation becomes too difficult to survive. The virus on this deserted island has the characteristic of repeatedly appearing and disappearing, so the next time you explore, you'll start from the same initial conditions. Moreover, items you obtain on the island likely have viruses attached, so you can't bring them back to headquarters. Your equipment will also reset to its initial state. Memory Knowledge obtained by completing quests, repaired equipment, and unlocked doors are saved as 'memory' and carried over to the next investigation. This memory can lead to the development of new scenarios in future explorations, so be sure to actively progress through quests alongside virus research. Mutants Mutants are created through virus mutations. They spread contamination around them, so long-term close combat should be avoided. Mutants appear frequently depending on the virus's state, but by stabilizing the mutation, you can prevent their appearance. Progression Players can grow through the skill tree, acquiring new abilities, enhancing their stats, and expanding the range of items they can craft. Additionally, as virus analysis progresses, weapon mods and virus inoculation features will be unlocked, significantly broadening the scope of gameplay.

The Constantine is a world that exists inside Nathan's tree. After spring, summer, autumn and winter, the world goes to sleep. Level up the most in a year, collect the most money, win the most battles, etc. Achieve your goals and leave your name in the rankings. 1. Catch monsters, get items, money, and experience! When you accumulate experience points, you can level up, and when you change jobs at a certain level, you can acquire skills. [ Key Description ] 1) Direction keys (↑↓←→) to move, Space to attack, and Z to pick up items. 2) Shortcuts can be modified as desired. 3) Chat is the Enter key. 4) To talk to the NPC, click it with the mouse. Equip items (swords, bows, hats) and hit the world! 2. There are 4 major job changes. Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Archer. Warrior: Use high HP and armor to deal with monsters in the forefront. Wizard: Defeat multiple enemies with elemental magic and area magic. Protects allies through castle attribute magic Rogue: Specializes in 1v1 attacks and secures mobility through utility skills. Deals more damage to debuffed opponents. Archer: Weak HP, but strong against long-range attacks. Debuff skills can be used to make opponents vulnerable. Catch boss monsters with your colleagues using skills appropriate for each class! 3. If you get a rare item, you will be able to feel different from others. Explore the wide world and meet many friends! [Guide after starting the game] [Sign Up] 1) Enter the ID and Password you want to create. 2) Click the Register button at the bottom. (Your ID and password are not encrypted. Please enter a password that only you know, but you don't mind being exposed to the outside world. ex. 12345132 etc.) 3) If 'creation succeeded!' appears in the text above, membership registration is complete. ​[Login] 1) Enter the ID and Password to log in. 2) Click the Login button on the right. 3) Select a server. (Connect to the Int(X) Skaia(O) server.) [When starting for the first time] ​1) Since the character creation window appears, select the desired nickname and appearance and click the Create button at the bottom. 2) Direction keys (↑↓←→) to move, Space to attack, and Z to pick up items. 3) Shortcuts can be modified as desired. 4) Chat is the Enter key. 5) To talk to the NPC, click it with the mouse. [When you want to quit] ​1) Click the Exit button at the bottom right to log out and move to the login window. 2) If you want to exit, press the X window in the upper right corner. (For full screen, press Alt+Enter and press X window!)

rows.name: It's Dark
rows.short_description: There has been a containment breach in a secret facility located deep underground. Experiment E.C.H.O has escaped and is running loose. The lab has gone into shutdown mode, and it's dark...
rows.description_html: It's Dark is an asymmetrical multiplayer (3 vs 1) survival horror game that takes place in a lab on lockdown. One player plays as the monster, who must track and kill the other players to escape the lab. Up to three other players can play as scientists, who are tasked with exploring the lab and finding a way to subdue the monster. Features: -The Lab is procedurally generated so each game will be completely unique. -Making noise creates a notification ping that can alert players to your position. You'll need to be conscious of the noise you make in-game if you don't want to get discovered. -The dark environment makes for some tense gameplay. You'll never know what might around the corner...

rows.name: Almost Home Now
rows.short_description: A 10 minute horror experience of a girl walking home alone at night.
rows.description_html: A little girl finds herself having to walk home alone in the middle of the night. The empty roads seem a tad more ominous than usual. Control the protagonist in this 3rd-person fixed-camera horror game. Navigate your way through 4 distinct-themed areas as they get progressively more disturbing. At the same time, a stalker inches closer and closer. Quiet residential streets... Eerie park paths... Creepy woods trail... And just outside of the home, where things take an unexpected turn... Can you make sure the girl gets home safe and sound?

rows.name: Survive 10 Minutes Please
rows.short_description: Survive 10 minutes please is an action roguelike 2D zombie game where you have to survive a zombie horde by any means. Kill them, Upgrade yourself, Choose your abilities and try your best to survive in a challenging game.
rows.description_html: Survive 10 minutes please is an action roguelike 2D zombie game with a touch of RPG elements where you have to survive a zombie horde by any means. Kill them, Upgrade yourself, Choose your abilities and try your best to survive in a challenging game. FEATURES Choose the ability to upgrade yourself - Kill Them, Earn XP, Level Up, and Choose different abilities to survive against the ruthless horde. Challenging Survival - You have to survive for just 10 minutes, but it will not be easy. You have to think strategically about when to use landmines and grenades which are limited, a knife that consumes stamina, and a gun that has limited bullets to use against different types of enemies. Each run will be different - except for starting zombies you will encounter, Each run generates a Zombies horde, and items drop randomly so each run will give you a new experience. You will Die a lot - This game is hard so expect more death before completion of a game. Each death will give you a better understanding of a game. Controller Support - This game support controller to play, even without a controller game works well with the keyboard too. Stamina system and RPG elements - in this game knife is the only melee weapon that is unlimited to use but consumes stamina to use, so watch out for it. grenades, landmines, and bullets are limited but can obtain as drop items by a dead enemy. Note that all enemies will not drop items so use resources wisely. Adrenaline Rush and Health regeneration : your health will regenerate very slightly automatically after some time. Your stamina will regenerate more quickly if your health is below 20 percent. Dodge System : Dodge the enemy attack and counter-attack them.

rows.name: Picking Wheat
rows.short_description: This game is mainly composed of two parts: you are forced to watch some author's nonsense, and some simple puzzle levels. There are 9 preset levels to help players understand the basic rules of the puzzle. Free level editor, players can edit and upload levels, Download them, and give your likes!
rows.description_html: A puzzle game in simple visual style. Can you finish all the work in a whole day and get home successfully? Text adventure Some dreamy talk about the hidden diseases in modern society. There are nine visual novel chapters in total. Each chapter describes a theme in different forms. The themes includes the self, emotion, gender, etc. Each chapter is about to cost three minutes. If players are not interested in this part, they can skip it. Puzzle levels Some walking puzzle levels with simple rule. There are nine preset levels in total. Arrow keys control player movement. Each time the player crosses a cube panel, the number displayed on the cube will be reduced by one. After the number of one cube panel is reduced to zero, player can no longer pass through it. Player's goal is to reduce the number of all cube panels to zero and reach the end. If players are not interested in this part, they can skip it. Level editor In addition to the preset puzzle levels, each player can freely create his own level and upload it. This section requires a mouse. At the same time, you can browse all uploaded levels in the level bank, try them, and decide whether you like them.

rows.name: NanoHive
rows.short_description: Manage your hive of nanobots in a Free-to-Play top-down arena shooter and exterminate all the bacteria and viruses infecting the body. Multiply the hive by absorbing bacteria to save people's lives as fast as possible while competing with others in order to become the fastest NanoHive Operator.
rows.description_html: JOIN THE COMMUNITY Join us and be a part of the development of NanoHive and Tower of Sins (our next game) About the Game NanoHive is a fast-paced top-down shooter playing out inside of a human body. You are the Operator of a high-tech hive of nanobots with only one goal in mind, eradicating all the pesky bacteria and viruses as fast as possible. Explore and disinfect the different organs. Your tool is also your most important resource. Nanobots act as your health, ammunition and fuel. Manage them carefully. Nanobots are designed to absorb the organic matter present in bacteria so that they can multiply themselves. You need to be as fast as possible when lives are on the line. Being faster than the other Operators on the leaderboard doesn't hurt either.

rows.name: Champ's Nightmare
rows.short_description: Champ's Nightmare is a horror immersive audio game for the visually impaired which prioritizes ears over eyes.
rows.description_html: Champ's Nightmare is a horror audio game that is played entirely through sound with no visual input. The player must rely completely on their hearing to succeed. The objective of Champ's Nightmare is to avoid the monster, rescue the children, and escape the haunted cabin. The purpose of the game is to be fully accessible to visually impaired individuals. Champ's Nightmare is very narrative focused, and the controls only uses the arrow keys, escape key, and enter/return key. Headphones are strongly recommended. *Academic project*

rows.name: Forest of Tails: Arena
rows.short_description: Forest of Tails: Arena is a real-time action arena game that pits you against bugs, animals, and even other mice. Fight your way through waves, gain new skills, and loot powerful equipment to fight your way to the top.
rows.description_html: Forest of Tails: Arena puts you in the role of a mouse fighting in the Fieval arena for eternal mouse glory. Use stick, axe, and acorn to defeat wave after wave of angry enemies. Forest of Tails: Arena is a real-time action arena game that pits you against bugs, animals, and even other mice. Fight your way through waves, gain new skills, and loot powerful equipment to fight your way through progressively more difficult levels. Death doesn't mean the end for you; pick yourself back up and continue from your last checkpoint with all your skills and equipped gear in tact. Play Your Way After creating and customizing your mouse, you'll be thrust into the pits. Do you want to bludgeon ants using a rock warhammer? Maybe you'd rather poison lizards using your bow fashioned from plant roots. You'll be given lots of options on how to take down the unique enemies you'll find in the game. Level up and Grow Earn and select perks every time you level up. As you grow and improve your character, better and more unique randomized loot will drop for you. Combine weapon and character talents to create a force to be reckoned with. Fight, Die and Fight Again Death is only the beginning. Every time you die, you can take your equipped gear and stats back into the fight at your last checkpoint. Grind your way to the top and fight the biggest, baddest enemies that the arena can throw at you.

rows.name: The Purge Dilemma
rows.short_description: Do you have the intuition and cunning to successfully save yourself from the purges of a paranoid dictator? Prove your loyalty to the Tyrant in this social deduction game designed for 5-10 players.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Your lives depend on one man's paranoia: the Tyrant. Assume the role of the a paranoid tyrannical dictator and find out who among the other players is sabotaging the interests of the Committee. In this social deduction game you will test your investigative and deception skills. Will you be clever enough to save yourself before the Tyrant's paranoia reaches its peak? You will have proved your loyalty (or not) if your name does not appear among the victims of the Purges. Every member of the Committee will be able to run a Commissariat and choose who to include in it. All member will vote for or against the proposed Commissariat. Attention! For every rejected Commissariat proposal, instability rises - if it reaches its climax it will be a victory for the dissidents, and a shameful defeat for the loyalists. PLAY AS Step into the shoes of the dictator himself and carefully observe the behaviour of the players involved in a Commissariat. Gather as much information as possible in your notebook and unmask the dissidents sitting at the Committee table. Distribute special permits to the members of the Committee so that they may assist you in uncovering the dissidents. But careful! It would be a great waste if you gave that special permit to a traitor! Keep an eye on your paranoia: when the limit is reached you will be forced to pick the victims of your purges. Choose your victims carefully: leaving a dissident alive will cost you the entire game! Prove your innocence to the members of the Committee so that you may be chosen as a member of the Commissariat. Finish the tasks chosen by the Commissar to keep the Tyrant's paranoia at bay and be rewarded with special permits. Make use of the special permits given to you by the Tyrant to gather further information on the other members of the Committee. If you have a clear conscience all you have to do is prove to the Tyrant that you are not the one to kill. Prove your (false) innocence to the members of the Committee so that you may be chosen as a member of the Commissariat. Sabotage the tasks assigned to a Commissariat to raise the Tyrant's paranoia uncontrollably. Maintain a low profile! Sabotaging is risky and will only shrink the bubble around you.

rows.name: Pacifish
rows.short_description: Pacifish is an incremental fishing management game with several mechanics to interact with and improve. It can be played both idly, or more actively to progress faster.
rows.description_html: Pacifish is an incremental fishing management game with several mechanics to interact with and improve. It can be played both idly, or more actively to progress faster. Fish - Acquire and equip poles and tackle to fish in 6 unlockable areas. Fight - Disturbing the waters causes both the fish and the materials to fight back. Earn pixels to improve fighting stats. Hatch - Set up and upgrade incubators to hatch large quantities of fish. Eat - Consume those large quantities to improve stats such as fishing speed and fight stats. Swim - Manually take control of a fish to eat other fish and gain resources. Gamble - Spend your earned coin to play slots, or test your memory in a match game. Craft - Use materials to craft new poles and tackle, as well as create mods to alter pole stats.

rows.name: MARVEL SNAP
rows.short_description: MARVEL SNAP is a fast-paced Collectible Card Game that reimagines the genre with innovative mechanics. Winner of multiple awards like 'Best Strategy Game' and 'Breakthrough Game of the Year,' we invite you to join millions of players worldwide – Jump right in!
rows.description_html: MARVEL SNAP is a fast-paced, award-winning collectible card game with innovative mechanics that has been called 'accessible, and utterly brilliant' and 'one of the best card games' today. Build your deck of 12 cards. Each Card represents a Marvel Super Hero or Villain, each with a unique power or ability. The goal of the game is to outsmart and outwit your opponent. Learning how to play only takes a few minutes, and matches only takes 3 minutes. Download now and find out what everyone is talking about! The game is designed so that every match feels different. Play your cards at 50+ different locations across the Marvel Universe, each with iconic game-changing abilities. From Asgard to Wakanda, new locations are introduced regularly to put your creative problem-solving skills to the test. No more waiting around! Every game lasts only around three minutes. We cut out the fluff to focus more on the good stuff. Every player begins with a Free Starter Deck that helps you get started. From there, you can earn new cards to add to your collection simply by playing and mastering the game.Unlike other games in the Collectible Card Game Genre, there are no card packs in MARVEL SNAP. You can Play More to Earn More. Available on both mobile AND Desktop PC. Play anywhere, any time you want. Register your account and your progress stays with you across different platforms. 'SNAP' is a unique mechanic in the game that lets you raise the stakes during a match and apply pressure on your opponent. For example, if you think you have a winning hand, use the 'SNAP' mechanic to double down and potentially double your rewards. Hey, even if you're bluffing —you could double your rewards! Each card in your deck is a unique character from the Marvel Multiverse. No other game lets you collect, mix, and match hundreds of hero and villain art variants from the entire MARVEL Universe—and beyond. You might have a classic comic inspired Iron Man card, but do you also have the Chibi, 8-bit, and Cartoon variants? I am Groot. I AM Groot. I am GROOT. I am Groot? I am Groot. I AM GROOT! I am GROOT. I am Groot? MARVEL SNAP stays fresh and exciting with new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly. You don't have to wait months for updates! The game only takes a few minutes to learn and 3 minutes to play. Jump right in and find out why MARVEL SNAP won multiple industry awards!

rows.name: Fly By Knight
rows.short_description: Fly and fight your way through the magically altered tree you once called home! Free your friends from the prison gems that bind them! Find all your friends to open up an escape portal and get to safety!
rows.description_html: Fly By Knight is an action/platformer game where you control an adventurous bird trying to free your helpless critter friends from prison gems created by a dark magic sorcerer. To do so, you must confront enemy minions, besting them with your sword attacks and flying skills. To reach your cuddly friends, you must break through the barriers and beat up the nasty slimes that trapped you in a branch of the tree you once called home. Bounce your way through the mushroom patch, battle your way through the fierce enemy gauntlet, and glide your way through precarious wind tunnels, avoiding the fireball flowers within. If you get hurt along the way, take a birdbath in the healing pool to heal up! If you get hungry along the way, snack on some cherries! Don’t forget to save some for your critter friends! Collect all of them to unlock the true ending… Once your friends are free, escape through the magical portal created by the ancient magic residing in the prison gems combined with the power of friendship. Platforming, flying, and combat! 80 hidden cherries to hunt down! Alternate endings! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Just A Humble Swordsmith
rows.short_description: Craft swords from a variety of styles and materials in order to best equip the adventurers who come into your sword smithing shop. Strategize and watch the adventurers fight their way through a dungeon full of monsters in this idle battler!
rows.description_html: In Just A Humble Swordsmith, you play as a smith who has set up shop next to the entrance to a cave full of dangerous monsters. Meet the brave (and reckless) adventurers that come in, craft them a variety of powerful and exciting swords, then send them on their way through the cave to clear out the danger. The adventurers fight completely automatically, so you can focus on finding your favorite strategies or just try to make the coolest sword you can. Craft fantastical materials into a variety of sword styles for a huge number of possible combinations Make use of the unique stats and talents of named adventurers to find the best strategy for each one Watch as the adventurer fights through a diverse dungeon full of exciting new monsters and backdrops Progress through challenging boss battles and collect new crafting options at each checkpoint Enjoy colorful sprites and lively music with a retro 16-bit inspired aesthetic This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Amalgamy
rows.short_description: Blend into the crowd, track down your friends and win the game.
rows.description_html: Amalgamy is a game of blending in. Act like the characters around you as you go about your task of activating all the rings. All the while, your friends are doing the same. You can kill nearby characters at the risk of revealing yourself. Or use one of the many abilities to remain hidden, reveal others, or change the flow of the game. Activate all of the rings to win, or be the last man standing. Be careful with who you kill, as it may reveal to the others who you truly are. Game Customization & Extras Population, cooldowns, abilities, etc... Randomly spawned ability pouch. A toxic rat that can reveal players and give you a gift. Obstacles to change the flow of the game. Over 20 Abilities Acquire and use abilities during the game to reveal players, blend back into the crowd, or change the flow of the game entirely. Recommended for 2 - 4 players, although it supports up to 8. If you are playing with 2 players, then I recommend increasing the starting abilities to make it more fun.

rows.name: Offenders
rows.short_description: Make deals with people to identify and distract your enemies in order to eliminate them one by one and clear the areas from them until you reach their leader.
rows.description_html: Every mission will start as if you don't know anyone in the area and you have to roam and talk to people to reveal the enemies to you and try to avoid them by making deals with people or by your skills until you reach the end of the mission. At the end of each mission, you will be exposed to a specific situation such as hostage rescue, weapon store bombing, etc. and you have to think how you will accomplish this using your skills.

rows.name: Treats Please!
rows.short_description: This is a retro-styled puzzle game about keeping a hungry pet happy with tasty treats. Choosing treats the pet will enjoy will reduce their hunger strength level and choosing things they cannot eat will only make them hungrier!
rows.description_html: This is a free game in which you must keep a hungry pet happy by clicking on tasty treats. This is a simple, low-stakes puzzle game with retro styling. During the game, random items appear in a 3x3 grid, and the player must click the best items in order to keep the pet's hunger level from reaching maximum and ending the game. Sometimes, it is necessary to choose unwanted items on purpose in order to make room for new, good items, and learning when to take those losses at the right times is important to staying in the game longer. If you end up with all bad options, then clicking the 'SCRATCH' button will scratch the board clear and reveal new options. The goal of the game is to keep the hunger bar from reaching maximum for as long as possible. Key Features Handcrafted Pixel Art Pets Simple Gameplay Mechanics Retro Style Family-Friendly

rows.name: REFLEXIA Prototype ver.
rows.short_description: REFLEXIA's story starts out as a parody of its genre and ends as a psychological drama.
rows.description_html: The protagonist spends her days cooped up inside, sinking countless hours into eroges. She would've ended up bored to death eventually, if one day she wasn't teleported into a visual novel! Of course, something like this isn't exactly a good situation for the young lady. Not only will you be privy to all of her shameful thoughts, you'd also demand entertainment from her. Isn't that why you came to read this story? Seems like she will now, at the very least, need to go outside to buy groceries... Because no matter where she goes, the plot will await her! rows.name: Iron Order 1919
rows.short_description: An unique long-term strategy game with week-long matches with up to 101 players, set in the alternate reality of 1919.
rows.description_html: 1919 - “The Great War” continues. Europe has been trapped in a fierce fight over dominance. Continuous research and several technological breakthroughs lead to the creation of so-called Mechs. Towering war machines that roam the battlefield clad in thick armor, wielding never before seen firepower. Soldiers become mere bystanders in a war that will be decided in a cataclysmic clash of both man and machine, as well as a nation's sheer will to pay the toll of blood and iron. Iron Order is your chance to make a mark on battle-torn Europe. Enter an accelerated race driving technology to levels the early 20th century has never seen. In Multiplayer matches with up to 101 players you are asked to plan your strategy wisely and lead your nation to victory! Matches run in real-time on World Maps based on World War 1 scenarios and beyond . Nations are split into smaller provinces with unique properties that influence resource production or terrain types. The goal is to take over the majority of the map . To achieve your target, you have full control over your nation's economic developments, technological research, military advancements and diplomatic relations with other players. Work together, against each other and never trust your alliance fully - when power is in reach, everyone becomes an enemy. Will you still let your people fight with scythes or plan ahead and join the technological revolution? Regular updates expand the lore and add variety to the game's gameplay. We are just starting the journey of Iron Order, there is a lot to come, and we can’t wait to hear about your experiences in the game and your feedback. Welcome! Build your strategy around fantastical and historical units of the era! Long Term Strategy in Real-Time Weaponry based on popular Dieselpunk, Teslapunk and Steampunk ideas featuring Mechs and Robots Every unit type is featuring a special “Titan” class with incredible power and utility Play with up to 101 players per match Maps based on historical events and beyond

rows.name: Bug Dolls: Soviet Project
rows.short_description: This is a horror game about a small town engulfed in dangerous dolls.
rows.description_html: The action takes place in the small town of Zhukovsk. In the autumn of 1991, the entire population of the town was evacuated for an unknown reason. You are an ordinary resident of the city who did not have time to evacuate and you are forced to get out on your own. In the game you need to explore the deserted city, solve puzzles and find a way out of the situation. Dangerous mutated beetle dolls operate on the streets. Either kill or run away is up to you. After some time, you will be able to make two types of weapons. The location of the game is a semi-open world. You can go to many buildings located in the city, all places are unique in their own way. Models and environments are made with meticulous accuracy, which will allow you to feel the whole atmosphere of horror on yourself. You are not limited in your actions. You can study some part at once, then proceed to the passage of the main storyline, which will allow you to discover new places. Buying the game you will get: More than 15 hours of exciting game play. Responsive operation. Beautiful graphics. 3 different endings and an alternate playthrough. Pleasant music. Excellent optimization. Good luck in the passage!

rows.name: Liminus: The Silent Guard
rows.short_description: Souls on their perilous journey through the afterlife are left defenseless against the hungry darkness without the protective guidance of the Shepherds. Locate your flock, protect them from wolves, and guide them safely back home with your array of abilities and powers in Liminus: The Silent Guard.
rows.description_html: In Liminus: The Silent Guard, the player plays as the Shepherd: an eternal being searching to rescue the lost souls, or sheep, in the land known as the Inbetween. The Shepherd is to guide the sheep to shrines, a safe area for both of them and the place where sheep can continue on their journey in the afterlife. But beware, dangers lurk in dark places and the sheep can easily go astray. The further away the sheep and the Shepherd are from the shrines, the more danger they are in from wild wolves who prowl the darkness looking for the souls to bring to their dens and the guard wolves who protect the dens from the Shepherds. Liminus is an adventure game with strategy, simple puzzle solving, and collection elements. Strategize yourself because the Shepherd has limited yet replenishable light that powers his abilities. Call out to the darkness to find your sheep and defend against wolves by whacking them with your staff, stunning them with your light, or pushing them away with a castable shield. Every wild wolf killed generates a darker side to the Shepherd, kill enough wolves and you will be able to transform into the Reaper! An ultimate ability where you can move fast, kill wolves quickly, and destroy the otherwise unbeatable guard wolves that protect the dens. As your flock grows as you collect sheep, your light abilities will become stronger. But beware, inexperienced Shepherds will struggle with a large flock in difficult areas and wolves can still pick off your sheep. If a sheep becomes captured the Shepherd has to retrieve it from the dens and guide it to safety in order to progress to the next gated area. No souls are to be left behind. There is a Tutorial available to learn the abilities of the game and two levels to play. The Village includes two gated areas to complete with over 60 sheep to find and many wolves to battle around and The Woods is the other area available for players to play that will challenge them in their puzzle skills due to the higher number of sheep required to complete the level. About this project: This was a capstone project at BYU. Built by students within a year for the purpose of learning how to make games, collaborate as a team, and finish something enough for publication. Because of that, support and continual work on this game is limited to individual team members and their schedules as they move towards graduation. Bugs and issues with the game are welcome to be reported on, but please be aware they are the result of once-inexperienced people learning experience on the job. Regardless, our team is proud of the rich game we made and we welcome any and all interest in it! We hope someday it can continue to grow into something beyond what we made as students.

rows.name: The Way of the Badass
rows.short_description: Join Scarlet, Princess of Badass, in her crusades against the takeover of aliens, monsters, hybrids, and 'Cancel Culture' as she brings toughness back to humanity. Lead desperate allies, from a Nazi to a hobo and other Special Ed students, in liberating humankind from the satire of the Far Left.
rows.description_html: The Way of the Badass is a third-person, 2D shooter that features basic movement controls, a wide spectrum of weaponry, and a heavy emphasis on visual storytelling. Being 2D, most movement is done by going either left or right, with some up and down depending on pathways and efforts to dodge incoming enemy projectiles. An interactive cartoon! Drawn and completely created by Jay Geis himself, he alone single-handedly devised this on a team of none but himself, on a zero dollar budget, and on a part-time schedule. The whole experience should feel like playing through one of his comics (specifically set in the 'Short Bus' franchise on the timeline set 30 years after the original 'Hero Team' stories). Witness what nothing but raw enthusiasm can bring to the table! Female Protagonist! The adventure centers around a 5-year-old girl who's looking for her family - and her father specifically, a retired Colonel and World War III veteran. The story is told through her eyes, those adorable yet mean-spirited eyes. Colorful Characters! From the Duke of Badass named Duke Pope who's humbly serving as Scarlet's lieutenant, to a hobo whose guts and glory aspire to set the world record for 'most swear words in a video game', to a literal Nazi that holds the torch onto the failed ideology of World War II, each of the characters are distinct and memorable for their own no-holding-back attitudes when faced with the seemingly impossible challenge of restoring the artificial order of humanity as the masters of the Earth. Defy the censors, and resist the Thought Police! Such oppression is lurking in this world, even in the formerly Libertarian haven of Las Vegas, Nevada. And it's going to take an absurd crew to break through the conditioning of sappiness. That means ruling over a secret society called the 'Kingdom of Badass'! Learn more about their culture, where punks, Nazis, and American soldiers unite! Explore the lore! Tidbits are hidden throughout various locations that reveal what has happened in this fictional alternate timeline, spanning from the 2010s to the game's present in the 2040s. See what the kids who 'Ride the Short Bus' are taught in their museums and history textbooks. Full Voice Acting! Featuring the debut of Jay's voice talents, witness this single, lonely male perform as a little girl, a Nazi Stormtrooper, a mentally insane homeless person, a grizzled war veteran, a grizzly Viking Berserker, a knife whooshing through the air, and many more! Rock out to an all metal soundtrack! Also introducing the debut of Jay's performance as a GUITAR WARRIOR! From the psychotic noise of Violet, to the viking's roar, and the trippy vibes inside an alien's brain, each song has its own unique identity. Conduct unethical experiments on the invaders and their abominable creations! Don't just kill the tyrants. Torture them with methods including but not limited to: fire and acid, psychological trauma inflicted from school, and COVID! Secrets and Easter Eggs! There are a slew of cute little goodies! Some of them give early access to powerful weapons, and others are there just for fun. Unabridged Dev Diary! If you've ever wanted to pick Jay's brain, there is a way to do that. Get more info than you've ever wanted to know, every step of the creation process, involving not only behind-the-scenes but ALSO behind-the-behind-the-scenes! (That would be in the 'News' feeds and similar announcements pages, not necessarily in the game itself.) Free...not free, asterisk; free, exclamation mark! No external info stealers, no 'in-app purchases' or 'microtransactions', no invasive advertising, no DRM, no fine print, and no horse manure! This is so chock full of potential and equally juxtaposed by obscurity, Jay is giving it away for free! So tell all your family, friends, and pets about the journey of this Patron Saint of Cruel and Unusual Punishment!

rows.name: Ultimate Fighters
rows.short_description: 2D Fighting game
rows.description_html: This game is a fighting game where martial artists fight in 1 vs 1 battles. Use a variety of techniques to defeat your enemies. You can guard against punches and kicks, but you cannot guard against throws. You can use commands to perform special moves. You win if you reduce your opponent's HP to zero first. You can switch between modes or difficulty on the chara & stage selection screen. Clear all stages in the story & arcade mode to reach the ending. On the menu screen, you can check your technique commands and return to the title screen. You can use the keyboard or PS4 or XBOX360 controller to control the game. Saving is done automatically. Japanese and English languages are supported, and can be switched on the title screen. Press F1 to go full screen.

rows.name: Heroes of Time - Aizack's Return
rows.short_description: This sequel is in the MV version. Totally revamped and faithful to the previous game made on VX Ace. Everything you experienced in the 1st and 2nd game is redone with MV graphics.
rows.description_html: Last episode on RPG Maker MV The trilogy ends using RPG Maker MV engine. The last chapter of this saga totally remastered with MV graphics and systems. A side view battle system that was made for those who prefer seeing our heroes by this way. In this game you will be able to walk through the time constantly. You will choose between travelling in the past or in the future to save the timeline. There will be many tracks to go. Which will be yours? Soon more information about the new system that will be present on the 3rd chapter. Direct continuation of Heroes of Time. The story took place between two parallel realities (two of the seven possible endings from the previous game). The first being Aizack, who were defeated by Henzo and his friends in the previous story has now reawakened by the help of Lars, whose goal is to travel further in time, to the future from where he (Aizack) came. The other story took place right after Henzo and his group defeated Cronos, undoing any damage done to the timeline they once fickled. Timeless Game The premise In this third and final episode of the trilogy, it is now possible to travel through both the future and the past through the emblems on the ground that are found in various places around Ágaris. These emblems are time cracks opened due to Aizack's journey with his time machine. The user is teleported to a place known as the temporal dimension. This place connects the past to the present through open time cracks (through the emblems), making it possible to travel at any time to the future where Aizack, and Lars runs their evil schemes, as well as traveling to other emblems scattered in the past, thus giving the player freedom to face Aizack, and Lars at any point in the game. It's now up to the player to decide when they want to face Aizack in the future, only this time, however though, Lars and Aizack would not b e the only threat there, there is another being… the one that were once brought near destruction... in the land of Agaris. HENZO - A little more mature than in the last game, always carrying the Omega pistol in his pocket, he is taken by surprise by the appearance of Aizack, Lars and Gorgos in the middle of a movie session with his friends. WILLIE - Disappointed by the fact of not being remembered by people for the heroism he did in the last game, he faces yet another opportunity to be considered a hero. LENNA - With a guilty conscience for having done what she did to her trusted grandfather, she suspects that her grandfather is only in jail due to the corrections Cronos made, is also caught by a surprise by the arrival of a 'second version' of your grandfather from the past. EROS - Former Prince of Aqala, revived by Lars in events from the previous game, in this sequel he travels to the future precisely to let Henzo, Willie and Lenna know what is happening. AIZACK - Despite being killed long ago, in the year 1130, he is found on the edge of a river by Lars, alive. The two formed alliance and went with a scheme, to get revenge on Henzo and his friends. However, in another reality, in the year 2130, Aizack finds himself in a different situation because of certain someone. LARS - The person responsible for every tragedy that happened, After being defeated in the previous game, he recovers and finds Aizack seriously injured by those who were later known as the Hero of Agaris, with the two have their motives set, devised a scheme to get revenge on those who defeated him, traveling with the help of Aizack's intellect to build a device that takes them to the future where Henzo thought he saved the world

rows.name: Just Another Runner
rows.short_description: Take a quick enigmatic run up memory lane. Don't even think about slowing down, 'cause the present surely won't.
rows.description_html: Take a quick enigmatic run up memory lane. Don't even think about slowing down, 'cause the present surely won't. Run, jump, slide and boost through four levels of this short, satirical and mildly abstract exploration of contemporary nostalgia. Maintain your boost to keep running and break your 'Boost Record'. Featuring FMV cutscenes. Come on up and stay a while.

rows.short_description: Go about your normal every day life and meet new friends in this short visual novel!
rows.description_html: Are you a human? Well in this game, you can play as one! Start your day and go about your normal, everyday life, making new friends along the way. Don't like making tough choices? Well you're in luck, because this game doesn't have any! All you have to do is sit back and enjoy this short visual novel, which may or may not contain something behind the door. Features: Length: Short (15-30 minutes) Unique music and graphics Warning: This game contains flashing lights and imagery. Player discretion is advised.

rows.description_html: Check Out My New Horror Game Color Fear!                                     Color Fear is on Steam, Wishlist and Play Demo Now! About the Game Fiora Arc Care for the island while fighting for your life to escape Cardigan Fight Your Way Through B's Life And Whoever Stands In His Way Enjoy a rich and simple fighting system that will make you come back for more. Pick, Plant, Water and Grow Flowers For Stats Find and collect your favorite flower seeds to grow your own flowers. These flowers will help raise your stats in Cardigan. Control A Colony Within The Flowers You Plant Become a leader of a Pippen colony. Pippen's live within every flower, why not be their leader and strategize their survival against everything that lies within the flowers and fades. Skill Tree Gain energy from picking flowers and advancing a flower colony, pay for skills that will help you around the island, also your very own WATER BOY! Story Go through the complex life of B as he struggles to balance his life between the island that calls to him, and fighting his way to the top of the gangs of Cardigan. Legendary Flowers After purchasing the skill, when growing flowers you have the chance to grow a special legendary flower! Island Friends! ISLAND FRIENDS!!!

rows.name: Possessions
rows.short_description: Trapped in a house cursed by a Kitsune and forced to play his game, you must compete with other souls to take control a burglar's body and gain your freedom. Play as a stray soul trying to ambush the burglar by possessing household objects or as the burglar trying to finish tasks and find an exit!
rows.description_html: Daily Demo Edition In the Daily Demo Edition, it's free to play for up to 30 minutes each day, but only with default match settings. Lobbies can even accept players from both paid and demo versions! If your time runs out during a match, you'll be able to finish that match. If you get disconnected during a match, you can still start a new match as long as you've played less than 30 minutes that day. The play time only runs down while you're in a match and it gets reset every day at 3pm GMT (12am JST). About the Game In this online, asymmetric, mess-with-your-friends party game, one player controls a Burglar trapped in a house by a Kitsune and forced to do random tasks while 2-8 other players play as invisible Ghosts with the ability to possess household objects and use them to ambush the Burglar, take control of the body, and attempt to accomplish their own tasks. The first one to finish their tasks and escape the house with the body wins the round! Form lobbies and play online with your friends or join public lobbies. Play as the Burglar: -Explore the house to find the objects on your list and make it to an exit while avoiding ambushes -Pay attention to subtle visible and audible clues to tell if a ghost possessed a nearby object -Use the dodge mechanic to quickly roll out of the way of an ambush -Use the night vision mechanic to walk around in the dark or turn the lights on and let your eyes adjust Play as the Ghosts: -Customize the look of your ghost with several Colors, Eyes, and Flair to choose from -Possess objects and time your ambush to hit the Burglar and take control of the body -Use decoys while possessing objects to taunt and goad the Burglar -Watch the tasks that the Burglar completes and undo them later after taking control -Turn lights on near the Burglar to cause a flashbang effect and discharge his night vision -Turn lights off near the Burglar to plunge him into darkness until his night vision charges -Utilize the Ghost's glow to easily see in the dark -Scout out the house to learn the location of the shuffled rooms before becoming the Burglar

rows.name: Hyperhell
rows.short_description: HYPERHELL is a breakneck top-down movement shooter featuring the talents of several prolific hyperpop musicians. Obliterate your way through a colorful city of demons to reclaim what was stolen from you: a fully stocked fridge.
rows.description_html: HYPERHELL is a maximalist bullet hell roguelike featuring Fraxiom, Gupi and various hyperpop musicians. Free, with no DLC or microtransactions. Ronald Reagan has stolen Food House's fully stocked refrigerator, and it's up to them get it back. Travel through colorful cities in hell using a drill powered by demon blood to reach Satan's megamansion and reclaim your grub. Use popstar powers + a huge arsenal of cartoonish weaponry to carve your way through a wide array of enemies and bosses. Play fast and aggressive using a momentum based movement style to keep up with your appetite. Play as Fraxiom, Gupi, and other hyperpop musicians each with their own popstar powers Dodge and carve through a variety of different enemy bullet types and patterns using a massive arsenal of goofy over-the-top weapons Plunge deeper through the Murder City Megamall, SinCorp LLC Offices, and Satan's Megamansion Outmaneuver your opponents on grind-rails and boost pads with ridiculous movement mechanics Unlock new weapons and powerups for completing challenges, like the Rave Cannon and Trampoline Rifle Looping system allowing high level players to continue runs endlessly Fishing minigame

rows.name: Dungeon Redemption
rows.short_description: Dungeon Redemption is an Indie turn-based tactical roguelike where you command adventurers on journeys into the deep of dungeons. Master survival puzzles, and dive into ever-changing maps to guard the holy contracts! The gameplay is challenging enough to satisfy the strategy lovers.
rows.description_html: Adventurers who stumbled into the Forbidden Forests contracted in legend. 'For my redemption, live, adventurers!' Guide your band of adventurers through the darkest dungeon. Ram your enemies into environmental hazards, and do your best to survive in this harsh and unforgiving realm. In a randomly changing battle map, you'll control adventurers to use their skills wisely, using terrain and orientation mechanics to fight aggressive monsters and guard the holy contracts. Key Features: Exploration in the dark Dungeon : RPG with a focus on combat in a dark fantasy setting, with multiple environmental factors. Defend the Hourglass : Defend them from the enemies and watch your fire! Perfect Your Strategy : All enemy attacks are in turn-based combat. Analyze your opponent's attack and come up with the perfect counter every turn. Build your lineup : Shield your allies and counterattack your enemies when they strike. Use your archers for ranged support while performing melee attacks. Or execute one of many possible combo attacks! Another Chance : Failure is not an option. When you are defeated, send help back through time to save another timeline! Dungeon Redemption is currently in the demo stage. As game developers, we are keen to hear any of your feedback. Join our to exchange ideas and most importantly, have fun!
